Hence the official (ell,w)=(2,5) slot has an exact finite certificate: one pair per odd-dilation orbit at M=1024 and exclusion of every Delta factor q<2^256 with v_2(q-1)>=41. The reduction is proved; that production certificate is not yet complete.

nodes.title: DLI ell=2 weight-6 relations reduce to a guarded triple-cubic norm router
nodes.statement: Assume the paid official order-1024 weight-3 exclusion. Normalize three roots of a reduced weight-6 relation to {1,x,y}, put u=1+x+y, A=x+y+xy, B=xy, and select the product d in mu_1024 of the remaining triple. Then u is nonzero, C=(uA-B-d)/u, and the remaining roots have cubic T^3+uT^2+CT-d. Scaling those roots by u gives division-free coupled doubling recurrences S_(2m)=S_m^2-2T_m, T_(2m)=T_m^2-2P_mS_m, P_(2m)=P_m^2. Subject to the exact distinctness/disjointness guards, the cubic roots lie in mu_1024 iff S_1024=3u^1024 and T_1024=3u^2048. Thus the residual (ell,w)=(2,6) slot reduces to at most 1,514*1,024=1,550,336 pair-product candidates, each with two explicit cyclotomic norm obstructions. An official supporting prime cannot divide Norm(u), by the weight-3 exclusion, so all shared Norm(u) factors may be saturated out of the norm gcd. This is a proved router, not an emptiness theorem.

nodes.title: DLI zero-fiber mass is bounded by the full primitive-relation polymer majorant
nodes.statement: For signed kernel relations c with activity 2^(-|supp c|), every relation partitions into disjoint primitive relations. Hence the normalized zero-fiber partition function Z is at most the primitive independence polynomial and therefore at most exp(P), where P is the full primitive activity. The raw full-spectrum signed-shift ledger W_full dominates P, so E_j<=r_j exp(W_full,j). On the official schedule, product_j E_j<=2^100 follows from sum_j W_full,j<=100 log 2+t log(2^256/q). This exact interface replaces the refuted truncated C1' route but does not assert the aggregate full-spectrum budget, C2'', or B-WEAK.

nodes.title: DLI primitive conflict pressure is bounded by a truncated exponential
nodes.statement: If every primitive signed relation at a DLI level has support at least w_0, every compatible collection in the primitive independence polynomial has size at most K=floor(N/w_0). Weighted clique symmetrization gives the sharp total-activity bound I<=(1+P/K)^K<=Exp_K(P), hence E_j<=r_j(1+W_full,j/K_j)^K_j for the raw primitive ledger. The proved production exclusions give K=51 at ell=1, K=85 at ell=2, K=113 at ell=4, and K=floor(256ell/(2ell+1))<=127 for ell>=8. Therefore the full marginal baseline follows from sum_j K_j log(1+W_full,j/K_j)<=100log2+t log(2^256/q). The pressure bound is not asserted; this is the first exact support-conflict correction after the exp(W_full) route fence.

nodes.title: Affine-core all-zero charge
nodes.statement: Under the affine-core cogirth hypotheses, fix a kernel-coordinate basis T and let p_T be the number of persistent zero coordinates outside T. Genericity gives p_T<=N-r-a-1. Every sparse error over T has at least N-r-a-p_T nonpersistent zeros, and those zero sets are disjoint across slopes. Hence at most r+1 pairs use T, proving |P|C(Delta-r+a-1,a)<=C(N,a)(r+1). Exact XR arithmetic pays full-domain selector ranks 4,4,4,11,11,10, closing rank four on all six rows without collision-line coverage.

nodes.title: XR coherent GRS split pencils have an exact extra-kernel certificate
nodes.statement: For a common GRS_4 split-pencil family with received word U, extension direction q, distinct slopes gamma_i, and agreement blocks A_i, stack zero-extended cubic parity checks as M_F=[H_i|-gamma_i H_i]. The unavoidable cubic-pair kernel has dimension eight, while the genuine pair (U,q) supplies a ninth direction whose second projection is noncubic, so rank M_F<=2N-9; rank 2N-8 excludes the proposed family. Moreover, on every six-set the five-face divided-difference colors are a fractional-linear function of the omitted coordinate, hence all defined colors are either pairwise distinct or all equal. This is an exact necessary rank/Plucker certificate interface, not the aggregate split-pencil count.

nodes.title: XR low-core one-loop deficiency reduces to the coherent GRS split-pencil census
nodes.statement: In the P-B rank-five (u,v)=(0,1) branch, the loop coordinate is an agreement for at most one slope. Removing it and that possible exceptional member from a family above B=8n^3 leaves at least B regular members in a GRS_4 extension, with agreement block sizes 10/10/8 and pair cap four. Peeling at budget B-1 forces r=2 collision-direction degrees 209/207/66; every retained block is a divided-difference monochromatic clique, its reused directions are hypersurface-free through degrees 5/5/3, and optimized local zero-minor floors are 97650/52530/1782. This reduces the deficiency pair to a coherent split-pencil census but does not count it.

nodes.title: Post-strip affine-pencil charge
nodes.statement: Under the affine-core charge hypotheses, assume distinct selected errors have common zero set at most kappa<=k. For each kernel basis T used by two slopes, its persistent set completes T to their exact common zero set, so p_T+a<=kappa. The all-zero incidence then gives M_T<=floor((n-kappa)/(k+h-kappa)) and |P|C(h+a,a)<=C(n,a)floor((n-kappa)/(k+h-kappa)). The post-strip high-core branch uses kappa=k and the low-core branch uses kappa=k-1. Exact XR arithmetic pays selector ranks 4,4,4,15,15,14.

nodes.title: XR rank-five collision directions form a star configuration
nodes.statement: For a retained rank-five u=v=0 agreement block A, the cubic interpolation hyperplanes p(x)=q(x), x in A, are in simple position: Vandermonde independence gives unique fourfold intersections I_Tq and the divided-difference bridge excludes fivefold intersections. Their C(4+h,4) vertices are the projective collision directions. A nonzero degree-d polynomial on cubic-coefficient space is nonzero on at least C(4+h-d,4) vertices for d<=h, sharply. Therefore the official r=2 reused direction sets lie on no nonzero hypersurface of degree at most 4/4/2. This is local direction rigidity, not a point count.

nodes.title: XR rank-five residual is a divided-difference monochromatic-clique census
nodes.statement: In the retained P-A RowC rank-five u=v=0 core, every selected agreement set A has nonzero fourth divided difference [S]q on each five-subset S. Indeed, a zero would make all five constituent four-sets unreusable, while the r=2 peeling core permits at most 1/3/4 unreused four-sets on the three rows. Therefore Phi(S)=[S]U/[S]q is defined throughout A and is identically the selected slope gamma. Distinct members are distinct-color monochromatic (4+h)-cliques, and the preceding ratio fibers and zero minors are exactly equal-color four-stars of Phi. This is an exact bridge to the split-pencil census, not a clique count.

nodes.title: XR rank-five selectors reduce to one-dimensional extension lists
nodes.statement: For a RowC selector of affine rank five, puncture the persistent global roots P_0. The selected slopes become codewords in distinct quotient classes of a five-dimensional code C_E containing the four-dimensional kernel code K_E, all agreeing with one received word in at least 4+h+u+v positions. Their pairwise agreement is at most 4+u+v for P-A or 3+u+v for P-B. K_E has v loop coordinates and, after deleting and scaling them, is a four-dimensional polynomial subspace W subset F[X]_<4+u. At u=v=0 this is exactly a one-dimensional extension of GRS_4. This is an exact residual reduction, not a list-size payment.

nodes.title: XR rank-five rich lines force external maximal-minor zeros
nodes.statement: In the P-A RowC rank-five u=v=0 branch, normalize K_E to GRS_4. For a selected codeword c with residual z and chosen agreement set A, each four-set T subset A defines r_T=q-I_Tq and the exact collision line c+lambda*r_T. Other selected line members give distinct h-rich fibers of z/r_T on E\A. Equality in a fiber is exactly a vanishing 6x6 minor of the global lift (1,x,x^2,x^3,q,U). Combining with the rich-line hierarchy forces at least 23560/12600/228 distinct external vanishing-minor records per retained member on the three RowC rows. This is a representability reduction, not a slope count.

nodes.title: XR rank-five base residual has a near-saturated collision-line core
nodes.statement: In the RowC rank-five u=v=0 branch, choose 4+h agreements per selected codeword. P-B has pair cap three, so four-bases are unique and its three exact counts are below 8n^3. For P-A, a peeling argument on the C(N,4) kernel bases shows that any counterexample contains a nonempty subfamily in which every member lies on at least 125/123/31 distinct collision lines at rates 1/4,1/8,1/16, out of only 126/126/35 possible bases. The per-line post-strip caps are 153/179/320. This is a structural reduction, not a payment of the P-A line-rich core.

nodes.title: XR rank-five base residual has a multiplicity-sensitive rich-line hierarchy
nodes.statement: In the P-A RowC rank-five u=v=0 branch, put b=C(4+h,4), T=C(R+4,4), and B=8n^3. For every r>=2 with d_r=b-floor((r-1)T/(B+1))>0, any family above B has a nonempty subfamily in which every member lies on at least d_r distinct collision lines containing at least r members. The exact minimum degrees at r=3 are 123/120/27, and positive forced cores persist through r=74/40/9 at rates 1/4,1/8,1/16. This is a structural rich-line reduction, not a count of the surviving core.

nodes.title: XR rank-five one-defect quartic kernels have few nonbasis locators
nodes.statement: In a rank-five extension-list branch with u=1, the normalized kernel is a four-dimensional subspace W of quartics. A four-set T is a kernel nonbasis exactly when its split locator L_T lies in W. If W has no common evaluation root on an N-point domain, a triple-completion count and the sharp split-cubic locator line bound give at most floor((C(N,3)+(N-2)(N-4))/4) nonbasis four-sets. Official agreement blocks therefore contain at most 42/42/20 nonbases and at least 168/168/50 bases. This is a source-to-flat refinement, not an XR payment.

nodes.title: RS common-root weighted basis charge
nodes.statement: For a post-strip RS selector with affine kernel rank a, let G be the global common-root set of the kernel slice and P_0 the roots persistent on the whole affine family. The RS gcd bound gives |G|<=k-a, while every root in G\P_0 can vanish at only one selected slope. A loopless refinement of the cogirth basis lemma gives a*b_e>=m_e*C(a+h-1,a-1), where m_e is the number of nonloop zeros. Combining the summed basis supply with the per-basis post-strip pencil cap yields the exact common-root inequality and its endpoint envelope. Exact XR arithmetic pays selector ranks 4,4,4,16,16,14, moving the first open prize ranks to 17,17,15.

nodes.title: RS flat-nullity basis charge
nodes.statement: After factoring the global roots of a rank-a RS kernel slice, write u=k-a-|G| and v=|G|-|P_0|. Every proper rank-j flat of each nonloop zero-set matroid has size at most j+u, so ordered basis extension gives a*b_e>=m_e*C(m_e-u-1,a-1). Summing against the post-strip pencil cap and combining with the persistent-root subset-packing bound leaves only 14/8, 70/49, and 323/274 possible (u,v) pairs at RowC selector rank five for P-A/P-B, from 32131, 7875, and 1891 pairs respectively. This is a structural residual reduction, not a new rank payment.

nodes.title: XR split-pencil rank anomalies contain explicit dual-product-code trades
nodes.statement: Every nonzero left-kernel relation in a bounded split-pencil Maxwell core is a family of dual cubic-evaluation words lambda_i satisfying sum lambda_i=sum gamma_i lambda_i=0. On a block A_i of size 4+c_i, lambda_i(x)=P_i(x)/Lambda'_Ai(x) with deg P_i<c_i, so every active block has weight at least five. At every active coordinate at least three distinct slopes occur, and the coefficients have the dual-RS_2 form Q_x(gamma_i)/product_(j!=i)(gamma_i-gamma_j), deg Q_x<|I_x|-2. Thus every counterexample contains a bounded (block-degree at least 5, coordinate-degree at least 3) dual-product-code trade. This is a normal form, not a trade classification.

nodes.title: XR split-pencil counterexamples contain bounded Maxwell-dense cores
nodes.statement: Any genuine GRS_4 split-pencil family of (4+c)-blocks with c|F|>=2N-8 contains an inclusion-minimal subfamily G with c|G|=2|union G|-8+e, 0<=e<=c-1, while every proper J has c|J|<=2|union J|-9. Each block has at most floor((c-1-e)/2) private coordinates, and the stacked parity matrix has left nullity at least e+1, one beyond ordinary overdetermination. Official P-A core sizes are at most 308/359/640 and P-B one-loop core sizes at most 256/299/480. This is a bounded anomalous-core extraction, not its classification.

nodes.title: XR split-pencil dual trades have no rank one and localized rank two
nodes.statement: Let Lambda be a nonzero dual trade with distinct slopes and block intersection cap four. Rank one is impossible: dual RS_2 slope distance forces at least three proportional block rows, while dual GRS_4 distance gives them a common support of size at least five. At rank two there are at least four projectively distinct block rows; disjointness of their noncommon zero sets on the row-code line gives active coordinate support R<=floor(tm/(t-1))<=floor(4m/3). The official P-A caps are 12/12/9 and P-B one-loop caps are 13/13/10. This is a bounded-chart localization, not a payment.

nodes.title: Exact simple-pole floor through the maximal cyclic residual prefix
nodes.statement: At the official n=2^41, k=2^40 rate-half row, take c=2^22,d=2048 and the maximal legal residual prefix s=c-1. The cyclic list L_q=ceil(C(524287,264192)/(524288*q^2047)) gives epsilon_ca,epsilon_mca >= L_q(q-n)/(q(q-n+kL_q)) > 2^-83 at excess dc+s=8,594,128,895 and every smaller positive excess, uniformly for q<2^256. This refutes the former fixed safe point at excess 8,592,912,739.

nodes.title: Exact MCA equality: far-pair CA maximum versus sparse mutual layer
nodes.statement: For every linear code and integer agreement a, the exact support-wise MCA bad-slope numerator equals max(B_ca^far(a),S_sparse(a)), where the first term maximizes over column-far pairs and the second over pairs supported on at most n-a coordinates. Thus an MCA safe upper bound is exactly the conjunction of the two corresponding integer upper bounds.

nodes.title: Rate-half sparse pinning, normal form, and coupled match rigidity
nodes.statement: At agreement a=k+tau in an RS code, every non-tangent MCA-bad slope of a pair supported on e<=n-a coordinates is pinned by one active match to a nonzero ambiguity polynomial z=h product_(x in Z)(X-x), with |Z|>=a-e, deg h<=e-tau-1, and T>=A-e+tau+1+u active matches under the same radius budget. Hence e>=tau+1. For the official rate-half row and q>=2^168, all tangent slopes fit floor(q/2^128), leaving exactly the non-tangent coupled system.

nodes.title: DLI ell=2 weight-6 relations excluded by recursive norm and the official split gate
nodes.statement: For every official q<2^256 with v_2(q-1)>=41 and every exact order-1024 root omega in F_q, no reduced signed weight-6 polynomial P satisfies P(omega)=P(omega^3)=0. Odd dilation and rechoosing the normalized root of the selected triple reduce the triple-cubic router to exactly 404,740 candidate orbits. Of these, 404,230 have nonzero Norm(u)-saturated obstruction gcds factoring over 443 recursively Pocklington-certified primes with maximum v_2(p-1)=18. For the 510 identically double-zero candidates, the characteristic-zero power-of-two vanishing-sum lemma forces an antipodal pair, so the reduced guard fails. Hence the residual WCL slot (ell,w)=(2,6) is empty on every official row.

nodes.title: DLI ell=2 weight-6 split-16 counterfixture
nodes.statement: In GF(65537), an exact order-1024 subgroup contains the reduced antipodal-free six-set of exponents {0,180,211,585,852,903}; both its first and third odd moments vanish. The triple-cubic router guards hold, and v_2(65537-1)=16. Thus order-1024 splitting, or any blanket split threshold at most 2^16, does not imply emptiness of the (ell,w)=(2,6) slot. This is not an official counterexample because the official ambient split requires v_2(q-1)>=41.

nodes.title: PMA rate-half core triple-excess reduction
nodes.statement: Fixing three touched full petals identifies the nonpositive-J rate-half tail with a core RS list of length N=4ell+b-2, dimension K_0=ell+b-1, and agreement m=2ell+b+a-2. Any three contributors force, after removing their common factor, a nonconstant rational map whose 0, 1, and infinity fibers on the core have total size at least 2r+3a. Thus absence of this source-coupled positive three-fiber certificate pays the full tail by 8n per carried source. An exact smooth order-100 arbitrary-core fixture at the first J=0 row shows the generic smooth-core version is false, so the remaining theorem must retain the PMA CRT coupling.

nodes.title: PMA rate-half source-aligned gcd excess
nodes.statement: For fixed core and three touched petals, the forced PMA core word belongs to an explicit three-dimensional CRT quotient code: if E_c is constant c_i modulo each petal locator, then L_C E_c=P_*+LY and y=Y on the core. Any three tail contributors force the exact aligned overlap inequality u_12+u_13+u_23-tau >= 2(K_0-1)+3a, where the four terms are degrees of gcds with L_C, the source numerator P_*, and the three pair differences. Ambient equality fibers not carrying the source value are excluded. Absence of this certificate pays the tail by 8n per source.

nodes.title: PMA rate-half source cross-ratio fiber reduction
nodes.statement: Affine changes of the three source labels preserve the tail list, so every distinct triple normalizes to (0,1,lambda). Modulo the core RS code the source quotient code is two-dimensional. The lambda coefficient of the source numerator factors as L_1L_2R_3 with deg R_3<ell, leaving at most ell-1 exceptional core points. Removing their maximum overlap weight from the aligned gcd bonus leaves at least 2b+3a-2 weighted nonexceptional incidences voting for one source cross-ratio lambda. Absence of this fiber certificate pays the tail by 8n per source.

nodes.title: PMA rate-half two-petal support-fiber reduction
nodes.statement: After normalizing labels to (0,1,lambda), each exact core agreement set S determines a unique cofactor V_S by inversion modulo the second petal locator. A contributor exists exactly when deg V_S<=ell-a, the second residue Phi(S) modulo the third petal locator is the constant lambda, and V_S has no extra core root outside S. The reconstruction H_S=(L_SV_S-F_lambda)/(L_2L_3) is inverse to this map. Thus the fixed-cell list is exactly one guarded support-map fiber, with no separate missed-core or contributor-polynomial multiplier.

nodes.title: PMA rate-half guarded fibers are exact complement-divisor linear slices
nodes.statement: For normalized labels (0,1,lambda), write E_c=L_1 Etilde and M=L_2L_3. Complementing an exact m-point core support S by D=L_C/L_S gives deg D=2ell-a, and the predecessor's guarded support condition is equivalent to deg rem_M(D Etilde)<=ell-a and gcd(D,rem_M(D Etilde))=1. Conversely every such monic divisor reconstructs one exact contributor. Since Etilde is a unit modulo M, the unguarded slice in K[X]/(M) has dimension ell-a+1 and codimension ell+a-1. Its degree-2ell-a truncation is linearly identical to the proved three-petal mu-basis space; if the guarded fiber is nonempty, its dimension is one below the half strip and ell-2a+2 in the live upper strip. This is an exact BC/SCK-shaped instance map, not a max-fiber bound or an ordinary-prefix conjugacy.

nodes.title: Exact support-wise MCA numerator at full agreement
nodes.statement: For every proper linear code over F_q, the finite-slope support-wise numerator at full agreement is exactly B_mca(n)=1. The same one-slope construction gives B_mca(a)>=1 at every agreement. Hence q<2^128 has grand threshold zero, while q>=2^128 has a safe full-agreement endpoint. Combined with the rate-half pole floor, k+8,594,128,896<=a_RH(q)<=n.

nodes.title: Rate-half high-field safe bracket at half the minimum distance
nodes.statement: For the official n=2^41,k=2^40 rate-half row and q>=2^169, the exact MCA half-distance theorem plus the published CA proximity-gap import gives B_mca(3n/4)<=n<=floor(q/2^128). Hence k+8,594,128,896<=a_RH(q)<=3n/4 throughout that high-field range.

nodes.title: Rate-half far-CA rider and doubly sparse reduction
nodes.statement: For every linear code at integer radius r<n/2, the far-pair correlated-agreement numerator obeys B_ca^far(n-r)<=1+(r+1)L_2(n-2r). If a column-far pair has at least two bad slopes, translation by a code pair normalizes both received components to 2r-sparse errors. At rate one half and agreement a=k+tau, the deficient pair-list agreement is n-2r=2tau. This is a structural reduction and does not assert that its sufficient prize inequality holds.

nodes.title: Exact low-field rate-half threshold and post-cutoff bracket
nodes.statement: For the official n=2^41,k=2^40 rate-half row, let r_Q=389,500,552,608 and B_Q=r_Q+1. For every admissible field with B=floor(q/2^128)<=B_Q, the exact adjacent certificate is B_mca(n-B+1)=B<B_mca(n-B), the latter numerator being at least B+1. Thus every admissible q<(B_Q+1)2^128, approximately 2^166.502834419, is completely determined. More generally, for 1<=B<=k-1, n-B+1<=a_RH(q)<=n-min(B-1,r_Q). When B_Q<B<=2^39+1, safety at the lower candidate is equivalent to the single far-CA bound B_ca^far(n-B+1)<=B because its sparse numerator is already at most B-1.

nodes.title: Post-quadratic MDS extension fence
nodes.statement: For RS[F_5,{0,1,2,3},2] at radius r=1, the first radius beyond the quadratic hypothesis, a column-far received pair with syndromes y_0=(0,1), y_1=(1,4) has four CA-bad finite slopes, while r+1=2. Thus the official post-quadratic CA assertion cannot follow from a universal MDS extension of B_ca^far(n-r)<=r+1; an official-row proof must exploit additional long-domain or anchor-pencil structure.

nodes.title: Exact far-CA anchor-pencil normal form
nodes.statement: For every linear code and column-far pair at radius r, fixing one bad slope with error e_0 of support size s gives an exact parametrization of every other bad slope as gamma_0+lambda with a codeword p satisfying wt(e_0+lambda(f_2-p))<=r. If t is the number of off-anchor discrepancies of p, then r-s+1<=t<=r and at least s+t-r anchor coordinates satisfy p=f_2+e_0/lambda. When 2r<d_min, p is unique per slope. This uniqueness holds throughout the first official post-quadratic CA-only range.

nodes.title: Far-CA as a split-locator Hankel pencil
nodes.statement: For every RS code and 1<=r<=n-k, a syndrome is within radius r exactly when its (n-k-r) by (r+1) Hankel matrix has a kernel vector that is the coefficient vector of a monic squarefree degree-r locator split over the evaluation domain. A received pair is column-close exactly when the two Hankel kernels share such a locator. Hence for a column-far pair, CA-bad slopes are exactly the parameters where the syndrome Hankel pencil has a domain-split kernel locator. At the first official transition, the missing r+1 bound is an exact supported-slope split-pencil census.

nodes.title: Full-column-rank rate-half Hankel branch
nodes.statement: For r<(n-k)/2, if the (n-k-r) by (r+1) syndrome Hankel pencil has generic column rank r+1, then a fixed nonzero maximal minor of degree at most r+1 contains every slope with a nonzero kernel. Hence at most r+1 slopes carry a domain-split locator, proving the required far-CA bound in this branch. In the first official transition, only generically rank-deficient pencils remain; at the final CA-only block r=(n-k)/2, deficiency is forced by matrix dimensions.

nodes.title: Fixed-kernel rate-half Hankel branch
nodes.statement: Let rho>=1 be the generic rank of an RS syndrome Hankel pencil. If its generic right kernel is the scalar extension of a fixed F-subspace K_0, then K_0 is annihilated by both endpoint matrices. For a column-far pair K_0 contains no domain-split locator. Away from the roots of one nonzero rho-minor, specialization preserves rank and the kernel remains K_0. Hence at most rho finite slopes carry a split locator. This closes every constant-kernel rank-deficient branch, including at the half-distance endpoint; only genuinely moving generic kernels remain.

nodes.title: Two-sided minimal-index budget for moving Hankel kernels
nodes.statement: For a generically rank-deficient scalar syndrome Hankel pencil of generic rank rho, the binary divided-power apolar complete intersection gives the same degree-rho generator Q_Z for the right and left kernels. If its primitive parameter degree is e and it has s fixed evaluation-domain factors, Kronecker degree and residual apolarity give (R+1-2rho+s)e<=rho-s. Coupling the resulting regular-block allowance with root incidence bounds all supported slopes. At the official rate-half row this proves the far-CA r+1 bound for every r<=2^39-2, extending the exact adjacent formula to every admissible q<2^167. Only budgets 2^39 and 2^39+1 remain in the first CA-only block.

nodes.title: Exceptional-slope root charge for Hankel pencils
nodes.statement: For a moving generic apolar generator Q_Z of parameter degree e, a supported rank-drop slope of loss c retains domain roots while c is charged to Kronecker multiplicity. The base bound is T(rho-s)<=(N-s)e+rho-(R+1-2rho)e; contracting the fixed core strengthens the regular allowance to rho-s-(R+1-2rho+s)e. At the official A=3 profiles this closes every e<=2^37-1, forces the remaining high-degree branch to have no fixed domain roots, and also closes e=2^37 at the half-distance budget. At the A=1 endpoint it closes every e<=2^37 and leaves only three explicit core-size rows with s<=2.

nodes.title: Endpoint saturation rigidity for the strict A=3 Hankel profile
nodes.statement: At the first unresolved strict A=3 parameter degree, write rho=4m-1, N=16m, e=m, and delta=m-1. If the desired T<=rho+1 cap fails, exceptional-root charging and parameter-root incidence force the unique count T=4m+1. If O is the total number of domain roots omitted from the specialized generic generators, then O<=delta and the exact column-capacity deficit is 1+O<=m. Hence at least 15m=15N/16 domain points occur as roots at exactly m supported slopes, exhausting the parameter degree of Q_Z(x). This is a necessary extremal profile, not an exclusion of it.

nodes.title: Endpoint norm-defect and complementary-factor identities
nodes.statement: For a hypothetical failure at the first strict A=3 endpoint, let H be the squarefree supported-slope form, R=product_(x in D)Q(x) the parameter norm, and O the aggregate omitted-domain-root count. There are forms J,S with J R=H^rho S, deg J=O<=m-1, and deg S=1+O<=m. If P_sat is the product of the at least 15m saturated domain points, there are complementary biforms Vbar,W with Q Vbar+P_sat W=H, deg_param Vbar=3m+1, deg_X Vbar<deg P_sat, and deg_X W<=rho-1. At least 2m+2 supported slopes are generic-rank, D-split, and parameter-transverse. The D x Z evaluation matrix is a full-row/full-column Reed-Solomon product-code word with exact column and row MDS excesses O and 1+O. These identities are necessary normal forms, not exclusions of the endpoint configuration.

nodes.title: Component-profile rigidity at the strict endpoint
nodes.statement: Factor a hypothetical first strict A=3 endpoint counterexample into irreducible bidegree components (r_i,e_i). Component root incidence gives T r_i-I_i>=T r_i-N e_i, while the aggregate row shortfall is at most O<=m-1. Hence r_i<=4e_i. Since sum_i(4e_i-r_i)=4m-(4m-1)=1, there is exactly one component with r=4e-1 and every other component has r=4e. The balanced components consume at least four shortfall units per parameter degree, so their total parameter degree is at most floor((m-1)/4); the unique defect-one component has e>=ceil((3m+1)/4). In particular Q cannot split into rational parameter branches, but the dominant nonlinear component remains open.

nodes.title: Component-defect localization at the strict endpoint
nodes.statement: At the first strict A=3 endpoint, let E be overlap among the distinct irreducible-component incidence sets, D_i=T r_i-I_i the row deficit, C_i=N e_i-I_i the column deficit, and b the total parameter degree outside the unique defect-one component. The generator is geometrically squarefree and the exact ledgers are sum D_i=O-E and sum C_i=1+O-E. The dominant component satisfies C_*-D_*=4b+1, while every balanced residual component satisfies D_i-C_i=4e_i. Hence 4b<=O-E and e_*>=m-floor((O-E)/4). Every component splits disjointly on at least 3m+2 supported slopes and at least 15m domain fibers; at least 3m+1-O supported slopes are also parameter-transverse. The dominant nonlinear component remains open.

nodes.title: Separated-pullback exclusion at the strict endpoint
nodes.statement: At the official first strict A=3 endpoint, the dominant irreducible component of bidegree (4e-1,e) cannot be a separated rational fiber product f(X)=g(U:V) with map degrees 4e-1 and e. For such a pullback, grouping grid points by their common image and optimizing the two capped fiber-size sequences gives a column deficit C_*>m throughout ceil((3m+1)/4)<=e<=m. Component-defect localization instead gives C_*<=sum_i C_i=1+O-E<=m. Thus polynomial separated-variable, Kummer pullback, and general separated rational-map models are excluded. Since an irreducible separation-rank-two biform is such a cross-multiplied rational equality, the dominant component has separation rank at least three. The full primitive generator also has separation rank at least three: rank two would force column deficit at least 4(m-1)>m, versus its exact 1+O<=m. Genuinely mixed biforms remain open.

nodes.title: Rational-normal kernel curve at the strict endpoint
nodes.statement: At the official first strict A=3,e=m endpoint, the (4m+1) by 4m Hankel pencil has generic rank 4m-1 and exactly one right singular block. The two-sided minimal-index theorem identifies it as L_m. Consequently, if Q(U,V;X)=sum_j Q_j(X)U^(m-j)V^j is the full primitive kernel generator, its m+1 coefficient forms Q_j are linearly independent. The separation rank of Q is exactly m+1, and the projective kernel map is a degree-m rational normal curve. Domain evaluation is injective. At least 3m+2 supported points of the curve are squarefree D-split locators, and at least 15m domain-evaluation hyperplanes each cut it in m distinct supported points. This exposes the exact endpoint geometry but does not exclude it.

nodes.title: Dominant-component rank amplification at the strict endpoint
nodes.statement: At the official first strict endpoint, maximal separation rank m+1 of the full primitive generator propagates through its irreducible factorization. For every component Q_i of parameter degree e_i, sr(Q_i)>=ceil((m+1)/(m-e_i+1)). For the unique dominant component, its complement has parameter degree b=m-e_*<=floor((O-E)/4)<=m/4-1, so sr(Q_*)>=ceil((m+1)/(b+1))>=5. If b=0, Q_*=Q has exact rank m+1. Thus all rank-three and rank-four mixed dominant models are excluded; rank-five-or-higher models remain open.

nodes.title: XR one-defect low-core lies outside the ambient augmented-paving payment
nodes.statement: The generic XR rank-five (u,v)=(1,0) kernel is a four-dimensional quartic subspace and need not be MDS: span(1,X,X^2,L_T) is source-compatible but has a dependent evaluation four-set T. Hence the printed all-pair weighted-RS paving theorem does not apply to this whole branch. Even granting its strongest ambient deep-hole specialization on the special MDS branch gives RowC ceilings 9,009,204,611 / 19,418,424,240 / 123,242,307,467, all above 8*1024^3. At rate quarter a closing augmented-basis proof must establish beta_5(A)<=2,164,663,517,435, a source-coupled saving of at least 105,656,044,614 five-row bases (4.653796 percent) from ambient. This is a sharp route fence, not an XR payment.

nodes.title: XR nonlocal rank-two trades are quadratic or cubic rational fibers
nodes.statement: For either nonlocal rank-two profile, dual-GRS_4 scaling identifies the two-dimensional row space with a polynomial pencil of degree at most R-5. Since there are four slopes, the row-coefficient code equals dual RS_2, so a projective change turns the pencil ratio into a rational function phi whose four fibers on the active set are exactly the row zero sets. The R=7 profile is degree two and its three pairs are orbits of one Mobius involution. The R=8 profile has degree two or three; its quadratic branch has four involution pairs, while an explicit F_103 cube-fiber trade proves the cubic branch is genuine. This is a rational-fiber dictionary, not an ownership/counting theorem.

nodes.title: XR rank-two trades are proper subcircuits of official Maxwell cores
nodes.statement: Embed any of the five rank-two support profiles into full official Maxwell blocks. Charging every coordinate saved beyond private placement to newly consumed pair-intersection slack gives exact lower bounds on Delta_J=2|union J|-8-c|J|. Across P-A block types (m,c)=(9,5),(7,3) and P-B one-loop types (10,6),(8,4), the minimum is Delta_J=2 and all twenty profile bounds are explicit and set-system sharp. The full Maxwell core has deficit -e<=0, so a rank-two relation can never activate every block. Hence every rank-two anomaly is a proper local subcircuit, while every full-block-support anomaly has trade rank at least three. This is a circuit split, not a payment of the local branch.

nodes.title: XR six-face Plucker syzygies remove three rank-two profiles
nodes.statement: On a six-set X, t selected five-faces with distinct split-pencil colors obey one fractional-linear color law. Their canonical dual-cubic face words mu_i have an exact left-syzygy space ker(1;x_i;gamma_i;x_i gamma_i) of dimension t-3, because that matrix has rank three. Conversely every R=6 rank-two trade from the support atlas is one of these forced local Plucker syzygies. After quotienting their span from the parity stack's left kernel, only the two nonlocal rank-two profiles (t,R;z)=(4,7;1,2,2,2) and (4,8;2,2,2,2) remain. This is an exact known-syzygy quotient, not a payment of the two residual profiles.

nodes.title: XR rank-two dual trades have five exact support profiles
nodes.statement: For a rank-two dual-product-code trade, each active coordinate is nonzero in all but at most one projectively distinct block row. Double-counting pairwise support intersections excludes pair cap at most three. Under pair cap four it forces 4<=t<=6, 6<=R<=8, and exactly five zero-set profiles: (t,R;z)=(4,6;1^4),(4,7;1,2^3),(4,8;2^4),(5,6;1^5),(6,6;1^6). The row space is a two-dimensional dual-GRS_4 subcode and the row-coefficient space a two-dimensional dual-RS_2 subcode; either inclusion is equality at R=6 or t=4 respectively. Explicit finite-field trades realize all five profiles, so this is a sharp support atlas, not a chart payment.

nodes.title: Upstream affine-span and rank-flat RS list compilers
nodes.statement: For an affine direction-s codeword flat in RS[F,D,K], the number of members agreeing with one received word on at least m=K+w coordinates is at most floor(C(n-K+s,s)/C(w+s,s)). With generalized direction-code weights d_j, common-zero miss count b, and t=n-m, the sharper cap is floor(d_s falling s / product_j(d_j-t+b)), where d_j>=n-K+j. This independently reconstructs upstream thm:affine-span-list and thm:rank-flat-list at b13de811.

nodes.statement: For one fixed union U of R+nu RS parity-check columns and t<R, transverse syndrome-line slopes with t-sparse lifts number at most floor(C(R+nu,nu+1)/(R-t)); at nu=1 this is floor(R(R+1)/(2(R-t))). In one fixed syndrome fiber, if h=R+nu-t and h^2>(R+nu)(nu-1), the t-sparse lifts number at most floor((R+nu)(h-nu+1)/(h^2-(R+nu)(nu-1))). This independently reconstructs the three fixed-union theorems at b13de811 and makes no all-chart claim.

nodes.statement: For d>=3, four distinct codewords of RS[F,D,2d], |D|=4d, all agreeing with one received word on at least 3d-1 coordinates are affinely independent. nodes.statement: For every admissible official rate-1/2 row, with B*=floor(|F|/2^128) and ordinary worst-list size L_1(a), find a_L(C) such that L_1(a_L(C)) <= B* < L_1(a_L(C)-1). nodes.title: Exact-integer Johnson safe anchor for rate-half ordinary lists
nodes.statement: For any Reed-Solomon code, B>=1, and agreement a, put ell=B+1 and ell*a=nd+r with 0<=r<n. nodes.title: Exact rate-half ordinary-list crossing at budgets one and two
nodes.statement: For every multiplicative-coset RS row with n=4d and k=2d, the ordinary worst-list crossing is exactly a_L=3n/4 for integer budgets B=1 and B=2: the exact-integer Johnson theorem proves L_1(3n/4)<=B, while explicit two- and three-codeword received-word constructions prove B<L_1(3n/4-1). nodes.title: C36' admits a 145/4 shifted-energy close after identity separation
nodes.statement: For A=(1-H)\{0}, product and quotient multiplicities have equal L2 energy E_x(A), and N_3to1=sum_t P(t)R(t)=E_x(A)-(1/2)sum_t(P(t)-R(t))^2. nodes.statement: For S=H-1 and A=S\{0}, E_x(S)=E_x(A)+(2n-1)^2 exactly. Hence the full-shift estimate E_x(H-1)<=(145/4)(n-1)^2+(2n-1)^2 implies C36' on every official order. In centered-source form it is enough to bound E_x(H-1)-n^4/p by (145/4)(n-1)^2+(2n-1)^2-n^4/p, an allowance strictly greater than 39.24n^2 because every official prime has p>n^2. This corrects the zero convention in the literature audit but does not prove the energy estimate or promote C36'.

nodes.title: A cubic quotient-block tail alone cannot pay C36' energy
nodes.statement: For every official order n=2^s with 22<=s<=41, an explicit abstract quotient-block profile satisfies the exact mass sum_B m_B(m_B-1)=(n-1)(n-2) and the cubic tail #{B:m_B>=tau}<=4n^2/tau^3, yet its induced clean energy (n-1)^2+sum_B m_B(m_B-1)^2 exceeds (145/4)(n-1)^2. Hence those two marginal inputs alone cannot prove the clean C36' energy premise. The profiles are not asserted to be subgroup-realizable; this is a route fence, not a counterexample to C36'.

nodes.title: Every official nonidentity shifted-product fiber is below 33 n^(2/3)
nodes.statement: For every prime-field C36 row n=2^s, 13<=s<=41, p=1 mod n, p>=n^2, and every tau in F_p^*\{1}, the shifted-product fiber P(tau)=#{(a,b) in ((1-H)\{0})^2:ab=tau} satisfies P(tau)<33n^(2/3). The proof applies the constants-explicit Konyagin--Shparlinski--Vyugin auxiliary construction after the subgroup-preserving bijection (x,y)->(U,V)=(x,x/y), which gives the irreducible bidegree-(2,1) curve U^2-UV-U+(1-tau)V with a two-term lowest homogeneous part. All finite parameter inequalities and floor repairs are proved on the 29 official orders. This is a marginal bound only and does not prove the weighted C36' correlation.

nodes.title: C36 rich overlap is supported on one explicit derivative-ideal integer per order
nodes.statement: For every dyadic order n>=4 there is an explicit positive odd integer e_n, defined as the degree-root of the Galois-invariant norm of the first-nineteen-derivative ideals of the ordered shifted-product polynomial, such that every prime p=1 mod n satisfies p^X_18 | e_n. Hence X_18=0 for every row prime p not dividing e_n, while 17 log(e_n)<=300n^2 log(p) implies the exact C36 target. The proof retains the quotient weight by evaluating once for every ordered nonidentity quotient lift. It does not bound or factor e_n, so the universal critical leaf remains open.

nodes.title: C36' cutoff-18 double-accident reduction
nodes.statement: With Q_18(t)=(P(t)-18)_+, split X_18=sum_(t!=1)Q_18(t)R(t)=A_18+Y_18, where A_18=sum_(t!=1,R(t)>0)Q_18(t)<=(n-1)^2 and Y_18=sum_(t!=1)Q_18(t)(R(t)-1)_+. Therefore the exact residual estimate 17Y_18<=283n^2+34n-17, or the stronger Y_18<=16n^2, implies the C36' target. Every positive Y_18 record is both a rich product event and an additional quotient-collision event.

nodes.title: Joint derivative ideal detects exactly the C36' double-accident primes
nodes.statement: For each of the 29 official dyadic orders, quotient separation unit-normalizes the cutoff-18 product derivative ideal on every R=1 fiber using exponent B_n=min(n-19,ceil(33n^(2/3))-19). The resulting odd integer f_n divides gcd(e_n,h_n^B_n), where h_n is the odd quotient-discriminant integer, and satisfies p^Y_18|f_n and p|f_n iff Y_18>0 for every official row prime. Thus primes outside f_n close C36', while the global discriminant-height envelope is quantitatively insufficient and a residual-size or target-local valuation bound remains open.

nodes.title: Budget-three rate-half list intersection reduction
nodes.statement: Any four distinct codewords listed at agreement 3n/4-1 in a rate-half RS code have, up to codeword relabeling, one of six incidence types and give a pairwise-distinct kernel vector of an explicit 4-wise RS intersection matrix with 3k columns. Full column rank on those six fixed-subgroup types would prove predecessor safety. An exact RS[F_17,mu_8,4] rank-11/12 witness realizes one type, so pairwise MDS and Johnson arithmetic alone cannot close B*=3. No official crossing is claimed.

nodes.title: Budget-three Plucker edge gate
nodes.statement: Every B*=3 split-pencil witness has degree-at-most-two edge factors satisfying b_01 b_23-b_02 b_13+b_03 b_12=0. This degree-at-most-four identity is independent of the large block locators. It gives an explicit rank-two rational parameterization of all four block locators from two generators and an exact two-generator factorization R A_0 A_1 N_2 N_3=b_01^2 Lambda_D with deg R<=8. The bounded gate is proved but not classified.

nodes.title: Budget-three path Mobius transversal
nodes.statement: Every path-plus-singleton B*=3 split pencil is a coupled pair of constant pencils with injective Mobius-transversal complements. The degree-d pencil has exactly three fully domain-split members for d>=3, and the degree-(d-1) pencil has exactly three for d>=6. The order-eight singular witness is the sharp d=2 four-member exception. A separate d=4 power-of-two witness shows that exact-three does not exclude the path; existence on official rows remains open.

nodes.title: Budget-three split-fiber atlas
nodes.statement: Every B*=3 split-pencil witness lies in one of thirteen exact edge-degree chambers; the pendant type has at least one genuinely quadratic edge. Five of the six incidence types contain an explicit total of thirteen three-member constant split pencils. Each degree-d pencil uses three of at most four fully subgroup-split members, as does each degree-(d-1) pencil for d>=6. The cycle is the unique type with no deficit-free split pencil. nodes.title: Budget-three split-pencil normal form

The six incidence types give an exact degree ledger with deg b_ij<=2 and only three possible quadratic slots. The block, edge, singleton, and full locators factor the multiplicative-coset vanishing polynomial and obey an exact pair-locator product identity. This reduces B*=3 to a base-field-normalized split-pencil classification but does not exclude or construct such a pencil.

nodes.title: Exact all-arity rate-half list crossing at budgets one and two

nodes.statement: Every B*=3 4-cycle witness defines a rational map A_1/A_0 with complete fibers on T_0,T_1 and injective Mobius graph fibers on T_2,T_3. The Plucker identity gives their exact graph difference. Together with the path theorem, all thirteen deficit-free pencils have exactly their three displayed fully domain-split members at official scale; the dense K_4-e and K_4 base pencils have exactly two. nodes.statement: In the all-linear K_4 chamber, the Plucker edge bivector is a projective line on Gr(2,4). The four degree-(d-2) block locators consequently satisfy one nondegenerate base-field constant relation with all coefficients nonzero, and their product misses the subgroup polynomial by exactly eight roots. The resulting four-term split-unit equation remains open.

nodes.statement: Exactly nine of the thirteen B*=3 edge-degree chambers are projective lines on Gr(2,4), giving nondegenerate base-field split-unit relations among the large locators with exact exceptional degrees 3,4,5,6,8. Rank-deficient scrolls give nondegenerate base-field split-unit relations; every full-rank scroll is transformed by one constant base-field matrix to the module (alpha,Xalpha,beta,Xbeta). nodes.title: Strict A=3 slope-slack rational-normal ledger
nodes.statement: At the official strict budget B=2^39, every live A=3 moving-kernel branch with m=2^37 and m<=e<=floor((4m-1)/3) has a primitive apolar generator whose e+1 parameter coefficient forms are independent. Its projective kernel family is a degree-e rational normal curve of exact separation rank e+1. If T supported slopes violate the desired T<=4m cap and h=4e+1-T, then 0<=h<=4(e-m). The exact root-incidence matrix has rank e+1, product-code weight T(N-rho)+O=N(T-e)+C, capacity deficit C=4e-rho+h*rho+O<=e+h*rho, at least max(0,N-e-h*rho) saturated domain rows, and at least T-(rho-3e) completely split generic columns. On h=0, the complete domain norm has a residual factor of degree at most e, at least N-e rows admit an exact complementary factorization, and every geometric component bidegree lies in a unique necessary arithmetic chamber. The former endpoint is exactly e=m,h=0. No residual stratum is excluded.

nodes.title: Half-distance A=3 slope-slack rational-normal ledger
nodes.statement: At the half-distance budget B=2^39+1, every live A=3 moving-kernel branch with m=2^37 and m+1<=e<=floor((4m-1)/3) has a primitive apolar generator whose e+1 parameter coefficients are independent. The transposed Hankel pencil gives a degree-e rational normal kernel curve of exact separation rank e+1. If T violates the target T<=4m+1 and h=4e+1-T, then 0<=h<=4(e-m)-1. The root-incidence matrix has exact rank and product-code weight, capacity deficit at most e+h(4m-1), at least max(0,16m-e-h(4m-1)) saturated rows, and at least T-(4m-1-3e) completely split generic columns. On h=0, the norm residual has degree at most e, complementary factors exist over at least 16m-e rows, and component bidegrees lie in unique necessary chambers. At e=m+1 only h=0,1,2,3 remain, all with at least 3m+2 saturated rows. The A=1 profile is not covered.

nodes.title: Half-distance A=1 core-stratified slope-slack ledger
nodes.statement: At the half-distance budget B=2^39+1, every live A=1 branch has fixed core s in {0,1,2}. After stripping that core, its degree-d residual apolar generator has exact separation rank e+1 and traces a rational normal curve. Euclidean division of the contracted root budget gives an exact core-dependent cap T_max and remainder eta. Every failure of T<=2^39+1 has slack ell=T_max-T, capacity C=ell*d+eta-Delta+O<=ell*d+eta, at least max(0,N-s-ell*d-eta) saturated residual rows, at least T-Delta completely split clean columns, and a residual evaluation matrix of exact rank e+1 and exact product-code weight. On ell=0, the residual norm has degree at most eta, complementary factors exist on all but eta rows, and component bidegrees occupy chambers of width less than two, with uniqueness for s=1,2. At e=2^37+1 the three cores leave only 3+4+4 slack strata, all with positive saturation. No stratum is excluded.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one maximal-degree component localization
nodes.statement: On the half-distance A=1 sharp-cap face with fixed core s=1 and maximal degree e=2m-1, the residual generator has one unique component of bidegree (2e_*+1,e_*); every other component has bidegree (2e_i,e_i). The residual parameter degree b consumes five units of the exact column-defect budget per degree, so b<=floor(e/5). Maximal separation rank of the full residual generator forces sr(Q_*)>=ceil((e+1)/(b+1)), which is at least five at the official row. Thus separated pullbacks and every rank-at-most-four dominant model are excluded. The generator is geometrically squarefree and all components split disjointly on at least 8m-4 supported slopes and 14m residual domain rows. The rank-at-least-five dominant component remains open.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one middle-Hankel adjugate factorization
nodes.statement: On the half-distance A=1 core-one maximal-degree face, contraction produces a square symmetric middle-Hankel pencil M of size d+1 and generic rank d. If q is the primitive degree-e residual apolar coefficient vector, then adj(M)=lambda*q*q^T for one nonzero linear form lambda. The gcd of every nonzero maximal minor is exactly lambda, which is the unique size-one regular Kronecker block. The pencil has rank d away from its one projective root and rank d-1 there. All residual root omission is concentrated at that slope; on sharp cap O is 0 or 1 and the norm residual degree is e-1+O. This is an exact coefficient-chain interface, not a stratum exclusion.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one componentwise norm localization
nodes.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, every component omission and component intersection is confined to the unique middle-Hankel regular slope. At most one component has one omitted root. If b is total residual parameter degree, the dominant component has exact column deficit C_*=e-5b-1+D_* and every residual component has C_i=5e_i+D_i. Each component satisfies its own exact norm identity J_i R_i=P^r_i S_i and complementary factorization. The dominant norm residual has degree e-5b-1+D_* and splits on at least 14m+5b residual domain rows. Together with separation rank at least five, this is the exact remaining mixed norm object; it is not excluded.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one two-sided complement weld
nodes.statement: For the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree dominant component, interpolate both the domain-saturated complement QV+P_XW=P and the slope-clean complement QA+P_clB=G_X. Eliminating their shared clean-slope product gives WB-B_XE_Z=QK and VB+AE_Z=-P_XK, where deg_X K<=D_0-1 and deg_parameter K<=T-1. The separated opposing factor B_X(X)E_Z(U,V) has bidegree at most (e-5b-1+D_*,1). This is an exact two-sided matrix-factorization normal form for the remaining mixed component, not a stratum exclusion.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one zero-weld quartic boundary
nodes.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree face, the two-sided weld can have K=0 only when b=0 and D_*=1. In that sole branch the full residual generator is irreducible and factors a separated difference F(U,V)-G_0(X)=Q_*V_0, where deg F=4e, deg G_0=8e+4, G_0 is supported on all but exactly three residual-domain points, deg Q_*=(2e+1,e), and deg V_0=(6e+3,3e). Thus Q_* is a one-quarter bidegree factor of a quartic separated boundary. Every other residual profile, D_*=0 profile, and exceptional-factor allocation has K nonzero. The quartic boundary and nonzero-K branch remain open.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one zero-weld exclusion
nodes.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, the sole possible K=0 profile would have b=0,D_*=1,C_*=e and F(U,V)-G_0(X)=Q_*V_0, with G_0 omitting exactly three residual-domain points. At a G_0 root, Q_* divides the squarefree clean-slope product F and is saturated. At each omitted point it has no clean-slope root and at most the one exceptional root, so the three points contribute at least 3(e-1)>e to C_*, contradicting C_*=e. Hence K is nonzero on every profile of this face; the nonzero-weld branch remains open.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one nonzero-weld trace descent
nodes.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, every nonsaturated-domain trace of the nonzero weld has an exact gcd factorization K_x=-H_xJ_x whose complementary Q-degree is delta_x+epsilon_x; the deficits sum to C_*. If D_*=1, the exceptional-slope trace has a saturated gcd of degree at least e+3b and complementary quotient degree at most c+1. Exhaustively, either one of these traces is active, or B_XE_Z divides K and factor allocation reduces the weld to W_1B_1-1=QK_1 with nonzero K_1 in a smaller degree box. Neither branch is excluded.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one trace-free allocation rigidity
nodes.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, the dominant norm residual is exactly the product of the local bad-row quotients N_x of degrees delta_x. In the trace-free nonzero-weld branch, every bad domain factor divides both A and B; the apparent W-allocation would force Qhat_x to divide E_Z, which also forces epsilon_x=1 and the contradictory degree deg Qhat_x=delta_x+1>=2. The exceptional factor has two exact allocations; in its B-allocation Q(gamma_0;X) is a squarefree degree-(r-1) divisor of G_X. After the forced allocations, both complements and the unit-product weld reduce to the exact square (TFA7). The reduced square and active traces remain open.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one trace-free weld exclusion
nodes.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, the trace-free nonzero-weld branch is impossible. The exceptional Z_W allocation contradicts the positive gcd of Q(gamma_0;X) and P_X. The remaining reduced square makes every supported Q_gamma divide P_X, so every bad row has full deficit e_* and C_*=ce_*. Capacity forces b=0,D_*=1,c=1. At that profile the exceptional fiber has degree r-1, requiring deg_X A_1(gamma_0)=D_0-r, while B_X|A and deg_X A=D_0-r permit only D_0-r-1. Hence every surviving profile has an active defect trace of K.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one active-trace core reduction
nodes.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, cancel all bad-domain factors with zero K trace from A,B,K and allocate any zero exceptional trace, obtaining the exact active-core system QV_a+P_XW_a=P_clZ_BE_a, QA_a+P_clZ_BB_a=P_XX_1, W_aB_a-X_1E_a=QK_a. Every factor of X_1 and, when present, E_a is active. Capacity proves that every bad-domain trace is active except in two b=0,D_*=1 boundary profiles: c=1 with exceptional-only activity, or c=2 with one active domain row of deficit one.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one exceptional-trace allocation
nodes.statement: Every official active core has the full first complement QV_a+P_XW_a=P. If D_*=1 and the exceptional trace is zero, the Z_W=E_Z allocation contradicts the positive gcd of Q(gamma_0;X) and P_X; necessarily E_Z divides B, every domain trace is active, and Q(gamma_0;X) is a squarefree degree-(r-1) divisor of G_X. Thus the active branch consists of exactly the three systems in (ETA4): no exceptional factor, active exceptional trace, or zero exceptional trace with all domain traces active.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one exceptional-trace nonvanishing
nodes.statement: On every official D_*=1 active core, the exceptional K trace is nonzero. A zero exceptional trace would force every domain trace active, Q(gamma_0;X) squarefree of degree r-1, and Q(gamma_0;X)A_a(gamma_0;X)=G_X. This requires X-degree D_0-r+1 in A_a, while X_0=1 and the original complement permit only D_0-r. Hence the zero-exceptional third system (ETA4) is empty, leaving only the D_*=0 and active-exceptional D_*=1 systems.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one active-core two-sided partition
nodes.statement: In either remaining official active system, every clean slope gives a squarefree complementary partition Q_gamma A_gamma=G_X/X_0 of exact degrees (r,D_0-z-r), and every saturated domain row gives a squarefree complementary partition Q_xV_x=P of exact degrees (e_*,T-e_*). Both quotients attain their global degree bounds. The active bad-row clean incidences have exact total c e_*-C_*-E_bad, with the explicit D_*=0 and D_*=1 formulas (ATP8). This is the current degree-tight two-sided divisor-partition interface, not a classification.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one active-partition incidence reconstruction
nodes.statement: For either live active system, the saturated-row by clean-slope nonincidence graph is connected with both same-side pairs sharing a neighbor. Monic locator ratios factor into unique row/column potentials and satisfy every alternating-cycle identity. Conversely, incidence consistency, those cycle identities, and coefficientwise membership of the scaled clean locators in RS[Z_cl,e_*+1] are necessary and sufficient to reconstruct the unique compatible biform up to scalar; all saturated fibers then follow automatically. The clean-locator, saturated-locator, and core value matrices have exact rank sr(Q), at least five and exactly e+1 when b=0. This is exact classification preprocessing, not a Hankel or irreducibility test.

nodes.title: XR uniform higher-rank selectors reduce to bounded split-pencil trades
nodes.statement: For every high-core selector rank s=a+1 in the uniform flat-nullity cell u=v=0, tangent genericity gives a coherent GRS_a split pencil on N=R+a coordinates with block size a+h and pair cap a. Any over-budget family contains a minimal Maxwell core hL=2v-2a+e, 0<=e<=h-1, whose parity stack has an extra right-kernel class and at least e+1 dual-product-code trade relations. Active block rows have weight at least a+1 and active coordinates degree at least three. Trade rank one is impossible; trade rank two has 4<=t<=a+2, active union a+2<=rho<=2a, and a polynomial-pencil model of degree at most a-1. This is the arbitrary-rank uniform-cell structural compiler, not an aggregate slope payment.

nodes.title: XR minimum rank-two trades are face syzygies or near-tangent cores
nodes.statement: In an arbitrary-rank uniform XR split pencil, every rank-two trade on its minimum active union |X|=a+2 has facet supports X\{x_i}. The order-a facet divided differences of U and q are affine in x_i. Distinct slopes force an exact dichotomy: either all selected denominators are nonzero and the relation space is the dimension-(t-3) Plucker kernel of (1;x_i;gamma_i;x_i gamma_i), or both facet forms vanish identically and the received directions share a k+2 agreement core. A partially singular pattern is impossible. After quotienting regular face syzygies, rank-two residue has union at least a+3 or the explicit near-tangent defect h-2.

nodes.title: Known budget-three path pattern is characteristic-17 isolated
nodes.statement: For the fixed exponent-support pattern of the known order-sixteen path witness, a 24 by 24 intersection-matrix minor has determinant alpha with absolute cyclotomic norm 2^170*17^4. Hence the pattern has full column rank in every odd characteristic except possibly 17. The known F_17 realization has rank 23, while characteristic 17 cannot support an order-2^41 domain below the official field cap. Thus this explicit finite witness cannot transport to the prize-max budget-three row with its exponent supports unchanged; no other path assignment or chamber is excluded.

nodes.title: Budget-three equal-multifiber quotient constructions are Vandermonde-excluded
nodes.statement: If B_i is a union of s full fibers of one monomial map X^m and A_i=B_i/(X-r_i) deletes one distinct root, then the top m coefficients of A_i are the geometric vector (1,r_i,...,r_i^(m-1)). Any t<=m such locators are Vandermonde-independent. Hence all four cycle chambers are incompatible with direct equal-multifiber quotient completions for m>=4, and both path chambers are incompatible for m>=3. At d=2^39 this excludes every power-of-two quotient-fiber size m>=4 in those six chambers; small-fiber, mixed-map, partial-fiber, primitive, and the other seven chamber residuals remain open.

nodes.title: Budget-three multideletion equal-multifiber constructions are excluded
nodes.statement: Let equal-size completed blocks be unions of fibers of one X^m map, and delete pairwise-disjoint nonzero root sets R_i of sizes ell_i. The reversed top coefficients of the resulting locators are z^(ell_i-ell_0)/product_(r in R_i)(1-rz). These rational functions are independent when m>sum ell_i-ell_0. The five linear chamber profiles give thresholds 4,3,6,7,5; hence power-of-two fiber size m>=8 is excluded across all nine linear B*=3 chambers. Cycle/path already exclude m>=4. Small-fiber, mixed-map, partial-fiber, primitive, and quadratic-scroll residuals remain open.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-four constructions pass through a rank-two gate
nodes.statement: For direct equal-complete fibers of size four, multiplication by the deleted-root product gives a 4 by 4 residue matrix over F(X^4). Rank four forbids a constant locator relation, while rank three forces the huge equal-degree completed blocks to share a factor, contradicting pairwise-coprime block locators. Linear K_4-e and triangle-plus-singleton have rank at least three and are excluded. Linear K_4 survives only on the exact rank-two reciprocal-quadratic locus, which contains the antipodal deleted-pair component.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-four antipodal branch descends to a quotient pencil
nodes.statement: On the antipodal rank-two component P_i=X^2-a_i, direct fiber-four linear K_4 data descend through Y=X^4 to four pairwise-coprime monic degree-s-1 polynomials G_i in one two-dimensional base-field pencil. They satisfy product G_i=(Y^d-1)/product_i(Y-a_i^2). At the prize maximum this is an exact degree-2^37-1 split-pencil census on the order-2^39 quotient subgroup.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal quotient pencil has a Möbius weld
nodes.statement: In the antipodal fiber-four quotient descent, the two locator relations force the four pencil parameters to be one fractional-linear image of the four deleted-pair parameters a_i. After an invertible base-field pencil change, the residual is the quartic norm equation product_i(R+a_i S)=kappa (Y^d-1)/product_i(Y-a_i^2), with deg R,deg S at most d/4-1.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal quotient pencil is primitive
nodes.statement: The Mobius-welded antipodal map has exact odd degree d/4-1, so it cannot factor through a nontrivial cyclic or dihedral quotient of the dyadic subgroup. The direct index-four coset partition is also impossible: one deletion per coset gives four geometric-series factors with Vandermonde rank four, contradicting the rank-two pencil. The remaining quartic norm residual is primitive and nonperiodic.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal quotient pencil has a half-degree floor
nodes.statement: In the antipodal quotient descent, let V span the unique degree-drop direction of the two-dimensional monic pencil and put r=d/4-1. Centering the four pencil parameters and reversing the quartic product identity at infinity proves deg V>=ceil((r-4)/2) whenever the characteristic exceeds d, improved to ceil((2r-4)/3) when the centered coefficient e_2 vanishes. On the maximal official row these are 2^36-2 and (2^38-4)/3 respectively.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal pure quartic has exact degree drop one
nodes.statement: In the centered antipodal quotient pencil, if the outer parameter quartic has e_2=e_3=0, the second-derivative Wronskian proves deg V=r-1 and factors exactly as Y^(d-2)U^2V^2 times a nonzero linear polynomial. Both U,V are squarefree, and at most one root of UV lies in the deleted divisor or at zero. On the maximal official row deg V=2^37-2.

nodes.title: H3 low-distance two-generator ideal-star router
nodes.statement: Every cutoff-18 rich shifted-product fiber contains a rooted pair of low-distance collisions with one common center among coefficient vectors of squared norm at most three. The row prime divides the norm of their normalized two-generator ideal, which divides the gcd of the two normalized principal norms. This strictly sharpens the fixed-order candidate union from single collision norms to ideal-star norms.

nodes.title: H3 ideal-star prime-alignment criterion
nodes.statement: For p=1 mod n, divisibility of a normalized rooted ideal-star norm by p is equivalent to simultaneous collision at one degree-one prime above p. Odd Galois dilation makes one fixed primitive root sufficient for screening the complete admissible-star union.

nodes.title: H3 distance-two collisions are 2-primary
nodes.statement: A nonzero dyadic shifted-product collision whose half-basis vector has squared norm two is a cyclotomic binomial with 2-power rational norm. It cannot vanish at an odd row prime. Removing distance two strengthens the seven-vector rich-fiber packing count from four to at least six distance-at-most-six edges.

nodes.title: H3 distance-four cross-overlap router
nodes.statement: Every distance-four edge among the seven selected same-fiber representations lies in one of two exact two-variable lanes. The antipodal lane is x^2=u+v-uv. The generic cross signed-monomial lane reduces to uv=-y and ux(1-y)=u^2-y.

nodes.title: H3 weighted low-distance multistar router
nodes.statement: Every cutoff-18 rich shifted-product fiber contains a center whose incident distance-four/six deficit weight is at least four. The row prime divides the norm of the resulting normalized two-to-four-generator ideal, and one fixed primitive root gives an exact weighted-degree candidate sieve.

nodes.title: H3 rich-excess multistar degree ladder
nodes.statement: If e=P(t)-18 is positive, the rich product fiber contains at least 7+ceil(e/2) squared-norm-at-most-three representations. Their distance-four/six weighted graph has a center of incident weight L(7+ceil(e/2)); only the boundary profiles (P,D)=(19,1),(20,2) can avoid weight six.

nodes.title: H3 excess-budget versus multistar-degree tradeoff
nodes.statement: For every cutoff 0<=E<=17, quotient mass pays the product-excess range e<=E and reduces C36' to the exact high-tail budget 17X_18^{>E}<=300n^2-17E(n-1)(n-2). The retained targets have explicit multistar degree L(7+ceil((E+1)/2)); the Pareto cutoffs are E=0,2,6,10,14.

nodes.title: H3 high-excess low-distance moment reduction
nodes.statement: On the selected P(t)>=33 tail, the product excess P(t)-18 is at most 16/83 times the full distance-four/six centroid weight W(t)=2N_4(t)+N_6(t). Hence the exact weighted edge-quotient moment bound 272M_33<=83(300n^2-238(n-1)(n-2)) implies C36'.

nodes.title: H3 low-distance edge-quotient incidence router
nodes.statement: The selected moment M_33 is exactly 2|I_4|+|I_6| for a canonically oriented four-variable/two-subgroup-membership rational system. The distance-four cross-overlap and antipodal lanes each reduce further to a three-variable/two-membership cover.

nodes.title: H3 distance-four fiber-degree cap
nodes.statement: Within one small-vector product fiber, generic vectors have norm three and the unique possible antipodal vector has norm one. Orient one valid cross-overlap per generic distance-four edge; each head determines its tail uniquely, so N_4(t)<=g+ag, hence N_4(t)<=2(m-1) for nonempty fibers, and antipodal-free fibers satisfy N_4(t)<=m.

nodes.title: H3 high-excess distance-six moment reduction
nodes.statement: On P(t)>=33, combining the oriented fiberwise distance-four cap with the norm-one antipodal centroid saving gives P(t)-18<=(8/21)N_6(t). Therefore 136 sum N_6(t)R(t)<=21(300n^2-238(n-1)(n-2)) implies C36'.

nodes.title: H3 selected distance-six moment splits at the antipodal target class
nodes.statement: On the selected P>=33 tail, antipodal-free fibers satisfy P(t)-18<=(16/53)N_6(t), while antipodal targets satisfy the uniform 8/21 ratio and their edge-quotient records form an exact four-variable/three-membership incidence through t=1-x^2. Hence 136(42M_6,33^0+53M_6,33^A)<=1113B_(n,14) implies C36'. Exact analytic Pareto alternatives are also proved at E=6 (P>=25) and E=10 (P>=29).

nodes.title: H3 distance-six support-overlap payment
nodes.statement: Every support-overlapping generic distance-six edge lies in one of two cubic one-parameter covers, giving at most six such edges per product target; an antipodal target has at most two additional distance-six edges. Exact quotient mass pays these strata, so C36' follows from the disjoint-support E=6 estimate D_6,25^0+(17/10)D_6,25^A<=(223/20)n^2.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal reverse-residual stratification
nodes.statement: If q is the first nonzero centered outer coefficient of an antipodal quotient pencil and h=deg U-deg V, then the differential residual T=dDU-Y(D'U+4DU') is nonzero of exact degree deg U+4-qh. It contains every repeated, deleted-divisor, or zero root of U. On the two lowest official maximal-row strata T is respectively linear and quadratic.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal fourth-root gap reduction
nodes.statement: If the antipodal differential residual has degree at most three, the monic direction U is uniquely the reversed degree-r truncation of E(z)^(-1/4), where E=z^4D(z^-1). Exact norm contact becomes an exact gap in the first omitted coefficients. The official generic boundary requires two consecutive zero coefficients and the intermediate boundary requires one.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic secondary-gap reduction
nodes.statement: On the maximal official generic floor, after the monic direction U is fixed by the fourth-root truncation, the normalized reverse of V is fixed modulo z^h by a square-root series determined by the deleted divisor. Since deg V=h-3, its coefficients at h-2=2^36-1 and h-1=2^36 must both vanish.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic two-window square reduction
nodes.statement: After the generic primary gap, the normalized secondary square is exactly the product of two length-h windows of the fourth-root coefficient sequence modulo z^h. The secondary gap is equivalent to one truncated square congruence, and the shifted tail obeys a first-order differential equation with linear forcing.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic deleted-pair parity reduction
nodes.statement: When the four deleted roots on the maximal generic boundary form two antipodal pairs, parity makes one primary and one secondary gap automatic. After common scaling, the remaining simultaneous gate is two exact univariate equations in one nontrivial (d/2)-torsion ratio.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic deleted-pair even factorization
nodes.statement: A deleted-antipodal-pair candidate passing the complete generic canonical criterion has zero odd outer coefficient and factors the punctured 8M-torsion binomial into two coprime degree-(4M-1) square-pencil factors.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic deleted-pair Fourier-resultant branch collapse
nodes.statement: The flat signed root coloring and its primitive cyclotomic resultant exclude complete deleted-pair survivors in the official prime-field and nonsplit quadratic maximal-row branches. Only the split quadratic branch remains for this sublocus.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic deleted-pair constant ODE
nodes.statement: A complete deleted-pair survivor descends to a half-degree square pencil whose odd generic direction is the unique monic polynomial solution, when one exists, of an exact constant-forcing first-order ODE. Its forced simple zero is the sole exceptional root allowed by the linear residual.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic deleted-pair Möbius ratio router
nodes.statement: In the remaining split quadratic deleted-pair branch, the Möbius matching is equivalent to three explicit reciprocal equations relating the single lift ratio to the outer square ratio, which is itself N-torsion. Thus each lift ratio permits at most three unordered outer ratios.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic deleted-pair remainder-square router
nodes.statement: After the constant ODE and three-branch Möbius torsion router, Euclidean division gives an exact necessary-and-sufficient square test for the missing direction. The harmonic branch is one fourth-power test, and no polynomial coefficient remains free.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic deleted-pair harmonic exclusion
nodes.statement: The harmonic outer ratio q=-1 is impossible throughout the exact official maximal-row split-quadratic characteristic interval. Every remaining deleted-pair candidate is nonharmonic.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic deleted-pair nonharmonic scalar router
nodes.statement: After harmonic exclusion, the Mobius and Euclidean remainder equations eliminate the outer ratio. Each of three branches is exactly one polynomial scalar identity in the lift ratio, one torsion trace, and one reciprocal-root-invariant square test.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic deleted-pair nonharmonic fourth-power router
nodes.statement: In the source trace coordinate, all three nonharmonic remainder multipliers are explicit rational squares. Conditional on the selected scalar identity, the final root-dependent square test is exactly the branch-independent assertion that the Euclidean remainder is a fourth power.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic deleted-pair fourth-root gcd gate
nodes.statement: The constant ODE gives an exact differential identity for the Euclidean residual. On any passing fourth-power branch, its degree-(M-1) fourth root divides one explicit ODE polynomial, forcing a half-degree gcd and a root-free divisibility gate.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic deleted-pair constant-coefficient gate
nodes.statement: The constant term of each nonharmonic scalar identity is one explicit equation in the deleted ratio, source trace, and one terminal coefficient of a reversed truncated quotient. It is an exact first rejection gate before the full remainder, gcd, or fourth-power tests.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal generic canonical-span criterion
nodes.statement: On the maximal generic floor, four deleted subgroup roots canonically determine both pencil directions and all centered outer coefficients. After the primary and secondary gaps, the full norm equation is equivalent to one exact two-dimensional polynomial span identity plus the split/Mobius matching of the resulting outer quartic.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal intermediate Hensel certifier
nodes.statement: On the maximal intermediate floor, normalized V is the unique formal solution of H=C^3(1+u z^h C/B). Its first forbidden coefficient gives the exact gate 3 kappa-u Delta=0: it uniquely fixes u when Delta is nonzero, rejects when Delta=0 and kappa is nonzero, and isolates one scalar only when both vanish.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal pure harmonic-Fermat router
nodes.statement: The maximal pure-quartic antipodal boundary forces the square-root lifts of its four deleted roots to form a non-antipodal harmonic quadruple. After normalization their fourth lift is one explicit rational function of two subgroup variables, while the polynomial content is exactly a coprime decomposition Q=B^4+Z^4 with printed endpoint orders and degrees.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one exceptional-only factor descent
nodes.statement: On the b=0, D_*=1, c=z=1 exceptional-only active profile, the full exceptional fiber lies in P_X. Cancelling its forced divisor from B modulo Q turns the active weld into the exact complement square QA_1+PB_1=P_X, WB_1-1=QK_1, VB_1+A_1=-P_XK_1. The correction raises deg_X A_1 from D_0-r-1 to exactly D_0-r, isolating the one-degree obstruction that prevents reuse of the trace-free exclusion.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one exceptional-only infinity-coefficient rigidity
nodes.statement: The exceptional-only corrected square saturates the opposite bidegree corners deg(A_1)=(D_0-r,T-1) and deg(B_1)=(D_0,e-1). Writing [X^r]Q=E q_bar, all leading coefficients of B_1,W,K_1 are forced by q_bar, the leading coefficient of J, and one optional leading coefficient of V. Truncating B_1 at the old X-degree D_0-1 loses every valid packet.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one exceptional-only two-sided resultant saturation
nodes.statement: The corrected exceptional-only system has four exact pure-power resultants. In the supported-slope direction Res(P,Q) is P_X^e and its A_1 complement is P_X^(T-e); in the saturated-row direction Res(P_X,Q) is P_cl^r E^(r-1) and its V complement has exponents n_X-r and n_X-r+1. The two normalization constants occur in inverse pairs, and no residual factor remains.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one exceptional-only unit-resultant collapse
nodes.statement: For the corrected exceptional-only unit pair, Res_X(Q,B_1)=c_X q_bar collapses to the degree-(e-1) cofactor of [X^r]Q=E q_bar. If m=deg_X W, then Res_X(Q,W)=c_X^(-1) E^(m+n_X+1)q_bar^(m+n_X).
