nodes.title: L1 fixed-support cross-determinant fiber bound
nodes.statement: For one source chart, defect degree, and exact petal-support pattern, exact saturated monic pairs inject by Phi(F,W)=(W_0F-WF_0)/product_i L_(S_i) into polynomials of degree at most r_cross=2d+v-t ell. Hence their total number, across all missing-equation syndromes, is at most q^max(0,r_cross+1). Every fixed (p,r_cross) box is polynomial per source chart after summing all defect degrees. Thus a bounded-polarity per-chart counterfamily must have unbounded cross slack inside the proved survivor width window; non-intrinsic first-match chart supply remains separate.

nodes.title: L1 fixed-support defect Johnson bound
nodes.statement: For one source chart and exact labelled petal support of size h, distinct exact saturated degree-d defect sets inside the (k-1)-point source core intersect in at most r_J=2d-h. Hence a negative-r_J cell is a singleton, while every cell with d^2>(k-1)r_J has size at most (k-1)(d-r_J)/(d^2-(k-1)r_J). All positive-denominator cells are polynomial per source chart at fixed petal polarity, with no field or syndrome factor. Thus a bounded-polarity counterfamily may be restricted to (k-1)(e-1)>=d^2; retaining the background gap g=ell-b further gives d^2<=(k-1)(d-g).

nodes.title: L1 bounded retained-core payment
nodes.statement: In one maximal-sunflower source chart, let a=(k-1)-d be the retained-core size and p the polarized petal entropy. Every fixed box a<=A,p<=P has at most (A+1)(P+1)n^(1/c_0+A+P) exact contributors: choose the retained a-subset of the fixed core, then the petal exceptions; h>d makes the numerator unique. Thus a bounded-polarity per-chart counterfamily in the sub-Johnson tail must have a unbounded, and its tail inequality is equivalently a((k-1)-a)>=(k-1)(ell-b).

nodes.title: L1 cross-quotient split-descent obstruction
nodes.statement: An exact F_23 maximal chart with ell=2, five two-point petals, one background point, fixed petal polarity p=5, and two saturated threshold contributors has cross quotient 16+9X+4X^2+15X^3=(X-13)(20+15X+15X^2). The quadratic discriminant 14 is nonsquare, so the quotient is not split. The cell has N=8,d=4,h=5 and N(2d-h)=24>=16=d^2, placing the obstruction in the live sub-Johnson tail. Cross-quotient injection therefore cannot be iterated as split-defect descent without an additional splitting theorem.

nodes.title: L1 fixed-support codeword quotient bound
nodes.statement: For one source chart and exact petal support X of size h, fix one compatible degree-at-most-(k-1) codeword P_0. Every other compatible codeword injects by (P-P_0)/L_X into polynomials of degree at most (k-1)-h, so the cell has size at most q^max(0,k-h). Every fixed (p,(k-1)-h) box is polynomial per source chart with bound (P+1)n^(1/c_0+P+gamma(E+1)). In sub-Johnson variables a=(k-1)-d and s=h-d, a bounded-polarity counterfamily must therefore have a-s=(k-1)-h unbounded. No splitting property of the quotient is asserted.

nodes.title: L1 background-overlap singleton payment
nodes.statement: Fix one source chart, defect degree d, and exact petal support of size h. Put N=k-1, a=N-d, s=h-d, and g=ell-b. Every compatible word has at least ell-s background agreements, so two words share at least ell-2s+g background points. Their degree-at-most-N difference already vanishes on the h petal points; hence the cell is a singleton whenever a+s<ell+g. At fixed petal polarity this whole region is polynomial per chart. Combining the strict complement with the sub-Johnson condition gives the exact survivor strip a^2/N<=c=N-h=a-s<=2a-ell-g. An exact F_17 ell=2 chart has two contributors at equality a+s=ell+g=3, so strictness is load-bearing.

nodes.title: L1 background-quotient Johnson bound
nodes.statement: For one source chart, defect degree, and exact h-point petal support X, put N=k-1, c=N-h, s=h-d, b=ell-g, and u=ell-s. Subtracting the degree-<h interpolant on X and dividing by L_X injects compatible codewords into degree-at-most-c polynomials on the b-point background that agree with one derived word in at least u positions. If u^2>bc, the Johnson bound gives at most b(u-c)/(u^2-bc)<=n^2 codewords, so all such cells are polynomial per chart at fixed petal polarity. The live balanced tail also satisfies (ell-a+c)^2<=(ell-g)c together with a^2/N<=c<=2a-ell-g. The exact F_17 equality cell (b,u,c)=(1,1,1) has two contributors, so strictness is load-bearing.

nodes.title: L1 joint core/background Johnson bound
nodes.statement: For one exact support cell, choose u=ell-(h-d) background agreements per contributor. The common-defect and common-background locators divide the same nonzero cross determinant, so |D_1 intersect D_2|+|R_1 intersect R_2|<=r=2d-h. A joint incidence second moment gives |Z|<=Nb ell/(bd^2+Nu^2-Nbr)<=n^3 whenever the denominator is positive. Thus fixed petal polarity is polynomial there. In tail variables a=N-d and c=N-h, every counterfamily satisfies b a^2+N(ell-a+c)^2<=Nbc. The exact F_17 chart attains the positive bound with two contributors; the exact F_23 nonsplit chart has two contributors at zero denominator, so strictness is load-bearing.

nodes.title: L1 joint-Johnson source-scale gate
nodes.statement: The nonpositive joint-Johnson region implies the variance constraint a(N-a)/N+u(b-u)/b>=ell when b>0; zero background gives the analogous core-only constraint. Hence every bounded-polarity live cell has N+b>=4ell and N>=3ell+1. In an official rate-1/r source, (r-1)k+1=Mell+b then forces M>=3(r-1), so all smaller source scales are polynomial per chart. The first live counts are M>=3,9,21,45 at rates 1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16. The arithmetic family ell=2r,b=2r-1,k=6r+2,M=3(r-1) attains N+b=4ell, so the source-scale constant is arithmetically sharp.

nodes.title: L1 joint Plotkin-boundary payment
nodes.statement: Encode each exact-support contributor by A=D disjoint_union R in the (N+b)-point core/background universe, where R is a canonical u-subset of its background agreements. The shared cross-determinant budget gives |A triangle A'|>=2ell. If N+b<=4ell, the sign-vector embeddings have pairwise nonpositive inner products, so the elementary Rankin bound gives at most 2(N+b)<=2n contributors. Thus fixed petal polarity is polynomial throughout the equality regime and every live cell satisfies N+b>4ell. For an official rate-1/r source this is equivalent to rb>(4(r-1)-M)ell+r, or (M-3(r-1)+1)ell>r(g+1).

nodes.title: L1 bounded Plotkin-excess payment
nodes.statement: Let E=N+b-4ell>=0 for the combined core/background constant-weight code. Partition contributors by their pattern on any E coordinates. Puncturing within one pattern class preserves distance and leaves length 4ell with distance at least 2ell, so Rankin gives at most 2(4ell) members per class and at most 2^(E+1)(N+b-E) contributors per exact support cell. Hence every fixed (petal polarity, Plotkin excess) box is polynomial per chart, and a counterfamily must have N+b-4ell unbounded. Officially, (r-1)E=(M-3(r-1)+1)ell-r(g+1).

nodes.title: L1 background-surplus Plotkin payment
nodes.statement: Stratify one exact support/defect cell by exact background agreement count u+z. Using every background agreement, the combined core/background sets have distance at least 2(ell+z). Thus the cell has at most 2^(E_z+1)n members for E_z=N+b-4(ell+z)>=0, and every fixed logarithmic effective-excess window E_z<=C log_2 n is polynomial per chart at fixed petal polarity. A counterfamily must have (E_P-4z)/log_2 n unbounded. Officially, (r-1)E_z=(M-3(r-1)+1)ell-r(g+1)-4(r-1)z. No background-subset factor is introduced because the exact set is determined by the numerator.

nodes.title: L1 marked constant-shift sub-two-ell exclusion
nodes.statement: For a common constant-shift pencil P-a_i with at least three marked petals, write P-a_i=S_iV_i, J=product_i V_i, and v=deg J. If S_i divides W-c_iF, gcd(F,W)=1, ell<deg F=d, and d+v<2ell, no such data exist. Multiplying by J restores full-petal congruences but gives gcd(JF,JW)=J; rank three would force a common divisor of degree d+v-ell>v, while rank at most two forces all c_i equal and again contradicts the exact gcd. Thus the bounded-p L1 branch is empty on this three-dense common-pencil marked strip, including whenever d+p<2ell.

nodes.title: L1 marked constant-shift multistrip exclusion
nodes.statement: For a common constant-shift pencil with t marked petals and total selected mark degree v, no exact saturated tuple exists in strip m when t>=2m+1, m ell<d, and d+v<(m+1)ell. After restoring full locators with J, row rank at least 2m+1 forces a common factor of degree d+v-m ell>v; lower rank gives at least two degree-m kernel pairs, whose cross products vanish at 2m+1 labels and force one primitive direction of degree at most m-1, again producing a common factor larger than J. Thus a bounded-p common-pencil residual has at most 2m selected dense petals unless its marked degree reaches the next strip boundary. The L1 threshold gives the matching survivor pin ceil((d-p+1)/ell)<=T_dense<=2m.

nodes.title: L1 marked constant-shift extremal kernel normal form
nodes.statement: At the upper survivor endpoint T=2m in marked degree strip m, exact saturation forces the 2m by 2(m+1) constant-shift coefficient matrix to have rank exactly 2m. Every kernel basis is a pair of degree-at-most-m polynomial columns with determinant kappa product_i(Z-a_i), and the enlarged numerator/denominator have a unique two-generator reconstruction whose coefficient gcd divides the mark locator J. The adjugate recovers both coefficients after multiplication by the complete quotient locator. Explicit saturated full-petal examples F=1+lambda X^cV(P), W=U(P) exist in every strip, so the 2m+1 exclusion threshold is sharp and the endpoint must be priced rather than excluded.

nodes.title: L1 marked constant-shift Forney-window normal form
nodes.statement: Every marked common constant-shift survivor with t<=2m in strip m has a reduced rank-two interpolation-module basis of Forney degrees mu<=nu<=m, mu+nu=t, and determinant kappa product_i(Z-a_i). Its degree-at-most-m coefficient kernel has exact dimension 2m-t+2 and full row rank t. The enlarged numerator/denominator have a unique reconstruction from those generators, with evaluated multiplier gcd dividing the mark locator J. Every admissible Forney pair is populated by an explicit saturated family F=1+lambda X^cR(P)V(P), W=U(P), so the finite strata must be priced or profile-owned rather than excluded.

nodes.title: L1 marked common-pencil CRT numerator-fiber bound
nodes.statement: Fix one bounded-polarity common-pencil chart, all supports and marks, and one exact defect locator F. CRT makes the numerator solutions one affine class modulo the product S of selected support locators. In strip m, every Forney-window cell with t>=m+1 has deg S>d and therefore at most one numerator. At the lower endpoint t=m, threshold arithmetic gives eta=d-m ell<=p-1 and affine freedom degree eta+v<=2p-1, hence at most q^(2p) numerators. For fixed p and generated q=poly(n), numerator multiplicity is polynomial uniformly in the strip; squarefree defect-locator counting is the only non-polynomial common-pencil issue left.

nodes.title: L1 marked common-pencil quotient-boundary router
nodes.statement: In a genuine quotient/coset common-pencil chart, every squarefree defect locator factors uniquely into a canonical partial-fiber boundary and a product of complete quotient-fiber locators P-a. Composing this factorization with the marked CRT theorem bounds every fixed-polarity, fixed-boundary cell by q^(2P_0) times a polynomial boundary factor times the actual full-fiber quotient-core census. Thus bounded boundary and numerator multiplicity cannot create a new super-polynomial factor; the residue is the source-coupled quotient-core census or unbounded partial-fiber boundary. No exact-periodic ownership or cross-chart first-match bound is inferred.

nodes.title: L1 quotient-chart bounded core-boundary closure
nodes.statement: At the L1 cutoff ell>=c_0 n/log_2 n with ell>2P_0, one genuine quotient/coset source chart has only M+N<=log_2(n)/c_0 total petal and core fibers. Dense/sparse orientation plus at most P_0 exceptional petal points counts all p<=P_0 supports; the quotient-boundary router counts every beta<=B_0 defect locator by at most 2^N(B_0+1)n^B_0; and the strict-window plus thin-edge CRT theorems contribute at most q^(2P_0) numerators throughout every degree strip. Hence the complete common-pencil box is at most (P_0+1)(B_0+1)n^(1/c_0+P_0+B_0+2 gamma P_0) per source chart when q<=n^gamma. Cross-chart aggregation, unbounded boundary, non-quotient cores, and arbitrary petal locators remain open.

nodes.title: L1 marked common-pencil next-strip boundary fiber bound
nodes.statement: On the thin boundary d+p>=(m+1)ell of strip m, put g=(m+1)ell-d. For fixed p<=P_0 and ell>2P_0, the exact list threshold forces at least m+1 dense petals. Their selected support product has degree t ell-v, so CRT leaves at most one numerator when v<g and at most q^(v-g+1)<=q^p otherwise. Thus the fixed-locator numerator fiber is polynomial uniformly on the boundary omitted by the strict Forney window.

nodes.title: L1 quotient-chart bipolar entropy closure
nodes.statement: In one genuine quotient/coset common-pencil chart, orient every petal support and every exact core defect fiber as sparse or dense. The exceptional point counts are exactly the petal polarity p_pet and symmetric core polarity p_core. At the L1 cutoff the M+N orientation bits cost only 2^(M+N)<=n^(1/c_0); bounded exceptional sets cost n^(P_0+B_0); and the whole-strip CRT bounds cost q^(2P_0). Thus every fixed bipolar box has at most (P_0+1)(B_0+1)n^(1/c_0+P_0+B_0+2 gamma P_0) contributors per source chart. Any super-polynomial fixed-chart family must have unbounded petal or symmetric core polarity; cross-chart and arbitrary-locator branches remain open.

nodes.title: L1 core bipolar signed-quotient normal form
nodes.statement: For a core partitioned into complete P-fibers, orient each exact defect fiber as dense or sparse, with ties sparse. The defect locator has a unique signed quotient presentation F_D L_H=L_S product_(a in A_+)(P-a), where H is the set of holes in dense fibers, S is the occupied set in sparse fibers, gcd(L_H,L_S)=1, and deg L_H+deg L_S equals the symmetric core polarity. The triple (A_+,H,S) reconstructs D exactly. This identifies growing core polarity with growing signed mark degree but supplies no periodic owner or count.

nodes.title: L1 intrinsic quotient source-chart census
nodes.statement: For a fixed received word and intrinsic complete-fiber partition, one source core/petal role assignment determines every source member uniquely: two degree-below-k polynomials agreeing on the (k-1)-point core plus one full petal coincide. Hence there are at most 3^(n/ell) canonical source charts per scale. At ell>=c_0 n/log_2 n this is at most n^(log_2(3)/c_0), and the logarithmically many dyadic intrinsic scales preserve polynomial first-match aggregation. Composed with the bipolar per-chart bound, every fixed polarity box is globally polynomial across intrinsic quotient charts. Partial cores, non-intrinsic quotient maps, and arbitrary petals remain open.

nodes.title: L1 intrinsic partial-core triple-polarity closure
nodes.statement: For an intrinsic quotient partition, allow an arbitrary (k-1)-point source core and measure three symmetric exception counts: layout polarity of the core against complete fibers, exact-defect polarity inside each core slice, and petal-support polarity. Four orientation vectors over L=n/ell fibers, bounded exception sets, source-member uniqueness, and the whole-strip CRT bounds give at most (log_2 n+1)(R_0+1)(B_0+1)(P_0+1)n^(4/c_0+R_0+B_0+P_0+2 gamma P_0) contributors across all intrinsic scales. Thus every fixed triple-polarity box is globally polynomial even with partial cores; non-intrinsic quotient maps and arbitrary petals remain open.

nodes.title: DSP8 disjoint distance-six multiplicity gate
nodes.statement: After the proved distance-four and support-overlap deletions, every P>=25 target retains at least 11 disjoint distance-six edges in the antipodal-free class and at least two in the antipodal class. This forces respectively a same-target two-leaf star ideal and a same-target two-edge ideal; on P>=33 the two classes force pure disjoint-distance-six stars of degrees seven and five.

nodes.title: DSP8 excess quotient-depth compiler
nodes.statement: Paying L quotient layers and product excess through E reduces C36' to rho_L=(R-L)_+. On the Pareto diagonal L+E=17, exclusion of any rectangle (P,R)>=(19,18),(21,16),(25,12),(29,8),(33,4) closes C36'. The selected P>=33,R>=4 endpoint is Mbar_(3),6,33^0+(53/42)Mbar_(3),6,33^A<=(583/272)n^2; every survivor carries a degree-seven/five pure distance-six star and a four-lift quotient packet, odd-locally expressible as one nonzero coupling anchor plus a three-spoke quotient-collision star.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal pure harmonic binary-quartic norm gate
nodes.statement: For a split squarefree deleted quartic in characteristic different from two and three, the product of the classical cubic binary-quartic invariant over the eight square-root sign classes is a symmetric degree-24 support polynomial. It vanishes exactly when some lift is harmonic and is evaluated compactly by three quadratic norms.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal pure harmonic spectral quadratic gate
nodes.statement: For the unique pure packet reconstructed from a spectral candidate, harmonic matching is equivalent to one short coefficient identity on one of the three quadratic splittings of its degree-four gcd. Together with the two fourth-power quotients and scalar splitting, this is an exact combined spectral, Fermat, and harmonic acceptance gate.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal harmonic-torsion characteristic sieve
nodes.statement: Four power-of-two roots with pairwise distinct squares cannot have cross-ratio -1 in characteristic zero: the cleared equation is an eight-term vanishing sum, and divisibility by X^(N/2)+1 forces antipodal pairing, which distinct squares make impossible. At the official lift order 2^40, every finite survivor therefore lies in the bad characteristics of one explicit integer unit-ideal certificate. A repeated-squaring presentation has 126 variables, 127 cubic-or-lower equations, and no dense degree-2^39 polynomial. No certificate or official exclusion is claimed.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one exceptional-only kernel-plane transversality
nodes.statement: At the exceptional slope, the two coefficient shifts of the degree-(r-1) minimal apolar generator span the complete middle-Hankel kernel. The first kernel lift obeys M_0q_1+M_1u=0, the induced form vanishes on the continuing line, and its value on the second shifted line is nonzero.

nodes.title: A=1 core-one exceptional-only quadratic-moment pin
nodes.statement: The first-order exceptional Hankel crossing is exactly the three shifted quadratic convolutions Theta_0=Theta_1=0 and Theta_2 nonzero. For contracted source weights these are the degree-zero, degree-one, and degree-two weighted moments of the squared exceptional locator.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal pure Euler ramification router
nodes.statement: On the pure-quartic boundary, the norm equation is equivalent to TU^3+d=e_4V^3C and its derivative factors exactly as U^2V^2L with L linear. Thus TU^3 has at most three finite critical values and every repeated-factor defect is localized at one point.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal pure ramification passport
nodes.statement: The pure Euler and second-Wronskian linear residuals satisfy Lambda=dL. The associated degree-4r rational cover lies in exactly four printed Belyi defect passports or one generic almost-Belyi passport, with same-side collisions exactly at the unique deleted-or-zero intersection.

nodes.title: Budget-three antipodal pure Euler spectral reconstruction
nodes.statement: A pure passport polynomial determines its norm packet uniquely: its coefficientwise Euler lift S has D=gcd(S,Y^d-1) of degree four, and the complementary quotients (Y^d-1+S)/D and -S/D are respectively a monic fourth power and a scalar times a monic fourth power. Base-field splitting and harmonic matching remain explicit separate tests.

nodes.title: Budget-three deleted-pair even-Jacobi norm router
nodes.statement: Parity and quadratic Jacobi transformations replace every signed deleted-pair degree-2^36 trace gcd by an exact quadratic-norm gcd of degree at most 2^35, preserving all six branches over the algebraic closure.

nodes.title: Budget-three deleted-pair torsion cyclotomic-norm decomposition
nodes.statement: For every dyadic M, the squared Jacobi/Chebyshev torsion resultants are exact cyclotomic norms: the T_(2M) branch is one Phi_(8M) norm and the U_(2M-1) branch is the product of the dyadic norm tower Phi_4 through Phi_(4M). The plus branch is equivalently (2M)^M times the product of resultants against T_1,T_2,...,T_M; over Q(sqrt(2)) the minus branch is the product of two conjugate resultants against sqrt(2)T_M+/-1. Odd-prime norm valuations are twice the resultant valuations. At official M=2^35 neither modular torsion factor need exceed degree M, without asserting modular nonvanishing.

nodes.title: RF3-double-prime retained-degree KoalaBear safe rows
nodes.statement: The corrected global-degree RF3-double-prime factor lift, combined with retained-degree interpolation, unconditionally bounds the full-field MCA bad-slope numerator at four n=2^21 KoalaBear rows by 274589064742753629, 274721012201293956, 274578888391562205, and 274861787390263486 respectively, each at most floor(p_KB^6/2^128)=274980728111395087. Thus the printed agreements 1485170, 1051719, 744762, and 527408 are safe at rates 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, and 1/16. No adjacent unsafe packet or maximal radius is claimed.

nodes.title: XR low-core u=0 loop-defect ratio router
nodes.statement: In every RowC rank-five P-B cell with u=0 and v>=1, deleting the v kernel loops removes at most v selected slopes and leaves a GRS_4 extension family on N=R+4 points. For every reused four-core T, the exact interpolation ratio has at most v-1 denominator-zero points per incident agreement set, so each slope contributes at least h+1 points to a disjoint ratio fiber and the line population is at most floor(R/(h+1)). A multiplicity-sensitive peeling formula D_r=C(4+h+v,4)-floor((r-1)C(R+4,4)/(8n^3+1-v)) supplies the complete rich-core interface. This reaches but does not pay the residual v<=1,2,6 cells.

nodes.title: Rate-half exceptional Hankel quotient-distance router
nodes.statement: On the official A=1 core-one exceptional-only sharp-cap profile, let W_A be the span of the moment columns at the r-1 roots of the exceptional locator A. The first-order syndrome h_1 has quotient support distance at least three modulo W_A. If the distance is exactly three, its residual-domain support triple is unique and its coefficients are the explicit Vandermonde-barycentric weights Theta_2/(A(x_i)^2 product_(j!=i)(x_i-x_j)); otherwise the quotient distance is at least four. This is an exhaustive source-intrinsic router, not an exclusion of either branch.

nodes.title: Rate-half exceptional distance-three MDS-escape router
nodes.statement: On the official A=1 core-one exceptional-only quotient-distance-three chart, every ordinary supported slope is either an internal fiber cancelling exactly two exceptional-root source coefficients, or a disjoint minimum-weight Vandermonde escape. The official incidence budget forces exactly e internal fibers, whose pairs partition the 2e exceptional roots, and exactly 3e external escapes. Each external locator G obeys G(t)/A(t)=constant on the canonical triple, and the total outside-row incidence deficit is exactly e. This is an exact router, not an exclusion of the chart.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three pair-Lagrange normal form
nodes.statement: On the official exceptional-only quotient-distance-three chart, normalize Q(0;X)=A(X). The e internal fibers partition the 2e exceptional roots into pairs D_i and determine the entire residual generator by Q(z;X)=Phi(z)A(X)+zB_T(X) sum_i (lambda_i/xi_i)L_i(z)A(X)/D_i(X), where xi_i are the internal slopes and L_i their Lagrange basis. The displayed X-side and parameter-side families are both independent, so this is a minimal rank-(e+1) separated expansion. The external split-fiber classification remains open.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three external split-design saturation
nodes.statement: On the official exceptional-only quotient-distance-three chart, the 3e external degree-(2e+1) locators form an exact biregular design on 6e+3 residual-domain points of degree e, while one unique point outside the canonical support is omitted. If C is the monic polynomial on those 6e+3 points, the product of all monic external locators is exactly C^e, and P_X=A B_T C. This exact incidence/product identity does not classify the individual external blocks.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three quadratic locator-rank gate
nodes.statement: On the official pair-Lagrange distance-three chart, let V be the X-coefficient space spanned by A and the e polynomials B A/D_i. Its quadratic product space has dimension at most 3e+1. Consequently the quadratic Veronese matrix of the 6e+3 external monic locator vectors has rank at most 3e+1, giving at least 3e+2 row dependencies and e(e-3)/2 independent quadratic equations. This is a necessary gate, not an exclusion of the chart.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three generic Schur-square saturation route fence
nodes.statement: For every e>=3 and every odd characteristic, some finite extension contains split disjoint rank-three pair locators D_i for which V=span{A,B A/D_i} has dim(VV)<=3e<3e+1. The construction uses pair factors from distinct fibers of B/R with B=X(X-1)(X+1), R=X^2+1. Thus generic pair-locator rank does not force saturation of the quadratic locator-rank cap; an official exclusion must use calibrated external-design data.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three generic Schur-defect trigonal-fiber classification
nodes.statement: On the rank-three pair-locator branch, let V=span{A,B A/D_i}. The exact defect (3e+1)-dim(VV) equals the dimension of the linear solution space of D_i | R-y_iB with deg R<=2, and that solution space has dimension at most one. Thus the generic quadratic rank is exactly 3e+1 or 3e; in the latter case all but at most one pair lie in distinct fibers of one projectively unique recovered degree-three rational map B/R. On official active rows, dim(VV) is exactly the quadratic locator-matrix rank.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three official trigonal-subgroup exclusion
nodes.closure: proof using published finite-field subgroup bounds
nodes.statement: On the official prime-field order-2^41 subgroup, the rank-three pair-locator branch has zero trigonal recovery kernel. A nonzero kernel would place 2e ordered exceptional pairs on one degree-three rational-map coincidence curve. Explicit subgroup bounds exclude its absolutely irreducible bidegree-(2,2), or after a torus change bidegree-(2,3), case; geometric reducibility would force an impossible order-three Mobius deck map. Hence the official generic quadratic rank is exactly 3e+1. The saturated external-design branch remains open.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three saturated cyclic-design residue route fence
nodes.statement: Over F_151 at e=5, an explicit 33-block cyclic split-divisor design is exactly 1-(15,5,11), has saturated quadratic locator rank 16=3e+1, and has complement span 9=e+4. Thus biregularity and both uncalibrated rank shadows coexist. For every degree-five internal locator I with I(0) nonzero, however, the complement residues modulo I have rank at least four. The calibrated rank-three residue gate is therefore load-bearing in the official saturated generic branch.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three complement-residue rank-three gate
nodes.statement: On the official pair-Lagrange external design, let I be the internal-slope locator, P_Z the external-slope locator, G_x the monic supported-slope locator of an active outside row, and H_x=P_Z/G_x. The 6e+3 residue classes H_x mod I span dimension at most three. Equivalently, both the complement-evaluation matrix H_x(xi_i) and inverse-locator matrix G_x(0)/G_x(xi_i) have rank at most three. The full complement polynomials span dimension at most e+4. Exact biregularity alone does not imply these gates.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three calibrated conic kernel-lift normal form
nodes.statement: On the exact pair-Lagrange external design, scale each degree-2e complement H_x=P_Z/G_x by s_x=B(x)G_x(0). There are fixed degree-less-than-e polynomials R_0,R_1,R_2 such that s_xH_x=R_0+xR_1+x^2R_2+IJ_x with a unique degree-at-most-e kernel lift J_x whose leading coefficient is s_x. nodes.statement: Substituting the Forney interpolation identity reduces the norm-discriminant quantity to (-1)^e Norm_A(Beta) Res(A,q_1)^2, whose first factor is already square by weighted self-duality. Thus direct evaluation from a complete packet is an audit, not an independent endpoint exclusion; only a separately derived profile formula could turn it into one.

nodes.title: A=1 half-dimension MDS non-GRS route fence
nodes.statement: An exact Euclidean self-dual [8,4,5] MDS code over F_11 has Schur-square dimension seven but is not generalized Reed--Solomon, certified by a full-rank linear-syzygy matrix for its three vanishing quadrics. Thus at n=2k the official MDS branch cannot be promoted to rational-normal form without endpoint-specific split, Forney, or smooth-domain input.

nodes.title: A=1 exceptional non-MDS annihilating-pair router
nodes.statement: On the non-MDS branch, complementary singular e-column sets have equal rank deficiency d by weighted self-duality and yield d-dimensional shortening spaces with all d^2 cross products zero. Their numerator gcds with A have degree at least e and lcm A, splitting into excess-zero or A=D_uD_v; q_1 is a unit, so no quotient inversion or maximal-minor enumeration is needed.

nodes.title: A=1 exceptional non-MDS support-residue gate
nodes.statement: For every cross pair from deficiency-d non-MDS shortening spaces, with K=H_lambda H_nu/A, M_1 isotropy forces the top coefficient of rem_(B_T)(Phi K A^(-1)) to vanish. Equivalently sum_A beta q_1 K is zero below degree 2e+2 and equals Theta_2 lc(K) at the top degree, yielding a d-by-d matrix of compressed checks.

nodes.title: Rate-half exceptional-only quotient-distance ceiling
nodes.statement: On the official A=1 core-one exceptional-only face, every ordinary clean locator represents the first-order quotient class outside the exceptional roots. Exact saturation gives 2e(e-1) exceptional-root incidences across the 4e ordinary locators, so averaging forces h<=3(e+1)/2=412316860416. Combined with the lower gap, the quotient distance is three or lies in the interval 183251937965<=h<=412316860416.

nodes.title: Rate-half exceptional-only quotient Forney-numerator normal form
nodes.statement: For every minimal quotient support T of size h on the official exceptional-only face, all source weights are reconstructed by a unique polynomial F with deg F=h-3, leading coefficient Theta_2, and gcd(F,A B_T)=1: omega_t=F(t)/(A(t)^2 B_T'(t)). The same F interpolates beta_a q_1(a)A'(a)B_T(a) on every exceptional root. Exact saturation makes q_1 nonzero there. This is the exact general-distance GRS/Forney key equation and specializes to the distance-three barycentric formula.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three matching-free boundary-power router
nodes.statement: On the official distance-three support packet, put K_A(a)=P_X'(a)/(B(a)^4 A'(a)^4) on the 2e exceptional roots and K_B(t)=P_X'(t)/(A(t)^4 B'(t)) on the triple. A boundary-compatible perfect matching exists exactly when the multiset of K_A(a)^e is centrally symmetric, equivalently its monic value polynomial is even; every admissible matching pairs opposite values. The triple gates are exactly equality of the three K_B(t)^e values.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three joint boundary/residue matching router
nodes.statement: On the official distance-three support packet, label each exceptional root by (Y_a,[C(a)]_r), where Y_a is its matching-free boundary e-th-power value and [.]_r is the class modulo r-th powers. With mu=[-product_(t in T)C(t)]_r, a perfect matching satisfies both every boundary gate and every dual row-product gate exactly when the label multiset is invariant under (y,g)|->(-y,mu/g). This reconstructs all joint-admissible matchings and forces the aggregate obstruction Res(A,C)/(-Res(B,C))^e in (F_q^*)^r.

nodes.title: Rate-half distance-three exceptional quadratic-character router
nodes.statement: On every official prime-field distance-three support packet, existence of a boundary-compatible perfect matching forces -A(0)A(s)A(x_0) to be a quadratic residue. This follows by multiplying the centrally paired e-th-power boundary values, deleting fourth-power denominators, and applying the smooth subgroup derivative formula. The test depends only on the exceptional support and the stripped and omitted rows.

nodes.title: KoalaBear rank-nine moving-root slack boundary
nodes.statement: For the KoalaBear rate-half support-wise MCA row, every post-C5, post-source-rational, full-outside rank-two record satisfying the printed moving-set and degree contracts has L_(F_eta)|(Pbar+eta Qbar) and nonnegative slacks h+u+ell=s-t-1 with delta_eta<=u. The zero-slack boundary is C5-owned; hence every survivor has s>=67474, reduced degree e>=33737, and full-gcd degree at most 1014838. At first slack only two nonbase linear cells remain.

nodes.title: Paper D v13.2 discrete subfield-census guard
nodes.statement: For C=RS[F,D,K] with D subseteq B, K<=m, 2(m-K)<=n-K, w'=m-K, w'+1<=d1<=floor((n-K+1)/2), m'=K-1+d1, and m'+d1<=n, the Paper D v13.2 identity-prefix census has A_B(d1)=C(n,m')|B|^-(d1-1), exact floor M_B^disc=C(m',m)ceil(A_B), and soft upper model M_B^soft=C(m',m)(1+A_B). Exact replay gives the corrected KoalaBear floors 67.0958/56.0111/43.9348/57.6849 bits and Mersenne-31 floors 52.1129/41.0169/39.1799/57.6848 bits at offsets zero through three.

nodes.title: Paper D v13.2 near-rational pair proximity
nodes.statement: For a linear code C and distinct finite slopes z1,z2, if u+z_i v=c_i+eta_i with c_i in C and wt(eta_i)<=w, then an explicit codeword pair (cu,cv) agrees jointly with (u,v) outside supp(eta1) union supp(eta2), hence on at least n-2w coordinates. Under Paper D v13.2 thm:capfp-dichotomy's hypotheses, including 2w<=n-K, two nonzero-census slopes with d1<=w imply this pair-proximity conclusion. This does not pay support-wise MCA witnesses.

nodes.title: Paper D v13.2 near-rational support-wise payment
nodes.statement: REFUTED: common codeword-pair proximity produced by two low-d1 slopes does not imply that no slope is support-wise MCA-bad. In the smooth rate-half code RS[F_17,mu_8,4] at m=5, u=(0,0,0,0,0,0,1,1) and v=(0,0,0,0,0,0,1,2) satisfy n-3w=m and have low-d1 nonzero-census slopes 8 and 16, yet both slopes possess agreement supports that do not extend to a codeword pair. The final displayed balanced-count inequality of cor:capfp-line is not itself refuted by this witness; its near-rational payment needs a new support-wise argument.

nodes.title: Universal nondeep tangent support-wise payment
nodes.statement: REFUTED: outside 3(n-A)<=n-K, a received pair jointly explained on at least A coordinates need not have at most n-A+1 support-wise MCA-bad slopes. In RS[F_17,mu_8,2] at A=3, the pair u=(0,0,0,0,0,0,1,1), v=(0,0,0,0,0,0,1,2) is jointly zero on six coordinates but has eight exact-A bad slopes, exceeding 6. The witness supports are distinct, low-core, aperiodic, and not an x->x^2 pullback. This is not an official-row refutation.

nodes.title: XR support-wise tangent/mismatch scope bridge
nodes.statement: Every received pair lies in one of two exhaustive routes. If globally generic, the R2 partition of record (ratified 2026-08-02) splits selected post-strip slopes BY DEFINITION into Gamma_band (some pairwise core >= k+1; band depths [1,h-1], the depth-(h-1) cascade tier included and named; charged by xr_graded_tangent_band_charge from the 13n^3 headroom), Gamma_hi (not band, some core exactly k) = P-A1 with its exact-k form unchanged, and Gamma_lo (all cores <= k-1) = P-B. The partition is exhaustive and disjoint by construction with NO core-cap premise; participation in a >=k+1 core is symmetric, so outside Gamma_band all pairwise cores are <= k. The strip rung is consumed for its FORCING content only (cores >= k+1 force a codeword pair on > k points), never as a removal. Generic budgets: 4n^3 + 8n^3 + 8n^3 inside the proved 29n^3 allowance. If a joint A-support explanation exists, only q_z=0 recovered-line tangents are removed, every q_z!=0 mismatch remains support-locally transverse, and the complete retained mismatch population routes to P-A2's one combined 16n^3 clause. Thus P-A1, P-A2, P-B, and the band column imply the exact residual bound for every pair. This node proves routing only and assumes no numerical clause. [Former = K split superseded: it rested on an unproved core cap; see notes/FLAG_ADJUDICATION_20260802.md.]

nodes.notes: OBLIGATION-PRESERVING SCOPE CONTRACTION: P-A1/P-B retain their original generic 8+8 allocation. The former standalone nongeneric 16n^3 branch-width target is merged verbatim as P-A2, with no stronger per-stratum split. The canonical full-zero descent (depth caps 169,169,255,254,254,510; terminal breadth and low ranks paid) remains the P-A2 attack.

nodes.title: True recovered-line tangent slopes inject into discrepancy coordinates
nodes.statement: For any linear code, write u=c0+e0 and v=c1+e1 with joint discrepancy support T. Finite support-wise MCA-bad slopes whose witness codeword is exactly c0+z c1 inject into T: every bad witness meets T and supplies a root e0(i)+z e1(i)=0 at a nonzero error coordinate, while one coordinate has at most one finite root. Hence their number is at most |T|, and in the official tangent branch at most n-A. No deep-regime hypothesis is used.

nodes.title: Nonzero tangent mismatches reduce to fixed-excess punctured GRS charts
nodes.statement: Let A=K+h and q_z=p_z-(c0+z c1) be a nonzero difference codeword for an exact-A witness S, with T the recovered-pair discrepancy support. If W=S\T and d=|W|, then P_W divides q_z, d<=K-1, and q_z/P_W has degree below K-d. On T, after scaling e0,e1 by P_W^{-1}, it agrees on A-d coordinates. Thus every mismatch enters a punctured GRS chart of dimension K-d, agreement A-d, invariant excess h, and error radius R-h. This is a per-witness reduction, not an aggregate over W.

nodes.title: Selected mismatches have canonical full-external-zero charts
nodes.statement: For one deterministically selected exact-A witness/codeword per retained slope, let q_z be its nonzero difference codeword and Z_z all zeros of q_z outside the recovered discrepancy support T. The full locator P_Z divides q_z, |Z_z|<=K-1, and after division the scaled line on T has agreement at least A-|Z_z| with a code of dimension K-|Z_z|. Hence excess remains at least A-K. This gives one full-zero chart per selected slope/codeword and removes witness-subset spray, but does not bound the number of distinct charts.

nodes.title: Mismatch-chart nongenericity is an alternative joint A-support
nodes.statement: For a full-external-zero chart (T,Z), scaled endpoint genericity fails at radius |T|-(A-|Z|) iff there are degree-below-(K-|Z|) polynomials g0,g1 such that c_i+P_Z g_i jointly explain the received pair on Z union R for some R subset T of size at least A-|Z|. Thus recursive nongenericity is exactly a second joint agreement support of size at least A extending Z. Supports for distinct joint codeword-pair explanations intersect in at most K-1 coordinates.

nodes.title: Nongeneric mismatch descent preserves excess and has bounded depth
nodes.statement: In a recursive nongeneric full-zero mismatch chain, a transition with external zero count d sends (N,K,A) to N'<=N-A, K'=K-d, A'=A-d. Thus h=A-K is invariant and every live transition decreases ambient length by at least h+1. A chain from length n has at most floor(n/(h+1))-1 transitions. The six clean candidate caps are 169,169,255,254,254,510, each below its deciding scale 256 or 512. This proves depth, not branch width or slope aggregation.

nodes.title: XR nongeneric-explanation Plotkin width
nodes.statement: At one mismatch instance with A=K+h and H=h+1, canonically truncated A-supports of distinct joint codeword-pair explanations form an injective constant-weight code with pairwise intersection at most K-1=A-H and distance at least 2H. Hence there are at most floor(4H/(4H-N)) explanations when N<4H, at most 2N at equality, and polynomially many whenever N-4H<=C log_2 n. Once descent enters N<=4H, its live subtree has at most 1+104H instances and 420H^2 tangent charges. More generally, if H>=2C log_2 n, the whole fixed-logarithmic subtree has at most 1+200n^(C+1) instances and 201n^(C+2) tangent charges. Generic chart slopes and pre-terminal slope fibers remain open.

nodes.title: DSP8 primitive cubic shift-pair adapter
nodes.statement: Every ordered DSP8 disjoint edge gives a decorated pair of monic H-split cubics A,B with A-B=t(s-r)X and A(0)=B(0)=-rs. This is a reduced degree-three/depth-one shift pair. Since n is dyadic, gcd(n,3)=1 makes every such pair coefficient-primitive. The converse reconstruction is exact, and the orientation ledger is J_25^c=4K_25^c=8D_6,25^c. The former sufficient target becomes 10K_25^0+17K_25^A<=223n^2; the later antipodal quotient-mass payment weakens the live target without changing this adapter.

nodes.title: DSP8 unit-product trace normal form
nodes.statement: Every decorated DSP8 primitive cubic shift pair has a unique product-one normalization. If q^3=RS and the six roots are divided by q, then q=rs, ruv=sxy=1, the two triples have common trace sigma, and the retained target is t=1+rs(r+s-sigma). Conversely these normalized data reconstruct the decorated pair with no free H-scale. Thus the exact residual is a common-trace pair of subgroup-split quadratics coupled to one quotient line; generic degree-three SP all-pairs counting is too coarse and supplies no DSP8 bound.

nodes.title: DSP8 antipodal Cayley-product router
nodes.statement: For an antipodal target t=1-a^2, let C(h)=(1+h)/(1-h), B=C(H without {1,-1}), and M_a=#{(alpha,beta) in B^2:alpha beta=C(a)}. Then P(1-a^2)=2+M_a exactly, so the DSP8 cutoff P>=25 is M_a>=23. If E_a counts ordered signed-disjoint edges among the corresponding small-generic factor pairs and L_a is the quotient-line multiplicity, then K_25^A=sum E_a L_a over canonical a with M_a>=23. This is an exact router and supplies no weighted-energy bound.

nodes.title: DSP8 unit-trace elliptic-curve router
nodes.statement: The unit-product trace fiber is the plane cubic X^2Y+XY^2-sigma XYZ+Z^3=0. In characteristic different from 2,3 it is a smooth geometrically irreducible genus-one curve when sigma^3!=27 and a one-node genus-zero curve when sigma^3=27. Raw ordered point-pair records have exact multiplicity G_25^c=4K_25^c=J_25^c, so DSP8 is a quotient-weighted subgroup point-pair estimate on this mostly elliptic family. The upstream same-(e1,e2) rational-conic chart does not parameterize this same-(e1,e3) residue.

nodes.title: Optimized one-fiber affine coset-pair Stepanov bound
nodes.statement: At every official dyadic prime-field row, any two nonconstant nonproportional affine forms simultaneously take values in H at fewer than 4n^(2/3) inputs. This is the exact T=1 optimization of the proved in-house Stepanov construction. It improves the older conservative 66n^(2/3) one-fiber corollary but does not change the multi-fiber rich-coset or energy constants.

nodes.title: DSP8 nodal-trace parameter router and marginal envelope
nodes.statement: Every singular trace sigma=3c has an exact rational parameter theta. Its H-points lie in at most three affine coset-pair branches and satisfy N_sigma<12n^(2/3)+1; the pair target is an explicit four-factor rational function. The total singular raw quotient-weighted record count is below 12n^(2/3)(12n^(2/3)+1)^2. This has the correct O(n^2) exponent, but after the class weight its leading coefficient is 29376 versus the full DSP8 allowance 892, so marginal point bounds do not close or delete the nodal locus.

nodes.title: DSP8 nodal target-divisor pruning
nodes.statement: For nonnode nodal parameters a,b, positive root overlap is exactly the six-value Mobius orbit S(a). The target satisfies t-1=-(q(a)+q(b)+3q(a)q(b))/(q(a)^2q(b)^2), and its zero divisor is contained in that positive-overlap orbit. Thus a complete packet can canonicalize the orbit and remove every positive collision, all nine negative collisions, and the identity target before retaining richness and quotient weights. This is exact pruning and supplies no surviving-pair bound.

nodes.title: Cubic-preimage affine coset-pair Stepanov bound
nodes.statement: At every official H3 ambient row, for a subgroup K of order m=n or 3n and any two nonconstant nonproportional affine forms, the simultaneous K-membership set has size below (51/16)m^(2/3). The exact Stepanov parameters work under p>=n^2 even when m=3n. This is a one-fiber theorem and supplies no energy estimate.

nodes.title: Mattarei affine coset-pair bound
nodes.statement: Let K<=F_p^* have order m and index d=(p-1)/m. If d>=4 and d^3>=4m, every simultaneous membership fiber of two nonconstant nonproportional affine forms has size <3*2^(-2/3)m^(2/3). This prime-field pointwise theorem bypasses, but does not refute, the in-house one-polynomial Stepanov barrier.

Therefore 189(10U_sm^0+17U_sm^A)<=144344n^(4/3), or class-blind 3213(U_sm^0+U_sm^A)<=144344n^(4/3), proves the live smooth residual. This compiler supplies no unweighted estimate.

nodes.title: DSP8 nodal/smooth high-tail domination
nodes.statement: On every retained product fiber, the nodal signed-disjoint distance-six graph has maximum degree three while the total disjoint graph has the proved multiplicity lower bound. Hence nodal edges are dominated targetwise by smooth edges for antipodal-free P>=33 and antipodal P>=35. The high-tail quotient-weighted moment is at most twice its smooth part; the bounded lower multiplicity bands and the smooth moment remain open.

nodes.title: H3 quotient anharmonic symmetry and antipodal twin
nodes.statement: The quotient weight R(t) is constant on the six-value anharmonic orbit of every nonzero nonidentity target. On an antipodal target t=1-a^2, tau(t)=t/(t-1)=1-a^(-2) has exactly the same product richness P and quotient weight R. Antipodal P and M_a=P-2 are even, so P>=25 is exactly P>=26 and M_a>=24. This canonicalizes antipodal target evaluation but does not preserve or identify signed-disjoint edge counts.

nodes.title: DSP8 antipodal quotient-mass payment
nodes.statement: On the E=6, P>=25 interface, the selected antipodal quotient mass S_A is below (C_M/2)(n-2)n^(2/3), C_M=3*2^(-2/3), and the class-weighted overlap payment is at most 6Q_n+(38/5)S_A. Consequently C36' follows from 10K_25^0+17K_25^A+152S_A<=750n^2-375Q_n; the uniform estimate 100(10K_25^0+17K_25^A)<=36781n^2 is sufficient without estimating the open disjoint correlation.

nodes.title: DSP8 global overlap-cover payment

Combining this with Mattarei's affine quotient-fiber cap and the antipodal quotient-mass theorem gives O_6,25^0+(17/10)O_6,25^A<(17/5)C_M n^(5/3)+(17/5)S_A. Consequently C36' follows from 10K_25^0+17K_25^A+68S_A+68C_M n^(5/3)<=750n^2-255Q_n; uniformly, 25(10K_25^0+17K_25^A)<=12134n^2 suffices without estimating the open disjoint correlation.
