nodes.statement: For F_25^c=sum over class-c P>=25 targets of P(t)(P(t)-2)R(t), the decorated disjoint correlation satisfies 10K_25^0+17K_25^A<=(10F_25^0+17F_25^A)/4<=(17/4)M_21, where M_21=sum over t!=1 of P(t)(P(t)-1)R(t). Consequently 25(10F_25^0+17F_25^A)<=48536n^2, or more strongly 425M_21<=48536n^2, implies the uniform DSP8 target. The older FM69 target is sufficient but substantially stronger than necessary.

nodes.title: DSP8 joint-star / quotient-depth Pareto compiler
nodes.statement: For every integer E from 6 through 16 and L=17-E, the retained disjoint-six moment with P>=19+E and rho_L=(R-L)_+ has an exact class-sensitive sufficient bound. Swap parity and the affine diagonal-target payment strengthen the five odd-cutoff allowances E=7,9,11,13,15 by a common factor 8093/3520>2.29, with exact row-sensitive budgets retaining S_(D,E). The eleven joint candidate packets range from (P,R)>=(25,12), with a degree-two free product star and eleven quotient spokes, through the degree-seven/five (34,3) packet with two spokes, to the coordinate-minimal (35,2) corner, with degree-eight/six product stars and one quotient spoke. Each full coupling batch is odd-locally equivalent to one nonzero coupling anchor plus the complete quotient-collision star. These are alternative compilers, not proved moment or survivor bounds.

nodes.title: HGE4 primitive shift-pair aggregate adapter
nodes.statement: For every official row and 4<=h<=H_max, the stripped HGE4 norm-gate record count satisfies N_h^strip<=SP_h^prim, where SP_h^prim is the ordered top shift-pair count after the quotient-pullback/full-fiber deletion. If B_h=binom(n,h)(binom(n,h)-1)/p^(h-1) and SP_h^prim<=7000n max(1,B_h) at every retained width, then sum_h N_h^strip<14n^3. The reduction and summation compiler are proved; the primitive shift-pair estimate is not claimed.

nodes.title: HGE4 primitive shift-pair orbit aggregate router
nodes.statement: Multiplicative scaling acts freely on every ordered primitive top shift pair, so SP_h^prim=n O_h^prim; a left-anchored ordered scanner has exactly A_h^left=h O_h^prim records. Hence sum_{h=4}^{H_max} O_h^prim<=14n^2 implies the HGE4 norm-gate target. Equivalently the per-width 7000n estimate asks for O_h^prim<=7000 max(1,B_h). At every official h>=4 row the latter allowance is smaller than binom(n,h), so naive uniform max-degree summation can meet it only by proving primitive emptiness; a nonzero route needs averaged falling-factorial, orbit, or sparse-active-support control.

nodes.title: HGE4 primitive shift-pair near-square union router
nodes.statement: An unordered primitive top shift pair is equivalent to a 2h-subset U whose locator D_U has the unique form S_U^2-d_U^2 with S_U monic of degree h and d_U a nonzero field element; the two signs reconstruct the pair. If V_free,V_swap count free and antipodal-swap scaling orbits of valid primitive unions, then O_h^prim=2V_free+V_swap. Distinct valid unions containing 1 satisfy A_h^union=hO_h^prim, so sum_h A_h^union/h<=14n^2 is exactly the HGE4 orbit target. The anchored candidate space falls by binom(2h-1,h-1) compared with ordered disjoint-pair enumeration. The aggregate count remains open.

nodes.title: H3 global product/quotient resultant compression
nodes.statement: For dyadic n, the complete shifted-root polynomial is F_n(X)=((1-X)^n-1)/X. The ordered product polynomial is Res_X(F_n(X),X^(n-1)F_n(T/X)); the nonidentity quotient polynomial is Res_X(F_n(X),F_n(TX))/(n(T-1)^(n-1)); and every cleared first-nineteen derivative packet is one bivariate resultant modulo U^19. This removes factor enumeration when constructing the two global polynomials, but does not eliminate the quotient-lift packet index, bound the exceptional integer, or supply an official-scale resultant algorithm.

nodes.title: H3 cutoff multiplicity-layer gcd compiler
nodes.statement: For every prime-field dyadic row and every cutoff c<n-1, let Pcal and Qcal be the global ordered product and nonidentity quotient polynomials. If G is the gcd of Pcal and its first c Hasse derivatives, and G_j is the gcd of the first j Hasse derivatives of G, then X_c=sum_j deg gcd(Qcal,G_j^(n-1)). Replacing Qcal by gcd(Qcal,Qcal') gives exactly Y_c=sum_t(P(t)-c)_+(R(t)-1)_+. At c=18 this is a quotient-lift-free exact row compiler for X_18 and Y_18; on the official orders, the uniform product-fiber theorem truncates it to B_n=min(n-19,ceil(33n^(2/3))-19) layers, each with a divisor-plus-Bezout certificate. It supplies no upper bound or official-scale complexity claim.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two path constructions share a forbidden factor
nodes.statement: Let three pairwise-coprime locators be one-root deletions from unions of fibers of a common X^2 map, with completed half-degree s>=2. Writing H_i(Y)=(Y-r_i^2)K_i(Y) gives A_i(X)=(X+r_i)K_i(X^2). The odd and even parts of a nondegenerate three-term relation force all K_i to be scalar multiples of one common K, so the A_i share the nonconstant factor K(X^2), a contradiction. Hence both path-plus-singleton chambers have no direct common-fiber-size-two construction. Together with the Vandermonde theorem, every direct equal-complete-fiber path construction with m>=2 is excluded; m=1, mixed-map, partial-fiber, primitive, and non-path residuals remain open.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two cycles route through three quartic-pencil strata
nodes.statement: Every direct common-X^2 four-cycle construction descends through Y=X^2 to four pairwise-coprime degree-(s-1) members of a two-dimensional pencil with a squarefree quartic denominator D_*; the completion roots are automatically distinct. The number c=0,1,2 of antipodal deleted-root pairs is exhaustive. For c=0, D_*=product_i(Y-rho_i^2), giving exactly the existing matched antipodal quotient-pencil input at d_ant=2d=4s. For c=1,2, one or two repeated coefficient-square roots are replaced by exceptional-pair squares, producing explicit denominator-mismatch strata. All three have a Mobius weld, primitive rational-map degree s-1, and the general quartic degree floor. At the prize maximum the quotient order is 2^40, map degree 2^38-1, and lower pencil degree at least 2^37-2. No stratum is proved empty.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two cycle boundaries transfer through canonical span
nodes.statement: For every c=0,1,2 fiber-two cycle quartic-pencil stratum at quotient order 2^40, all parameter-uniform boundary theorems transfer through the canonical-span certifier. The generic and intermediate minimum-degree boundaries both have linear differential residual and the same primary gap a_(2^38)=a_(2^38+1)=0, a_(2^38+2)!=0; the generic secondary gaps are at 2^37-1 and 2^37. A two-antipodal-pair denominator uses M=2^36. The canonical outer quartic must be PGL-matched to the cycle completion roots rho_i. Only at c=0 are these automatically square-root lifts of all denominator roots, so the old one-parameter Mobius-ratio/norm gates are not imported into c=1,2.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two matched-cycle lifts descend to the prime field
nodes.statement: On the two-antipodal-denominator subbranch of the matched c=0 generic fiber-two cycle boundary at M=2^36 and N=2^39, a parameter-uniform Fourier resultant excludes the official prime-field branch and the quadratic p=-1 branch, leaving q_field=p^2 with p=1 mod 2^40. The even-factorization coefficients and outer roots descend to F_p under this weaker congruence. In the nonsplit class modulo 2^41, Frobenius sends a possible top lift r to +/-r; conjugating the three exact Mobius-ratio equations excludes the -r case. Hence every surviving normalized source lift and the Mobius matching lie over F_p. This does not exclude the boundary or transfer the later scalar, Jacobi, and norm gates.

nodes.title: XR mismatch-descent dimension area law
nodes.statement: For every live invariant-excess mismatch chain, sum_j(K_j+h)<=N_0-(h+1), while the external-zero drops telescope as sum_j d_j=K_0-K_L<=K_0-1. Consequently the number of levels with K_j>=kappa is at most floor((N_0-h-1)/(kappa+h)), and a chain close to maximal depth has only the corresponding small excess-dimension area. Exact caps are printed for all six clean-rate roots. This is pathwise dimension amortization, not a branch-width or slope payment.

nodes.title: XR nongeneric support-only exponential-width fence
nodes.statement: At each of the six clean-rate roots, there is an abstract family of A-subsets satisfying the exact joint-explanation support cap |Y intersect Y'|<=K-1 and containing more than 16n^3 members. Pairing 2A coordinates converts a binary Gilbert code of length A and distance H=h+1 into such a family; H/A<=1/16 gives size greater than 2^(5A/8). These supports are not claimed to be realizable RS explanations. The result proves that pre-terminal XR closure cannot use pairwise support packing alone and must retain algebraic realization or actual-slope ownership.

nodes.title: DSP8 nodal Stepanov constant barrier
nodes.statement: Every positive parameter choice in the in-house one-auxiliary-polynomial Stepanov ansatz, with D(A+D)<AB^2 and AB<=m, has degree-to-multiplicity quotient greater than 2^(5/3)m^(2/3). Using this ansatz for both the order-n quotient line and order-3n nodal parameter count forces a class-blind leading coefficient above 2176, exceeding the live G-normalized allowance 48536/25. Retuning A,B,D cannot close the three-cubic-root nodal lane. Mattarei's distinct Garcia--Voloch route now bypasses this proof-method barrier; the statement was never a lower bound on actual records.

nodes.title: DSP8 smooth-trace substar router
nodes.statement: For a fixed product target and one representation parameter r, the nodal condition for a second parameter s is (1+r+s-t)^3=27rs, a cubic in s with leading coefficient one. Thus every fixed-target nodal edge graph has maximum degree at most three. The Pareto product stars consequently retain same-center smooth substars; at the preferred (P,R)>=(35,2) corner, the degree-eight/six stars contain degree-five/three smooth substars. Their nonzero trace discriminants may be used as saturation factors in the candidate ideals without losing an actual official survivor. This is structural compression, not a DSP8 moment or survivor bound.

nodes.title: H3 quotient-algebra Fitting support compiler
nodes.statement: For dyadic n and every cutoff 2<=c<n-1, the monic nonidentity quotient polynomial over Z[1/2] defines a finite free quotient algebra. Quotienting it by the first c+1 Hasse derivatives of the global product polynomial gives a finite module whose odd order is divisible by an official row prime p exactly when X_c>0; adjoining the quotient derivative gives a divisor module whose order is divisible by p exactly when Y_c>0. Their mod-p dimensions are the exact min-depth sums sum_t min(R(t),(P(t)-c)_+) and sum_t min((R(t)-1)_+,(P(t)-c)_+), so the orders also have the corresponding valuation lower bounds. The smaller scalar annihilators, equivalently the largest Smith invariants or scalar elimination generators, have the same exact prime support and divide the full orders. This is an exact support compiler, not a weighted-moment valuation or an efficient official-scale Smith algorithm.

nodes.title: Support-distance scalar descent for Reed-Solomon lists
nodes.statement: Let E/F_q have degree r and let the evaluation domain lie in F_q. Put t=n-a, g=a-k+1, N_r=(q^r-1)/(q-1), and H_r=(q^(r-1)-1)/(q-1). If LtH_r<gN_r, then the existence of an E-valued RS list of size L at agreement a is equivalent to the existence of an F_q-valued list of size L. Thus the extension and base upper predicates at threshold L-1 are equivalent. The theorem does not prove either upper predicate; the upstream Mersenne-31 quartic specialization uses target 2^-100, not the local 2^-128 target.

nodes.title: HGE4 primitive swap odd-moment router
nodes.statement: A primitive near-square union with antipodal swap stabilizer exists only at odd width. Its two supports are P and -P, and the odd elementary symmetric functions e_j(P), equivalently the odd power sums through j<h, vanish. Conversely these equations, antipodal-freeness, and trivial common scaling stabilizer reconstruct the primitive swap pair. Thus the swap branch is empty at even h; at odd h it reduces to a signed odd-Vandermonde kernel on h antipodal pairs, with A_h^swap=hV_h^swap<=binom(n/2-1,h-1). The free-union class and the aggregate HGE4 bound remain open.

nodes.title: HGE4 primitive swap half-order square descent
nodes.statement: For odd h=2d+1, squaring the roots bijects primitive antipodal-swap near-square unions with h-subsets Y of mu_(n/2) having trivial scaling stabilizer and locator L_Y satisfying (L_Y+c_Y)/Z=T_Y^2, where c_Y=prod(Y). Equivalently L_Y=ZT_Y^2-c_Y divides Z^(n/2)-1. Scaling orbits correspond through mu_n/{+/-1}=mu_(n/2), so V_h^swap=W_h and A_h^swap=hW_h. An anchored generator performs one deterministic perfect-square test on each of binom(n/2-1,h-1) supports and removes all 2^(h-1) sign choices. No survivor bound or free-union bound is claimed.

nodes.title: HGE4 primitive swap straight-line certificate lift
nodes.statement: For every fixed N=n/2=2^m and odd h=2d+1, the swap condition YT(Y)^2-c | Y^N-1 is scheme-isomorphic over Z to a repeated-squaring system of cubic equations. With s_0=floor(log_2(h-1)), k=m-s_0, and b=d+1, the pruned system has b+k(2h-1)-h variables and k(2h-1) equations. It has no characteristic-zero point, so an integer Nullstellensatz certificate Delta_(N,h) restricts every survivor characteristic. No certificate, characteristic exclusion, survivor count, or free-union bound is claimed.

nodes.title: HGE4 non-full near-square straight-line lift
nodes.statement: For D=S^2-a^2, the divisor condition D | X^n-1 has an exact cubic repeated-squaring presentation. Adding sum_(j=1)^(h-1) z_j s_j=1 captures every non-full-fiber near-square divisor, including free and swap primitive unions; equivalently use h-1 inverse charts. With k=log_2(n)-floor(log_2(2h-1)), the global selector has k(4h-1) variables and k(4h-1)+1 equations, while one chart has k(4h-1)-h+2 variables. The schemes are empty in characteristic zero and have integer bad-characteristic certificate endpoints. No certificate, survivor count, or uniform aggregate is claimed.

nodes.title: HGE4 exact-ratio tower orbit compiler
nodes.statement: Primitive top shift-pair scaling orbits split bijectively by their exact dyadic ratio subgroup: O_h^prim(n,p)=sum_(m|n,m>=2h) E_h^prim(m,p), and each exact-level orbit has h left-anchored presentations. Therefore the levelwise estimate sum_(h=4)^floor(m/2) E_h^prim(m,p)<=(21/2)m^2 for every m|n sums geometrically to less than 14n^2 and implies HGE4. Exact levels are projected by the non-full near-square scheme with S(1)=a, V_r=1, and V_(r-1)!=1. The levelwise estimate itself is not proved.

nodes.title: HGE4 non-full complement-third gate
nodes.statement: If disjoint monic degree-h subgroup locators P,Q differ by a nonzero constant and leave a nonempty complement of degree c=m-2h, then h<=c. At dyadic exact ratio level m this is strict: 3h<m, so E_h^prim(m,p)=0 whenever 3h>=m and the HGE4 exact-level sum stops at floor((m-1)/3).

nodes.title: HGE4 complement-separator defect normal form
nodes.statement: For every retained non-full exact-level pair, the separator cofactors A=(H-1)/P and B=(H+1)/Q have difference G=B-A of exact degree e=m-3h, leading coefficient -d^2h/m, and satisfy m(P+Q-PQG)=d^2XP'R. Thus the closest dyadic third-line widths reduce to linear or quadratic defect systems; the systems are not counted here.

nodes.title: HGE4 boundary-defect trace pin
nodes.statement: At the e=1,2 HGE4 third-line boundaries, the separator defect G has no independent coefficients: it is fixed by the first one or two locator coefficients, with exact zero-value scalar gates. In the e=1 scaling orbit, p_0=1 and x=q_0 give d=x-1 and a=(1+x)/(x(x-1)^2). These are necessary pins, not boundary exclusions or counts.

nodes.title: HGE4 linear-boundary orbit bound
nodes.statement: At every dyadic e=1 exact-ratio boundary m=3h+1 with h>1, reciprocal linearization forces the normalized locator coefficient by coefficient from its constant ratio x. Ordered scaling orbits inject into mu_m minus {1,-1}, so E_h^prim(m,p)<=m-2. A one-variable degree-(m-1) endpoint equation provides a stricter necessary screen.

nodes.title: HGE4 quadratic-boundary orbit bound
nodes.statement: At every dyadic e=2 exact-ratio boundary m=3h+2 with h>2, two square-class normalizations reduce each ordered scaling orbit to a triple (epsilon,x,a). Reciprocal linearization forces the locator below its endpoint, and the degree-(h+1) equation f_(h+1)=0 gives E_h^prim(m,p)<=2(m-1)(h+1)=2(m^2-1)/3.

nodes.title: Tame central-star Belyi necklace bound
nodes.statement: A tame degree-m polynomial cover with passport (3^h 1^e; (h+e) 1^(2h); m), labelled branch values, and distinguished central point has at most N(h+e,e) source-scaling classes, where N(c,e) is the binary-necklace number (1/c) sum_(d|gcd(c,e)) phi(d) binom(c/d,e/d).

nodes.title: HGE4 near-third Belyi necklace bound
nodes.statement: For every primitive non-full exact-level pair with m=3h+e and 0<e<h, reciprocal linearization produces a tame central-star Belyi map. Hence E_h^prim(m,p)<=2N(h+e,e). This sharpens the e=1,2 debits to 2 and (m+4)/3 and pays five further exact-level cells, without proving the remaining aggregate.

nodes.title: HGE4 near-third dual-gap exclusion
nodes.statement: For dyadic m=3h+e with 0<e<h, the reciprocal complement creates a second coefficient gap in Z^(2/3). If h>=2e+1, its order-e differential recurrence propagates backward without a stall because 3 does not divide e. Hence E_h^prim(m,p)=0 whenever 7h>=2m+1, and live exact-level widths satisfy h<=floor(2m/7).

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two matched-cycle post-field compiler
nodes.statement: On the two-antipodal-denominator subbranch of the matched c=0 generic fiber-two cycle boundary at M=2^36, a complete split-class level-39 characteristic screen extends the old levels 1 through 38 and excludes the harmonic outer ratio. Every nonharmonic survivor is classified exactly by the doubled constant ODE, three scalar identities, outer trace depth 39, and the reciprocal-root-invariant twisted fourth-power test T/q_out=W^4. This repairs the old unscaled T=W^4 test in the nonsplit field class. The constant/Legendre gate and fourth-root gcd gate transfer at the corrected degrees. Uniform rejection and the trace-Jacobi/norm endpoint remain open.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two matched-cycle trace-Jacobi norm transfer
nodes.statement: On the matched c=0 two-antipodal-denominator generic cycle branch at M=2^36, the Chebyshev/Gegenbauer sign router gives six exact trace gcds per fixed epsilon, and the even-Jacobi quadratic norm reduces each packet coverage-equivalently from degree at most 2^37 to degree at most 2^36. Thus the complete interface has two six-gcd packets and at most twelve signed branches. The torsion-only prefilter is one cyclotomic norm at order 2^39 for epsilon=-1 and a 37-level tower at orders 2^2 through 2^38 for epsilon=1; equivalent trace and quadratic-minus splits have maximum degree 2^36. A compatible divisor is only a candidate and must still pass the signed norm and corrected T/q_out fourth-power gate. No norm is evaluated and no large run is authorized.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two mismatch completion roots have a 24+6 invariant coupling
nodes.statement: For the generic canonical fiber-two cycle denominator-mismatch strata, the completion-root PGL coupling is root-permutation-free. If c=1, the four roots of D_* give exactly 24 candidate binary quartics, indexed by the ordered repeated-completion/residual-exceptional square pair and one relative sign. If c=2, they give exactly six candidates indexed by an unordered two-subset. Writing I=12ae-3bd+c^2 and J=72ace+9bcd-27ad^2-27b^2e-2c^3, a candidate matches the canonical outer quartic exactly when I_out^3 J_src^2=I_src^3 J_out^2. A passing class reconstructs its PGL_2(base field) map. No candidate is excluded and no matched norm gate is imported.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two mismatch coupling has a radical-free trace resolvent
nodes.statement: For the generic canonical fiber-two cycle denominator-mismatch strata, the 24+6 binary-quartic invariant packet has a radical-free constant-degree elimination. In c=2, each source class depends on a denominator pair only through z=(A+B)^2/(AB); the six values are the roots of an explicit degree-six symmetric pair-trace resolvent R_D, while outer matching is the degree-three equation 4I_out^3 z(z-36)^2-J_out^2(z+12)^3=0. Thus c=2 is exactly Res(R_D,K_out)=0. In c=1, reducing each sign test in F[u]/(u^2-BD) and taking its quadratic norm replaces 24 tests by twelve explicit base-field norm equations. No mismatch candidate is excluded and no official-order computation is authorized.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 mismatch packet is one coefficient resultant
nodes.statement: Let D_*(Y)=Y^4-e_1Y^3+e_2Y^2-e_3Y+e_4 split with distinct nonzero roots. For ordered distinct roots A,C, set S=e_1-A-C, P=e_4/(AC), and Nhat(A,C)=(AC)^6 N(A;S,P), where N is the radical-free c=1 norm. Then Nhat is polynomial of bidegree at most (18,18). With H(A,C)=(D_*(C)-D_*(A))/(C-A), the twelve c=1 candidates pass iff Res_A(D_*(A),Res_C(H(A,C),Nhat(A,C)))=0. This resultant equals e_4^36 times the product of all twelve norms, so it is an exact coefficient-only constant-degree compiler, not an exclusion.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 mismatch has one normalized torsion chamber
nodes.statement: At N=2^40 and generic h=2^37+1, common subgroup scaling normalizes the repeated c=1 completion square A to one. Writing b=B/A,d=D/A,c=C/A,S=b+d,P=bd gives D_A=(Y-1)(Y-c)(Y^2-SY+P), while the canonical outer invariants scale as I_A=A^(-4h)I,J_A=A^(-6h)J. The normalized radical-free norm is A^(-(24h+12)) times the old norm. Moreover b,d,c lie in mu_N iff the forty-step recurrences T'=T^2-2P, P'=P^2, c'=c^2 end at (2,1,1). With the printed split, square, and distinctness conditions, this is an exact one-chamber (S,P,c) compiler, not an exclusion.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 parity harmonic branch is empty
nodes.statement: On the official generic c=1 two-antipodal-denominator chamber, q_out!=-1. The field router reduces the two residual harmonic source equations to 41 updates from 8/5 and 40 updates from 16 over p=1+k*2^40, 29058991<=k<33554432. A preregistered 32-shard campaign checked all 4,495,441 integer moduli, including composites, with exact coverage and no hit. This excludes harmonic c=1 parity only.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 parity harmonic field and trace router
nodes.statement: Both residual harmonic c=1 parity classes lie over q_field=p^2 with p=1 mod 2^40 and 29058991<=k<33554432 in p=1+k*2^40. The source lift descends to F_p. H_P has reciprocal trace 8/5 and requires 41 trace doublings to terminal 2; after one doubling H_R has trace 16 and requires 40 more. This gives a complete bounded two-recurrence characteristic screen, but does not itself evaluate it.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 parity nonharmonic packet has six scalar compilers
nodes.statement: On the generic c=1 two-antipodal parity chamber, the signed-factor field bound leaves q_field=p^2 with p=1 mod 2^40 and puts all square-pencil data and the unordered outer trace in F_p without assuming the source lift descends. After the constant ODE and Euclidean division R=AS+T, completion is equivalent to one of the six Mobius traces y satisfying y_39=2, S^2=(y+2)T, and the reciprocal-root-invariant gate T/q_out=W^4. Every survivor also obeys 4tH^2+y+2=0 and deg gcd(S,P_aux)>=2^36-1. This is an exact compiler, not a uniform exclusion or compute authorization.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 parity has one anti-invariant source role
nodes.statement: On the official nonharmonic c=1 parity chamber, Frobenius comparison of the six source traces gives exact anti-invariant factors. P0 is algebraically impossible; R1/R2 reduce to reciprocal trace -8 and P1/P2 to trace 6/5. A preregistered 16-shard screen covered all 2,247,721 nonsplit candidate moduli with no hit. Hence every accepted R1,R2,P0,P1,P2 lift lies in F_p. R0 is identically invariant under r->-r and remains the sole possible anti-invariant source role.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 parity R0 trace and scalar gates are lift-free
nodes.statement: For the sole potentially anti-invariant R0 role, put u=r^2 and t=u^2. Its two source traces are exactly the roots of K_t(Y)=t(Y-2)^2+4(t-1)^2. A 39-step recurrence modulo this separable quadratic is an exact lift-free outer-torsion test. Eliminating Y from S^2=(Y+2)T gives the exact scalar identity t(S^2-4T)^2+4(t-1)^2T^2=0; a common coefficient gcd enforces the same trace in both gates. Every survivor consequently obeys 4t(1+tH^2)^2+(t-1)^2=0. This does not exclude R0 or discharge its fourth-power and gcd gates.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 parity R0 has a shared two-sign Jacobi-norm interface
nodes.statement: For R0, put a=(r+r^-1)/2, x=2a^2-1, and epsilon=r^(2^40). The primary gap, source torsion, and lift-free constant gate are exactly C_(2M)^(1/4)(x)=0, the epsilon Chebyshev factor, and (1+epsilon P_(4M-1)(x)^2)^2+x^2-1=0. The even-Jacobi transform gives one degree-2^36 gcd per sign with F_epsilon=(1+epsilon zQ^2)^2+z-1. Its torsion-only resultants are exactly the existing CR-002 order-2^39 norm and 37-level plus tower, so no separate large R0 norm run is needed. The norms and signed gcds remain unevaluated.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 parity has fourteen shared-norm Jacobi tests
nodes.statement: For each c=1 parity source branch, the constant gate is h_Xj=sP with s^2=-epsilon. Eliminating r against r^4-2xr^2+1 collapses the six roles to four explicit polynomials: R0, common R1/R2, P0, and common P1/P2. The even x-sign norm then gives exactly seven degree-2^36 Jacobi gcds per torsion sign. All fourteen tests share the existing CR-002 order-2^39 minus norm and 37-level plus tower. Absence of official divisors of both norms empties the full generic two-antipodal c=1 parity packet; compatible divisors still require scalar and Euclidean replay.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 parity chamber has six outer-trace Mobius tests
nodes.statement: When the normalized c=1 denominator has two antipodal root pairs, there are exactly two source-role patterns. The even canonical outer quartic has unordered ratio trace tau_O=(alpha^2-2gamma)/gamma. Across the three perfect matchings of each source pattern, completion-root PGL matching is equivalent to one of six explicit equations tau_O=4((z+1)/(z-1))^2-2; outer torsion is a 39-step trace recurrence. At harmonic trace -2, two classes are excluded directly, leaving only two symmetry classes. The router does not exclude those classes or the nonharmonic packet.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=2 outer quartic passes a dyadic torsion-trace gate
nodes.statement: At quotient order N=2^40, every generic canonical c=2 denominator-mismatch survivor has an outer invariant cubic K_O(Z)=4I^3 Z(Z-36)^2-J^2(Z+12)^3 sharing a root with the N-torsion trace locus. In F[Z]/(K_O), start Q_0=Z-2 and iterate Q_(j+1)=Q_j^2-2 for forty steps. Then gcd(K_O,Q_40-2) is nonconstant. Each remainder has degree at most two, so this outer-only necessary gate uses forty cubic-quotient squarings and no dense Chebyshev or cyclotomic polynomial. Passage does not identify a pair of D_* roots, prove canonical span, or reconstruct a cycle.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=2 coupling and torsion meet at an actual denominator pair
nodes.statement: In the generic canonical c=2 denominator-mismatch chamber, let R_D be the degree-six resolvent of actual denominator-pair traces, K_O the degree-three outer invariant cubic, and Q_40-2 the official-order trace equation computed modulo K_O. Then G_2=gcd(K_O,R_D mod K_O,Q_40-2) is nonconstant exactly when an actual pair {A,B} has K_O((A+B)^2/(AB))=0 and (A/B)^(2^40)=1. Its distinct zeros are exactly all such pair traces and its degree is at most three. This exact selector removes outer-only false positives but does not impose canonical span, the gap equations, or cycle closure.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=2 selected pairs form one normalized torsion chamber
nodes.statement: Every actual pair selected in the generic canonical c=2 denominator-mismatch chamber can be normalized at one selected root to D_A(Y)=(Y-1)(Y-t)(Y^2-SY+P). The selected pair passes exactly when K_A((1+t)^2/t)=0 and t^(2^40)=1; forty scalar squarings compile torsion for t and both complementary roots. Reversing pair orientation is the explicit involution (t,S,P)->(t^-1,S/t,P/t^2). Thus the old six labelled pairs become one role-labelled chamber modulo this involution, while all gap, canonical-span, splitting, square-class, and cycle conditions remain.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=2 mismatch is one normalized gap-span recurrence interface
nodes.statement: On the maximal official generic c=2 mismatch chamber, E(z)=(1-z)(1-tz)(1-Sz+Pz^2) determines every fourth-root coefficient by one explicit four-term recurrence. The primary gap is a_(2H-2)=a_(2H-1)=0 with c=a_(2H) nonzero; the secondary gap is the exact two-window square LT=cC^2 mod z^H. Canonical span then uniquely reconstructs alpha=4c, beta, and gamma, and selected-pair coupling is one scalar outer-invariant equation at z_t=(1+t)^2/t. Together with the normalized torsion/split chamber this is an exact decision interface, not an exclusion or compute authorization.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=2 pure fourth-root denominators fail the official primary gap
nodes.statement: On the maximal official c=2 mismatch row, H=2^37+1 and the first required primary zero is a_(2H-2)=a_(2^38). A scaled pure fourth-root denominator normalizes to E(z)=1-z^4, whose coefficient at that index is (1/4)_(2^36)/(2^36)!. The official characteristic exceeds 2^40, so every numerator and denominator factor is nonzero. Hence the coefficient cannot vanish and this denominator geometry is excluded. No rigidity implication from the primary or secondary gaps to this geometry is asserted.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=2 parity has three traces and shares the CR-002 Jacobi norms
nodes.statement: On a two-antipodal c=2 denominator, normalize the roots to {1,-1,r,-r} and put tau=r^2. The exact primary/secondary packet is the existing univariate parity system at M=2^36. The six selected denominator pairs collapse to trace classes 0, 2+r+r^-1, and 2-r-r^-1, each twice; completion coupling is J_out=0 or the orientation-free product of the outer invariant cubic at the latter two traces. Every survivor also passes the same degree-2^36 Jacobi primary/torsion gcd and CR-002 norm pair used by matched c=0 and generic c=1 parity. This does not force general denominators to be parity or evaluate the norms.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=2 gaps alone do not force parity
nodes.statement: Over F_53 at H=8, the split squarefree quartic E(z)=1+z+11z^2+34z^3+43z^4 has a_14=a_15=0, a_16=2, and its normalized two-window product LT/2 is the square of 1+22z+49z^2+3z^3+16z^4 modulo z^8. Its four roots are not two-antipodal. Their orders are 52,13,13,52 and their square classes are mixed, so the example refutes gap-only parity forcing but not the official torsion-and-square implication.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=2 secondary gap has an equivalent differential certifier
nodes.statement: After the generic primary double gap, write B=sum_(n=0)^(2H-3) a_nz^n, b=a_(2H-3), c=a_(2H), and kappa=E_4b/c. The primary residual is exactly E'B+4EB'=-8Hc z^(2H-1)+8(H-1)E_4b z^(2H). In official characteristic, the secondary square LT=cC^2 mod z^H is equivalent to z^H dividing zE'C^2+4HEC^2+4zECC'-(4H-4(H-1)kappa z)B for one C(0)=1 of degree at most H-3. This removes the high coefficient window but does not force parity or impose torsion.

nodes.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=2 official torsion absorbs field-side gates
nodes.statement: On the maximal official c=2 row, the terminal scalar torsion equations force all normalized denominator roots into mu_(2^40). Since 2^41 divides q-1, the complementary quadratic therefore splits over F_q and every root is a square, so splitting and common square class are not independent search conditions. The field-degree collapse then leaves either prime-field descent or reciprocal Frobenius, with E_j^p=E_(4-j)/E_4 in the unitary case. This does not identify conjugate packets or force parity.

nodes.title: DSP8 nodal decoration class-discount no-go

Thus negative candidates exist only on B=0, or additionally C=0 in the moving-moving template; those exceptional loci remain for the q-slice and full quotient gates.

The moving equations are reciprocal quartics in b; exact descent to s=b+1/b makes all three corresponding saturated ideals unit. Thus no aligned positive forced-ramified candidate passes the necessary q-slice identity. Combined with the aligned-negative theorem, the complete aligned w=0 branch is empty; aligned positive w!=0 and the near-aligned homogeneous endpoint boundary remain open.

Counting these bounded-defect configurations, first-core ownership, and aggregate payment remain open.

nodes.title: XR rank-two zero baselines have divisor arity and collision-design normal form
nodes.statement: For a rank-two relation occupying a full minimal Maxwell core at an official odd reserve, exact baseline D_0=0 forces t=2s+2 with s dividing h and even D=d+1. Every defect charge vanishes, the outside extensions form an exact multiplicity-one/two collision design, all five-row cores are impossible, and four-row cores have D=2h with no inactive extensions. Exact divisor, degree-capacity, private-congruence, and a<=k arithmetic gives necessary affine-rank floors 10,10,6,8601474050,8601474050,4302648690 on the six rows. Strictly negative baselines, proper circuits, higher trade rank, nonuniform cells, and aggregate payment remain open.

nodes.title: XR five-row rank-two full cores have a negative-baseline rank floor
nodes.statement: An official rank-two relation with exactly five active rows equal to a complete minimal Maxwell core has strictly negative baseline. Its magnitude b is congruent to -5h modulo 6; zero-fiber degree capacity and disjointness give necessary affine-rank floors 9,9,6,9544371773,9544371773,4772185889 on the six rows. The exact defect window is b=e+2(3I+sigma+H), 0<=e<=h-1. Proper five-block circuits inside larger cores and surviving high-rank records remain open.

nodes.title: XR rank-two full cores have a global official-row rank floor
nodes.statement: For every official full-support rank-two minimal Maxwell core, strict negative baseline gives an exact per-arity shell and affine-rank floor from zero-fiber capacity, pair mass, disjointness, and t<=a+2. Minimizing over the official arity ranges and composing with the zero-baseline router gives all-baseline affine-rank floors 8,8,5,8590051854,8590020865,4294977670. Proper four/five-block circuits inside larger cores, surviving high-rank records, higher trade rank, nonuniform cells, and aggregate payment remain open.

nodes.title: XR proper rank-two circuits have a defect and host-core router
nodes.statement: A proper four/five-block rank-two circuit inside a minimal Maxwell core has positive deficit of the forced parity. The exact collision identity gives a proper-circuit defect lower range disjoint by one integer charge from the full-core upper range, an explicit minimum number of additional host blocks, and parity-sensitive shell cutoffs beyond which every proper owner must carry active-zero reuse, unused pair slack, or outside multiplicity at least three. Embedding and aggregate counts remain open.

nodes.title: XR prize proper rank-two circuits have a private-point rank floor
nodes.statement: For a proper four/five-block rank-two circuit in a prize-row minimal Maxwell core, the exact extension ledger lower-bounds multiplicity-one outside points by th+t(t-2)D-(2t-3)Z+2C+I. Minimal-core private-point control and the exact core-size caps then force affine ranks at least 11265488,9646193,2243389. Composing with the full-core rank floor excludes every rank-two trade below those three levels; trade rank at least three remains.

nodes.title: XR prize uniform trades have a private-point rank floor
nodes.statement: For the active blocks of any nonzero trade in a prize-row uniform minimal Maxwell core, pairwise block intersections force at least th-t(t-2)a points private within the active subfamily. Minimal-core privacy and bounded host absorption imply a>=ceil((h+1)/(2(L-2))). Hence the complete uniform P-A branch is empty through selector ranks 11243370,9629972,2241633 at rates 1/4,1/8,1/16, independent of trade rank. High-rank uniform and all nonuniform cells remain open.

nodes.title: XR uniform families have canonical first-core peeling owners
nodes.statement: A deterministic peeling process assigns every block removed from a dense one-per-slope uniform split-pencil family one canonical pointed first-Maxwell-core/trade record. Rank-two pivots additionally carry their unique fundamental four/five-block circuit. The terminal unowned residual has size at most floor((2N-2a-1)/h), which is below the 8n^3 allocation. The remaining task is to count the possible classified pointed records, handle their rank-at-least-three branch, deduplicate collision components, and extend to nonuniform cells.

nodes.title: XR mismatch descent has a global accumulated-locator flag
nodes.statement: Every canonical nongeneric XR mismatch branch lifts to original degree-below-K codeword pairs with a squarefree accumulated locator on disjoint discrepancy layers. The original witness residual factors by every locator prefix, all descendant explanation differences have the corresponding prefix divisor, total locator degree is at most K-1, and puncturing a common prefix preserves the exact residual low-core cap. This removes arbitrary overlapping locator histories from the branch compiler but does not count flags, explanations, generic terminal charts, or slopes.

nodes.title: XR mismatch terminal tangents have global pair-list owners
nodes.statement: Every terminal genuine-tangent mismatch slope is owned once by one distinct nonroot original common-support codeword-pair explanation. A fixed pair owns at most n-A slopes, so the whole tangent currency is at most (n-A)(E-1), independent of descent depth and locator-flag multiplicity. The two-fold interleaving theorem bounds E by the ordinary worst list. Generic terminal charts and the required ordinary-list estimate remain open.

nodes.title: XR terminal mismatch tangents raise agreement by one
nodes.statement: Every retained genuine tangent to a lifted A-agreement explanation supplies one discrepancy coordinate beyond that explanation's common support. Its tangent codeword therefore agrees with the original line word on at least A+1 coordinates. The union over every terminal pair is a subset of the original bad-slope set at agreement A+1, with no explanation, depth, or locator multiplier. The stricter set and generic terminal charts remain open.

nodes.title: XR agreement-raise quotient support safe sum is over budget
nodes.statement: The standard quotient-remainder support safe sum over active cells B-k<c is a valid threshold-uniform upper ledger, but at every clean XR candidate one active support-size term already exceeds B*. Thus generic support enumeration cannot pay quotient/profile migration in the agreement-raising induction. A sharper distinct-slope image/coalescing theorem, threshold-coherent first-match owner, or the static global pair-list route remains necessary; no actual quotient-union lower bound is claimed.

nodes.title: XR threshold quotient slopes have an exact radical-lcm image
nodes.statement: For any finite support family on an affine received line, pass the endpoint restrictions to F^S/(C|_S). The monic gcd of their coordinate forms is basis-independent and is either 1 or one linear bad-slope factor. The radical lcm over every quotient-remainder support and raised agreement therefore has degree exactly equal to the distinct threshold-union quotient slope image. Constructing or bounding that lcm at official scale remains open.

nodes.title: XR threshold quotient image localizes to one-point-tail tangents
nodes.statement: For one quotient fiber size and A>=k+1, every noncontained quotient-remainder support above agreement A has a profile-preserving noncontained one-point deletion unless it has remainder one and its pure-fiber predecessor is contained. Iteration shows that the threshold quotient slope image is exactly the union of the exact-A image and these remainder-one boundary factors. Every boundary factor is a genuine tangent to the predecessor's codeword pair; this node alone does not own their union.

nodes.title: XR quotient boundaries are owned by the agreement raise
nodes.statement: Across every declared quotient scale, the full threshold quotient image is contained in the union of the exact-A quotient image and the original bad-slope set at agreement A+1. Every remainder-one boundary factor has at least A pure-core agreements plus its tangent cancellation point, so quotient migration has no independent boundary-tangent debit. The exact-threshold image, raised bad set, and generic-chart aggregate remain open.

nodes.title: XR quotient first match occurs at maximum agreement
nodes.statement: At threshold A, quotient slopes with higher agreement are carried into the existing B_(A+1) term, while every remaining exact quotient slope has maximum agreement exactly A. Any A-point quotient witness for such a slope is the witness codeword's full agreement set. A deterministic scale/codeword order removes cross-threshold and representation duplication; bounding the resulting full-agreement quotient image remains open.

nodes.title: XR quotient images route by their global fiber core
nodes.statement: Across the agreement induction at rates at most 1/4, first-match maximum-agreement quotient slopes have a global key consisting of their rate-preserving scale and k-point full-fiber core. Keys used once have total count at most the existing conservative B_quot_ub(A_0). Every repeated key supplies live slopes sharing a size-k core, hence routes to P-A on the generic branch and to the existing mismatch bridge otherwise. Quotient tails, thresholds, and support counts create no separate multiplicity. [R2 ADDENDUM 2026-08-02: the key core is a SUB-core, so a repeated key certifies a shared core of size >= k; under the partition of record it routes to P-A1 (max core = k) or the band column xr_graded_tangent_band_charge (core >= k+1) on the generic branch — the former '= k' reading was under-inclusive.]

nodes.title: XR prize flat-nullity effective-core floor
nodes.statement: For a prize P-A flat-nullity cell with affine rank a and parameters u,v, deleting the persistent roots gives exact-size residual zero sets of size kappa+h with pairwise intersection at most kappa, where kappa=a+u+v. Minimal dense-core private-point counting forces kappa>=ceil((h+1)/(2(L-2))), with L=floor((2R+h-1)/h). The prize floors are 11243370,9629972,2241633; at first open ranks 16,16,14 this forces u+v>=11243354,9629956,2241619. This is a necessary effective-core floor, not a count above it.

nodes.title: XR prize flat-nullity nonpersistent-root cap
nodes.statement: For fixed nonpersistent global-root count v, the exact real envelope underlying the flat-nullity basis charge FN3 is convex in u on 0<=u<=k-a-v, so its maximum occurs at u=0 or u=k-a-v. Exact endpoint arithmetic at the first open prize affine ranks gives the necessary caps v<=1526176110,2902067939,1962285106. Combined with the effective-core floor, every over-budget first-open P-A cell lies in an explicit root-defect wedge. This is a parameter reduction, not a P-A count.

nodes.title: XR prize u=0 loop-defect Maxwell and rank-one compiler
nodes.statement: For a prize P-A u=0,v>=1 cell, deleting at most v exceptional slopes and puncturing the global roots gives a coherent GRS_a family with block size a+h+v and pair cap a+v. Every minimal dense core on t blocks has at least v(t-2)+e+1 independent trades. Its rank-one trades are exactly common-support records (S,Q,alpha), where a+1<=|S|<=a+v, deg Q<|S|-a, Q is nonzero on S, and alpha satisfies the two slope parity equations. This is a structural compiler, not an aggregate count.

nodes.title: XR prize flat-nullity Maxwell trade-space compiler
nodes.statement: After deleting at most v exceptional slopes, any prize P-A flat-nullity cell has a normalized rank-a polynomial kernel W on blocks of size a+h+u+v with pair cap a+u+v. Every minimal dense core on t blocks has at least (u+v)(t-2)+e+1 independent trades. Every rank-one trade canonically owns a shared kernel-matroid circuit C of size at most a+1 on which both received directions restrict to W. This covers arbitrary u but does not count circuit owners or pay trade rank at least two.

nodes.title: XR prize flat-nullity rank-metric trade router
nodes.statement: Compressing the two universal slope-parity checks identifies each minimal-core trade space with a subspace of (t-2) by |V| matrices without changing rank. If D=(u+v)(t-2)+e+1 exceeds (t-2-r)|V|, the rank-metric Singleton row-deletion bound forces a nonzero trade of rank at most r. At maximal flat nullity this forces rank one through prize arities 12,9,9 and rank at most two through 18,13,13. This is an existence router, not a low-rank count.

nodes.title: XR prize rank-one trade flat/basis owner
nodes.statement: For a rank-one trade, two active slopes force both received directions to restrict into W on the whole common dual support S. If S spans W, its first basis is shared by every active block, the remaining support is persistent for that basis pencil, and the active population is at most floor((R-v)/h). If rank_W(S)=j<a, its closure is a proper flat of size at most j+u, which requires u>=1. This is a canonical owner dichotomy, not an aggregate count.

nodes.title: XR prize arbitrary-W trade-circuit Segre router
nodes.statement: The row-scaling circuit bound r+2<=ell<=2r+1 is coefficient-algebraic and applies to arbitrary flat-nullity W. Every rank-two trade decomposes into rank-one three-block circuits routed to the flat/basis owner and genuine rank-two circuits on four or five blocks. Their coefficient columns have the same Mobius/Plucker and full five-point Segre atlases as in the uniform theorem. Support realization and aggregate ownership remain open.

nodes.title: XR prize arbitrary-W rank-two dual-plane support router
nodes.statement: Every arbitrary-W rank-two four/five circuit is one dual plane L in (W|X)^perp. Its row supports are complements of fibers of the base-point-free projective map [F:G] on X. Distinct coefficient directions have disjoint fibers; in a five-block circuit a direction has multiplicity at most two, and each repeated pair routes to the local-tangent basis/flat owner. Each row has a unique arbitrary-W locator certificate. Aggregate plane counting remains open.

nodes.title: XR prize flat-nullity first-core peeling owner
nodes.statement: Deterministic first-core peeling extends to every prize P-A flat-nullity cell. Repeatedly choosing the first minimal dense core, first canonical trade, and first active pivot assigns each deleted block exactly one pointed basis/flat/dual-plane owner. The terminal normalized family has size at most floor((2(R-v)-1)/h); after restoring at most v exceptional slopes, the complete unowned population is below n and already paid. Nonterminal owner counting remains open.

nodes.title: XR prize arbitrary-W rank-two received-pair router
nodes.statement: For an arbitrary-W rank-two dual plane, pairing each row with its selected-error equation gives an interaction vector annihilating the Segre coefficient columns. Five-block planes and the zero-interaction four-block branch annihilate both received directions. Every nonzero four-block interaction is a scalar multiple of the Mobius hyperplane and gives an invertible pairing with the received direction plane. These are the only trade-row interaction classes; aggregate counting remains open.

nodes.title: XR prize arbitrary-rank dual-projective support router
nodes.statement: Every support-minimal rank-r trade circuit with r>=2 is one dual r-space in (W|X)^perp and one base-point-free map X->P^(r-1), with row supports complementary to projective hyperplane sections. Its coefficient-slope columns form a projective circuit on r+2 through 2r+1 blocks, repeated coefficient directions have multiplicity at most two, and the exact received-interaction dimension is 2r-t+1. Maximal arity is augmented-orthogonal. Aggregate projective-packet counting remains open.

nodes.title: XR prize arbitrary-rank augmented-orthogonal quotient router
nodes.statement: The pairing map from any support-minimal rank-r trade row space to the two received directions has rank s in {0,1,2}. Its kernel is the augmented-orthogonal subspace of dimension r-s. At s=1 exactly one row is interactive and t<=2r-1. At s=2 every quotient coefficient is tau_i(-gamma_i,1), so the coefficient-slope quotient lies on a three-dimensional conic span. Thus every arbitrary-rank packet is an augmented-orthogonal lift of a rank-at-most-two interaction quotient. Aggregate lift counting remains open.

nodes.title: L1 official-reserve tame-refinement router
nodes.statement: Let the generated evaluation field be F_(p^f), with n=2^m>=2^13, n|p^f-1, p^f<2^256, and k<=n/2. Given any corrected-reserve threshold sigma, reduce by exact-shell monotonicity to the least threshold sigma_0 for eta=min(epsilon,1/4), and put ell_0=sigma_0+1. The power-of-two order bound ord_n(p)>=n/(p+1), the field cap (which excludes p=3,5), and binom(n,a)<=2^n give ell_0<=ceil(5(p+1)/(4 log_2 p))+1<p. Hence p does not divide ell_0/s for any s|ell_0. Every whole-petal refinement at the canonical official cutoff is tame, so the fixed-petal census counts all map classes by at most M_src tau(ell_0)<=n. Wild fixed-petal decomposition is removed from the L1 frontier; role/support payment, partial fibers, unanchored maps, and arbitrary locators remain open.

nodes.title: L1 official Newton cofactor-window router
nodes.statement: Let the generated field be F_(p^f), with n=2^m>=2^13, n|p^f-1, p^f<2^256, and official rate. Exact order arithmetic forces p>=3583: the cap first gives p>=257 and ord_8192(p)<=16, hence p=+-1 mod 512; every such integer below 3583 has an explicit factor. The canonical reserve bound then gives ell_0<=ceil(5(p+1)/(4 log_2 p))+1<=p-3174. For a normalized received polynomial of degree h and canonical threshold a_0=k+ell_0-1, if e_0=h-a_0<=p-ell_0, every exact shell a>=a_0 has fixed-cofactor locator-prefix depth d=min(a,h-k)<p. Newton identities therefore give a bijective coordinate change from that locator prefix to the first d power sums. This covers at least excess layers 0<=e_0<=3174, and all received words when p>=n-k. It supplies a typed power-sum Q cell, not prefix flatness or Pade-graph coalescing.

nodes.title: L1 official Frobenius-checkpoint Q router
nodes.statement: Under the official generated-field hypotheses, the order bound, strict field cap, and p>=3583 imply p>=11n/256>n/24. Hence any locator-prefix depth d<=n-1 crosses at most floor(d/p)<=23 positive multiples of the characteristic. For a root set A, replace each power sum S_j at p|j by the elementary checkpoint E_j, retaining S_j at p not dividing j. Newton recursion together with S_(pj)=S_j^p gives a triangular coordinate equivalence between the first d elementary symmetric functions and these d mixed coordinates. Therefore every arbitrary-depth fixed-cofactor locator-prefix cell is exactly a p-free power-sum Q cell conditioned on at most 23 Frobenius checkpoints. Each mixed fiber lies in its coarse p-free fiber, so direct coarse-fiber flatness transfers with no loss. A raw conditional union costs less than n^453 qualitatively but cannot certify the finite q/2^128 threshold once a checkpoint is present. This is a coordinate and accounting router, not a max-fiber or Pade-graph theorem.

nodes.title: L1 official coarse p-free entropy reserve
nodes.statement: At every official scalar locator-prefix depth d containing a Frobenius checkpoint, the first such depth is at least 3175 layers beyond the canonical reserve and at most 23 checkpoints have been forgotten. Since every consecutive binomial ratio is below 15 and q>n>=2^13, the ambient coarse p-free average satisfies mu_free(d)/mu_mix(d0)<2^-28276 and hence mu_free(d)<2^-28276. Therefore ambient max-to-average inflation K_d<=q*2^28148 is sufficient for max coarse fiber <q/2^128. More sharply, generated-field degree f>=2 and the canonical depth estimate show that an exactly owner-pruned extras residual with max Exc_d<=2^(15(d-r))mu_free(d) is below 2^-3393 and hence empty; this does not apply to the full nonempty fiber, and 16 bits per condition do not follow from the same coarse inequalities. The F2 15-bit endpoint is arithmetically compatible but its zero target, structured subtraction, map, and owner are not transported. This proves no max-fiber flatness, Pade-graph coalescing, or L1.

nodes.title: L1 coarse p-free Wronskian distance packing
nodes.statement: For a finite-field n-set H, let Phi_free send each a-subset A to its p-free power sums through depth d<=a. Frobenius recovers equality of all moments through d inside any fiber. If distinct A,B in one fiber have disjoint tails X=A\B and Y=B\A of common size t, the locator Wronskian F_X'F_Y-F_XF_Y' is nonzero and has degree at most 2t-d-2, so t>=ceil((d+2)/2). Consequently every fiber has size at most floor(binom(n,s)/binom(a,s)), where s=a-ceil((d+2)/2)+1; for scalar L1 with a=k+d this is s=floor((a+k)/2). The half-depth distance is sharp over F_4. If a+k>=n, the cap is at least 2^(n-a), so under q<2^256 it cannot itself pay a cell with n-a>=128. This is a coarse-fiber statement: exact mixed/Pade prefixes already have the stronger tail bound d+1. It does not prove row-sharp Q, Pade-graph coalescing, or L1.

nodes.title: L1 official first-checkpoint split-pencil reduction
nodes.statement: On an official multiplicative-coset domain, let p<=d<=2p-2 and suppose a minimum-width coarse p-free collision has disjoint tails of size t=p. The tail locators must differ by a nonzero constant and have the exact form F_X=Z^p+Q+b, F_Y=Z^p+Q+b+c with deg Q<=r_d=2p-d-1. Conversely every disjoint fully split pair of this form gives the required moment collision. On the nonzero one of the two fibers, every nonidentity multiplicative ratio has at most r_d witnesses, so its ratio set has size at least 1+ceil((p^2-p)/r_d). Hence no t=p collision exists when r_d<=r_*(p,n)=floor((p(p-1)-1)/(n-1)), equivalently d>=2p-1-r_*(p,n). The official inequality 11n<=256p gives the uniform floor r_*>=floor(11(p-1)/256). The terminal affine-line case is an independent structural check. The surviving lower-depth object is a typed higher-degree split-pencil census, not a proved row-sharp bound.

nodes.title: L1 official split-pencil value capacity
nodes.statement: Fix a normalized perturbation P(Z)=Z^p+Q(Z), deg Q<p, on an official n-point multiplicative coset. Distinct fully split degree-p fibers are disjoint, giving at most floor(n/p)<=23 split values. The gcd G_Q(T) of the coefficient remainders of (Z^n-alpha) mod (P-T) is exactly their squarefree value polynomial and has degree at most 23; pair existence forces a narrow-matrix rank defect. If 2p>n no pair exists. In the m=2 band, a complement locator C uniquely determines the pair through (Z^n-alpha)/C=R^2+c. Polynomial Mason-Stothers, retaining its Frobenius-degenerate branch, proves that such a pair forces n=2p+2. Every pair is then indexed by an antipodal complement C=Z^2-b, with R=Z*C^((p-1)/2), c=b^p, and locators R+-delta. There are exactly n/2 unordered pairs, occurring only at depths p and p+1. Hence all broader m=2 minimum-width strata are empty. The result does not control m>=3 perturbations, higher widths, or the full L1 fiber.

nodes.title: L1 official checkpoint characteristic atlas
nodes.statement: For every official order n=2^s with 13<=s<=44, generated-field characteristic p<n, n|p^f-1, and p^f<2^256, the proved floor p>=3583 forces ord_n(p) in {1,2,4,8,16}. Enumerating the 32 low-order residues +-5^(j*2^(s-6)) and applying exact primality and field-cap filters gives precisely 59 possible (n,p) pairs. Their floor(n/p) histogram is {1:33,2:10,3:4,4:4,5:2,7:1,8:4,16:1}. The split-value theorems make 33 m=1 and six broad m=2 minimum-width strata empty; four remainder-two m=2 rows have exactly n/2 antipodal pairs; only 16 m>=3 rows retain a general minimum-width endpoint. No m<=2 compute remains. This is an exhaustive arithmetic router, not a higher-width or L1 bound.

nodes.title: L1 official maximal split-value complement census
nodes.statement: For every actual split-value degree 2<=h<=m=floor(n/p) in an official first-checkpoint Frobenius pencil, the degree-u complement C, u=n-hp, uniquely determines the normalized perturbation Q. At depth d, its top d-p nonleading coefficients vanish, so with ell_h=u-d+p there are at most floor(binom(n,ell_h)/binom(u,ell_h)) normalized records and binom(h,2) times that many unordered fiber pairs. After depressing the outer polynomial, polynomial Mason-Stothers gives ord_0(R)<=u-p or u e_h<=p, where h e_h+1=0 mod p. At h=m all 16 official m>=3 rows violate the only possible arm, so maximal capacity is empty at every depth. The lower-h exponent can still grow; higher tail widths and the full L1 fiber remain open.

nodes.title: L1 official broad-checkpoint Frobenius periodicity exclusion
nodes.statement: For a minimum-width split-fiber pair on an official multiplicative coset, the balanced {0,+1,-1} exponent word over F_p has Fourier zeros at exponents 0,...,p-1. Frobenius closes this zero set under multiplication by p modulo n. On each of the seven exact m>=3 atlas rows with remainder n-mp>16, every residual frequency is divisible by a printed even gcd in {2,4,8}. Fourier inversion then makes each sign support periodic with even orbit size, contradicting its odd size p. Thus all seven broad rows have empty t=p first-checkpoint strata at every depth. Only nine rows n=m(p+1), m in {4,8,16}, retain a higher-multiplicity minimum-width endpoint.

nodes.title: L1 coarse p-free Wronskian neighbor compiler
nodes.statement: Fix an anchor A in a coarse p-free depth-d fiber and a t-subset X of A exchanged by a neighbor B. The collision Wronskian W=F_X'F_Y-F_XF_Y' is nonzero, has degree at most D_t=2t-d-2, and is nonzero on X union Y. For fixed X, W determines the monic opposing tail F_Y uniquely. The exact number of degree-at-most-D certificates nonzero on X is R_q(t,D)=sum_j (-1)^j binom(t,j)q^max(D+1-j,0), giving the arbitrary-target neighbor bound 1+sum_(t>=tau_p) binom(a,t)min(binom(n-a,t),R_q(t,2t-d-2)), where tau_p=max(ceil((d+2)/2),min(d+1,p)). At formal half-depth excess j, certificate degree is 2j for even d and 2j+1 for odd d, but tame-tail strata below tau_p are empty. The exchanged-subset choice can remain exponential, so this compiler does not prove row-sharp Q, Pade coalescing, or L1.

nodes.title: L1 identity-pullback role-payment fence
nodes.statement: For the degree-one pullback P=X, every domain point is a complete singleton fiber: B=D, the unique quotient component is the original polynomial, the quotient receiver is U, kappa=0, and every codeword has partial loss z=0. Thus the common-support one-interleaved quotient list at agreement a is exactly ImgFib_U(a). Every source petal is automatically a union of singleton fibers, and at the canonical official cutoff ell<char(F), so this endpoint belongs to the anchored tame family. Therefore a theorem paying all anchored tame fiber-role assignments already contains the original L1 list bound at s=1; an s>=2 classification cannot close L1 without a separate global exact-shell/Toeplitz theorem.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne-checkpoint cyclotomic normal form
nodes.statement: On each of the nine surviving first-checkpoint rows, write N=p+1, n=mN, and k=qN+b with m in {4,8,16}. Multiplication by p sends (q,0) to (-q,0), sends (q,b) to (b-q-1,N-b) for b>0, and its square sends (q,b) to (q-2b,b). If S is the p-cyclotomic closure of [0,p-1] and g_b=gcd(2b,m), then (q,0) lies in S exactly for q=0, while (q,b) lies in S exactly when q is congruent to 0 or b-1 modulo g_b. The Fourier-complement sizes are 2N+1, 9N/2+1, and 37N/4+1. In particular N consecutive frequencies vanish, so every nonzero signed word has support at least N+1. A checkpoint pair has exact support 2N-2. This is a low-weight cyclic-code normal form, not a row exclusion or L1 bound.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne-checkpoint embedded two-fiber family
nodes.statement: For each of the nine rows n=m(p+1), the order-n multiplicative coset partitions into m/2 cosets of its unique subgroup of order 2(p+1). Applying the exact antipodal m=2 construction in each subgroup coset gives p+1 unordered split-fiber pairs per coset, hence exactly n/2 explicit embedded pairs. Their normalized perturbation has degree p-2, so they occur at checkpoint depths p and p+1. The inner polynomial is odd, zero is not split, and nonzero split values occur in sign pairs. Since maximal degree h=m is impossible, embedded pencils have exactly h=2 when m=4 and only even h<m in general. This is a necessary polynomial lower family, not an exhaustive h=2 classification, a nonembedded h>=3 exclusion, or an L1 bound.

nodes.title: L1 m=4, h=3 colored cyclic-code equivalence
nodes.statement: On each of the four official rows n=4(p+1), exact split-value degree h=3 is equivalent to a word with coefficients in {0,1,omega,omega^2}, each nonzero color occurring p times, such that both the word and its coefficientwise square lie in the explicit Mersenne cyclic code. nodes.statement: For a hypothetical exact h=3 pencil on an official row n=4(p+1), depress the outer cubic and write (R^3+aR+b)D=X^n-alpha with deg R=p and deg D=p+4. Hence every repeated-root or overlap defect is localized at at most 4-nu points and the total defect is at most 4-nu. nodes.notes: Exact equivalence only on alpha!=0. The exceptional x=0 and q=-6x^2 slopes remain in their separately owned finite branches. No generic unit verdict is claimed.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-zero linear-color exclusion
nodes.statement: On every m=8,h=7 and m=16,h=15 next-to-maximal order-zero HNF row, the colored Frobenius interpolant has degree at least two. The constant case forces Frobenius descent, while a linear interpolant makes P_s an affine image of mu_m minus one color and forces s into the prime field.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-zero quadratic collision router
nodes.statement: A quadratic order-zero colored Frobenius interpolant with two repeated colors must be even. On every m=8,h=7 endpoint row it has at most one repeated color, so its seven roots use at least six distinct colors. The collision-free, single-collision, and m=16 even branches remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-zero quadratic collision-free exclusion
nodes.statement: A quadratic order-zero colored Frobenius interpolant cannot be injective on the roots of P_s. Quotienting its reflection makes the locator a punctured-cyclotomic linear template, whose first three coefficients force s into the prime field.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-zero quadratic exclusion
nodes.statement: On all four official m=8,h=7 endpoint rows, no quadratic order-zero colored Frobenius interpolant survives. The exact-one-repeat color moments impose 21 quadratics on s, each coprime to the mandatory constant-coefficient n-torsion condition.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=16 order-zero single-collision exclusion
nodes.statement: On the official m=16,h=15 endpoint row, a quadratic order-zero colored Frobenius interpolant cannot have exactly one repeated color. Every remaining quadratic candidate is even and has at least two antipodal repeated-color pairs.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=16 order-zero even-quadratic exclusion
nodes.statement: The final even multi-repeat quadratic color system is empty on the official m=16,h=15 endpoint. Its odd/even locator gcd would have degree at least two, but the first-subresultant coefficients can vanish together only at prime-field values of s.

nodes.title: Budget-three common direction zeros always agree with the received word
nodes.statement: For every four-codeword budget-three predecessor witness and every selected-support pattern supplied by the intersection reduction, n_0=0 makes the selected agreement sets cover D. At a common zero of the direction code all four codeword values coincide, and coverage makes at least one of them equal to the received value. Hence every common zero is a common agreement and the rank-flat mismatch parameter is exactly b=0 in all six incidence types and thirteen edge-degree chambers.

nodes.title: Budget-three rank-flat chamber bridge is a route fence
nodes.statement: For every four-codeword budget-three predecessor witness in RS[F,D,2d], |D|=4d and d>=3, affine rank is three and common mismatch is b=0. Every six-type incidence pattern has a pair agreeing on exactly 2d-1 coordinates, so d_1=2d+1, and has a selected triple intersection of size at least d-1, so d_2<=3d+1. With 2d+3<=d_3<=4d, the rank-flat expression is strictly greater than four: x(x-1)(x-2)>8d^2(x-d-1) for x=d_3. Hence its integer cap is at least four in all thirteen chambers and the harvested compiler cannot prove the predecessor cap three. The bridge is closed as a route fence, not a chamber exclusion.
nodes.falsifier: A valid six-type tuple with d_1=2d+1, d_2<=3d+1, 2d+3<=d_3<=4d, b=0, and rank-flat integer cap at most three.
nodes.notes: Reconciled after canonical f2634a1f. The local affine-rank theorem makes the canonical s=2 program vacuous; the common-mismatch theorem gives b=0; exact incidence arithmetic proves the remaining rank-flat route cannot bite. Wired ev to rate_half_list_adjacent_crossing because it closes only a harvested proof route. MI2 remains scope-mismatched and unnecessary.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-zero reciprocal elimination
nodes.statement: The complete m=8,h=7 order-zero outer HNF chamber is empty on all four official rows. Two low-index Frobenius-reciprocal eliminants have a degree-1032 gcd whose roots are all prime-field values of s.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=16 order-zero reciprocal elimination
nodes.statement: The complete m=16,h=15 order-zero outer HNF chamber is empty on the official (n,p)=(131072,8191) row. The first three Frobenius-reciprocal coefficient equations give eliminants of degrees 11472 and 15296. Their degree-9912 gcd has squarefree radical s(s-1) product_(j=1)^15(s+j), so every common solution has s in F_8191, contradicting the HNF condition.
nodes.notes: Exact bounded computer algebra, not a field-element scan: the primary resultant construction and an independent companion-matrix/Newton construction reproduce both eliminants, their gcd, and the degree-17 radical. Closes order zero only; order one and global L1 remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one involution-component exclusion
nodes.statement: For odd h, h!*Phi_h(rho,c) is divisible by rho*c*(c-1)*(c+1). The order-one chamber already excludes the first three factors, while c=-1 contradicts (c-1)^n=1 on all five official next-to-maximal rows because the order of 2 modulo p=2^q-1 is the odd prime q and n is a power of two. Thus the order-one curve reduces to Psi_7=0 of bidegree (2,4) or Psi_15=0 of bidegree (6,12).
nodes.notes: Exact analytic component exclusion. The Modal factorization is discovery evidence; the stdlib verifier reconstructs the coefficient polynomials and the official torsion contradiction. The residual order-one curves remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one Newton reciprocal reduction
nodes.statement: For the reduced order-one roots x_i, the jth reciprocal coefficient equation is exactly e_j((x_i^star)^m)=e_j(x_i^(-m)). Newton identities therefore construct the first three necessary equations from traces at m,2m,3m, and the H-1 interior equations plus the constant-product equation are equivalent to the full reduced reciprocal identity. No generic mth-power resultant is required.
nodes.notes: Exact resultant-free reformulation. The first-three trace system is necessary only; parameter elimination and the pointwise Frobenius/cyclotomic/inner tests remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one full-trace cancellation
nodes.statement: The automatic order-one root x_0=-1/(c-1) contributes identically to every star and inverse m-power trace because c_star-1=zeta/(c-1), zeta^m=1, and m is even. Hence the first r reduced reciprocal equations are exactly the first r full-P trace equalities. The first-three system can be generated from the original degree-h polynomial without division by the known root or construction of Qtilde.
nodes.notes: Exact representation reduction inside the proved order-one Frobenius gate. It removes the quotient-division representation, not the parameter elimination or any pointwise outer/inner condition.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one conic reduction
nodes.statement: For h=7, the residual order-one curve is 35u^2+14(11c^2+5c+11)u+120(c^4+c^2+1)=0 with u=rho*c*(c-1). Completing the square gives the reciprocal quartic D(c)=7(5u+A)^2. Under z=c+c^-1 and w=(5u+A)/c it is the conic 7w^2=247z^2+770z+775, followed by the single quadratic pullback c^2-zc+1=0.
nodes.notes: Exact h=7 geometry reduction. The conic chart retains its quadratic c-pullback and finite exceptional charts; reciprocal, Frobenius, torsion, cyclotomic, and inner conditions remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one base-field conic router
nodes.statement: On the h=7 conic, both z=-1 points are excluded by the non-prime-field invariant. If the remaining line parameter t lies in F_p, Frobenius forces zeta=2-z; official Mersenne congruences then force zeta=-1 and z=3. This branch is empty at p=8191,131071 and reduces at p=524287,2147483647 to at most the two signs in 7w^2=5308, with c^2-3c+1=0 and rho^p=-c*rho.
nodes.notes: Exact branch router only. The two larger-row sign packets still owe every trace/cyclotomic/inner condition, and t outside the prime field is untouched.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one base-field branch exclusion
nodes.statement: The complete t in F_p branch of the m=8,h=7 order-one conic is empty. On the two residual rows, P^[p](W)=-P(1-W), so every root x has both x and 1-x in mu_n. Their p+1 colors reduce from mu_8 to three surviving real color pairs, giving at most six possible roots, while the degree-seven divisor P has seven distinct roots.
nodes.notes: Complete proof close of one h=7 branch. The non-base-field conic parameter and every other declared L1 chamber remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one constant-color exclusion
nodes.statement: On every official m=8,h=7 order-one row, the six roots left after removing the automatic root cannot all have the same p+1 Frobenius color. The first two colored reciprocal coefficient equations force rho*c=1-alpha and then 30alpha(c-1)=(alpha+1)zeta+12alpha^2. Its F_(p^2)/F_p norm equation has no solution at any eighth-root trace in an official characteristic.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one linear-color exclusion
nodes.statement: On all five official next-to-maximal order-one rows, the colored Frobenius interpolant on the reduced roots cannot have degree one. If E(W)=aW+b, its injective colors all satisfy the quadratic -(b^p+a^(p+1))X^2+(1+b^(p+1))X-b=0, contradicting the six or fourteen distinct colors required.
nodes.notes: Complete exclusion of degree one only. Combined with the m=8 constant-color theorem, the active h=7 branch starts at color degree two; h=15 still has a constant-color chamber.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one quadratic-collision router
nodes.statement: For a quadratic colored Frobenius interpolant on the six reduced h=7 roots, two repeated colors force an even interpolant and exactly two antipodal repeated pairs. This chamber also satisfies r(18+d-d^2)+192=0 for d=c-1 and r=rho*c. The complete quadratic residue splits into collision-free, one-repeat, and this two-antipodal chamber.
nodes.notes: Exact degree-two router, not an emptiness theorem. The two-antipodal chamber has one additional scalar equation; collision-free and one-repeat chambers remain independent.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one quadratic two-pair univariate reduction
nodes.statement: In the two-antipodal-pair quadratic color chamber, eliminating r=rho*c between the collision equation and the h=7 conic gives the fixed degree-eight polynomial F(d)=5d^8+10d^7-180d^6+672d^5+2862d^4-15516d^3+8199d^2-44172d+4860. Closure reduces to 32 degree-eight norm-color gcds.
nodes.notes: Exact univariate reduction only. The 32 gcd verdicts are unrun because Modal is spend-blocked; other quadratic collision patterns and all inner conditions remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one quadratic color resultant
nodes.statement: The pointwise equations for a quadratic colored Frobenius interpolant give an explicit degree-six polynomial R_E in the color. This excludes the complete m=16,h=15 quadratic stratum because fourteen roots require at least seven distinct colors. At m=8,h=7, R_E exactly equals the six-color multiset polynomial, including collision multiplicities.
nodes.notes: Complete proof close of color degree two at h=15 and an exact color-multiset router at h=7. The h=7 coefficient systems and all assignment/cyclotomic/inner tests remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one color-degree barrier
nodes.statement: For a nonconstant degree-d rootwise colored Frobenius interpolant on H reduced roots, the pointwise equations define plane curves of degrees d and d+1 with no common component, so H<=d(d+1). Thus h=7 starts at degree two and h=15 starts at degree four; the h=15 cubic chamber is empty.
nodes.notes: Exact degree barrier only. Equality or larger degree does not imply existence; h=15 constant and degrees four through thirteen remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=16 order-one constant-color reduction
nodes.statement: On the official m=16,h=15 row, a constant color forces rho*c=1-alpha and 182alpha(c-1)=(alpha+1)zeta+28alpha^2. Norm contraction reduces the chamber to two explicit quadratic gcds against the degree-nine mu_16 trace polynomial over F_8191.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=16 order-one constant-color exclusion
nodes.statement: Both quadratic trace gcds from the h=15 constant-color reduction are unit over F_8191. Direct lower-factor values and primitive-quartic pseudo-remainders with terminal residues 4509 and 4947 exclude every sixteenth-root trace, closing the complete constant-color chamber.
nodes.notes: Complete proof close of the h=15 constant-color stratum. Combined with the degree barrier, live h=15 color degrees are four through thirteen; cyclotomic and inner conditions remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one quadratic pointwise composition
nodes.statement: For every h=7 quadratic colored interpolant E=AW^2+BW+C, the pointwise Frobenius equations give A^pE^3+B^pWE^2+C^pW^2E-W^2=A^pA^3L. Comparing top and bottom coefficients forces C/A=(1-rho*c)/(c-1)^2 and the pure HNF equation g(1)=(1-rho*c)^3.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one quadratic HNF intersection
nodes.statement: Combining the quadratic pointwise equation g(1)=(1-rho*c)^3 with the h=7 residual conic eliminates r=rho*c into the fixed degree-fourteen polynomial R_2(d)=(a_0c_1-c_0a_1)^2-(a_0b_1-b_0a_1)(b_0c_1-c_0b_1), whose leading coefficient is -691200. Complete degree-two closure reduces to 32 norm-fiber gcds.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic two-triple reduction
nodes.statement: If a cubic colored interpolant sends the six reduced h=7 roots to exactly two colors with multiplicities 3+3, the two full cubic fibers factor L. Coefficient comparison adds q_2(d)r^2+q_1(d)r+q_0(d)=0; intersecting it with the residual conic gives the fixed degree-fourteen polynomial R_33 with leading coefficient -576000 and 32 norm-fiber gcd endpoints.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic two-triple exclusion
nodes.statement: The W^2 coefficient of the exact two-cubic-fiber factorization forces rd+4(d^2+3d+3)=0. Combining this with the h=7 conic and the prior second quadratic leaves only (2d+3)(d+3)=0; the two base-field norms 9/4 and 9 are not eighth roots on any official row. Thus the cubic color partition 3+3 is empty.
nodes.notes: Exact proof-only exclusion of the 3+3 cubic color partition. It retires the 32 norm-gcd packets queued by the predecessor but says nothing about other cubic partitions.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-color remainder router
nodes.statement: After the cubic 3+3 exclusion, exact three-color cubic packets have profile 3+2+1 or 2+2+2. Cyclic color rotation reduces the 56 unordered color triples to seven representatives; each packet satisfies the h=7 conic, the six-coefficient remainder L | product_(j in T)(E-omega^j), three nonempty-fiber resultants, and its norm-color equation.
nodes.notes: Exact bounded necessary router only. No one of the seven orbit systems is declared empty, and four-or-more-color cubic packets remain outside its scope.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-double factor reduction
nodes.statement: In the cubic 2+2+2 profile, the three double fibers factor L into quadratics F_i=W^2+u_iW+u_i^2-Uu_i+V belonging to one two-parameter family. Their external roots are y_i=u_i-U, and the three constants w+(u_i^2-Uu_i+V)(u_i-U) obey the scale-free ratio of the chosen three eighth-root colors.
nodes.notes: Exact low-degree necessary factor model for 2+2+2 only. It replaces the generic degree-nine remainder but supplies no emptiness verdict.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-double symmetric compiler
nodes.statement: Writing s_1,s_2,s_3 for the elementary symmetric functions of the three quadratic-fiber parameters, l_1,l_2,l_3 solve triangularly for s_1,V,s_3. The printed formulas for l_4,l_5,l_6 then give three exact equations in only (U,s_2,r,d); with the h=7 conic, the cubic 2+2+2 p-free core is a square four-equation system.
nodes.notes: Exact coefficient compiler only. Square counts equations and variables but is not a dimension or unit-ideal verdict; all color, norm, Frobenius, cyclotomic, and inner filters remain open.

nodes.statement: With q=dr, a=dU, b=d^2s_2, and x=a-3, the h=7 cubic 2+2+2 core consists of the residual conic, one quadratic D_b in b, and two equations affine-linear in b after exact reduction modulo D_b. The fifth-equation slope is -x(x^2+q/6), separating the exceptional branches x=0 and q=-6x^2 from a generic three-variable elimination.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-double q=-6x^2 degree-12 reduction
nodes.statement: On the exceptional q=-6x^2 branch, the h=7 conic and reduced fifth coefficient force every cubic 2+2+2 packet onto R_12(d)=105F(d)^2+7A(d)F(d)E(d)+10B(d)E(d)^2=0, an explicit degree-12 polynomial with leading coefficient 149868.
