nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-two-one factor reduction
nodes.statement: For a cubic 3+2+1 packet, the triple color gives a monic cubic factor F of L=FG. On the complementary cubic G, F takes values B,B,lambda B, where lambda=(gamma-alpha)/(beta-alpha); hence Res_W(G,X-F)=X^3-(2+lambda)BX^2+(1+2lambda)B^2X-lambda B^3. Seven color orbits and six role assignments give at most 42 packets.
nodes.notes: Exact low-degree necessary factor model for 3+2+1 only. No factor packet is declared empty and all norm, Frobenius, cyclotomic, and inner filters remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-two-one common-quadratic compiler
nodes.statement: In a cubic 3+2+1 packet, exact double multiplicity gives a common monic quadratic Q with G=Q(W)(W-y) and F-B=Q(W)(W-z). Writing a=y-z, one has F=G+aQ+B and aQ(y)=(lambda-1)B. The first three HNF coefficients eliminate a,g_2,B triangularly, leaving five exact equations in only (g_1,y,r,d) for each role value lambda.
nodes.notes: Exact factor and triangular coefficient compiler only. No one of the at most 42 role packets is declared empty, and all norm, Frobenius, cyclotomic, and inner filters remain open.

nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic collision-free value router
nodes.statement: For a collision-free cubic interpolant, the monic value resultant V_E=Res_W(L,X-E) is the product of the six used eighth-root colors. Multiplying by the quadratic for the missing pair gives V_E M_delta=X^8-1; cyclic translation reduces the 28 missing pairs to four distance packets delta=1,2,3,4.

nodes.statement: For four- or five-color cubic packets, let M be the squarefree missing-color product and D the excess-multiplicity product. The exact identity Res_W(L,X-E)M=(X^8-1)D yields 35 cyclic packets for 2+1+1+1+1, 35 for 3+1+1+1, and 54 for 2+2+1+1, for 124 p-free systems total.

nodes.title: WCL (4,11) quintic-divisor descent
nodes.statement: Let char K = 0 or > 11, omega of exact order 2048. For a reduced signed weight-11 relation rho_i = s_i omega^{e_i} with p_1=p_3=p_5=p_7=0: since gcd(11,2048)=1 with 11^{-1}=931 mod 2048, the global dilation lambda = a_11^{-931} uniquely normalises the product to one. Newton then gives e_1=e_3=e_5=e_7=0 and e_11=1. The odd indices at most 9 are {1,3,5,7,9}, all pinned at w=9; at w=11 they are {1,3,5,7,9,11} and e_9 is FREE. Hence the locator is F(X)=X B(X^2)-(e_9 X^2+1) with B a monic QUINTIC (six parameters, against four at (4,9)), the square locator is G(Y)=Y B(Y)^2-(e_9 Y+1)^2 = prod (Y-(lambda rho_i)^2), monic of degree 11 and dividing Y^1024-1, and the reconstruction is rho=(e_9 y+1)/B(y). The elimination endpoint (Y^1024-1) mod G gives 11 relations R_j in Z[b_0..b_4,e_9], six unknowns. The CONVERSE also holds under the side condition gcd(B(Y), e_9 Y+1)=1 (vacuous at e_9=0): G is squarefree, B is nonzero at every root of G, the eleven reconstructed rho are distinct, pairwise non-antipodal and are exactly F's roots, their product is one because F(0)=-1 identically, the window conditions are recovered from F's missing X^10,X^8,X^6,X^4 terms via Newton, and rho^2 in mu_1024 forces rho in mu_2048 hence the signed form s*omega^e with e<1024. So common-dilation orbits of (4,11) relations are IN BIJECTION with pairs (B,e_9) satisfying the side condition and the divisibility -- the exact analogue of the (4,9) quartic bijection. OWED: the Delta certificate, harder in shape than (4,9)'s at 11 relations in 6 unknowns against 9 in 4.

Characteristic-zero emptiness and a scheme-equivalent 142-variable, 147-equation cubic lift are already proved by the extended six-slot endpoint.

The even parity obstruction concerns only that normalization: (4,10) already has its exact E^2-YB^2 descent. nodes.title: WCL (4,10) even-weight divisor descent
nodes.statement: Let char K = 0 or > 10, omega of exact order 2048, and let a reduced signed weight-10 relation satisfy the ell=4 window p_1=p_3=p_5=p_7=0. Since gcd(10,2048)=2 the global dilation used at (4,9) and (4,11) does NOT exist -- but the even case needs no normalisation at all. Newton gives e_1=e_3=e_5=e_7=0; the odd indices at most 10 are {1,3,5,7,9}, so e_9 survives and e_10 = prod rho is free. Hence F(X) = E(X^2) - e_9 X with E(T)=T^5+e_2T^4+e_4T^3+e_6T^2+e_8T+e_10 monic quintic -- the single odd term sits INSIDE the even part, unlike the odd cells where X sits outside. e_9 != 0 is AUTOMATIC: e_9 = 0 makes F even, so roots fall into antipodal pairs, which reducedness forbids. Squaring E(rho^2) = e_9 rho gives the square locator G(Y) = E(Y)^2 - e_9^2 Y, monic of degree 10, equal to prod (Y - rho_i^2) and dividing Y^1024 - 1, with reconstruction rho = E(y)/e_9. The elimination endpoint is ten relations in six unknowns. OWED: the Delta certificate, subject to the same feasibility caveat as (4,9)/(4,11).

nodes.notes: Minted 2026-07-27. The parity dichotomy flagged (4,10) as obstructed (gcd(10,2048)=2) and predicted it would need a sub-tuple router in the style of the closed (2,5)/(2,6). nodes.title: L1 Mersenne HNF payoff-scope router

nodes.title: DLI norm gate, forward direction: a block-U skew/relation solution forces q^o | Norm in Z[zeta_n], with the basis-range hypothesis load-bearing, plus the determinant-free evaluation form
nodes.statement: Let n=2^s>=4, h=phi(n)=n/2, Z[zeta_n]=Z[x]/(x^h+1), q an odd prime with n | q-1, and zeta in F_q of exact order n. (LN0) x^h+1 splits mod q into h distinct linear factors (x-zeta^j), j odd mod n, so q is unramified, the h primes p_j=ker(zeta_n->zeta^j) are distinct of residue degree 1 and norm q, and Gal=(Z/n)^* permutes them SIMPLY TRANSITIVELY via sigma_a^{-1}(p_j)=p_{ja}; q odd with n a power of two gives unramifiedness and n | q-1 gives residue degree 1 -- both hypotheses are used. (LN1) If alpha=sum_{i in G} eps_i zeta_n^i with G inside the BASIS RANGE [0,h) and eps in {+-1}^G satisfies alpha(zeta)=0 in F_q, then Norm(alpha) != 0 and q | Norm(alpha); the basis-range hypothesis is LOAD-BEARING (an opposite pair {i,i+h} folds to the zero element, Norm 0), and it is exactly the banked C1 reduced-signed-support clause, satisfied by construction at every junction of the DLI tower. (LN2) If in addition alpha(zeta^u)=0 for every u in U with |U|=o, then q^o | Norm(alpha) != 0; more generally v_q(Norm(alpha)) >= m(alpha) := #{j odd : alpha(zeta^j)=0}. Two independent proofs: Hensel-lifting x^h+1 over Z_q (elementary), and the o primes p_u being pairwise distinct by simple transitivity. Official instantiation: at junction j, U_j={odd u : u 2^j <= t}, so every nonzero junction-j skew has q^{L_j} | Norm != 0. (LN3) Norm(alpha) = prod_{j odd mod n} alpha(zeta^j) in F_q, so q | Norm iff m(alpha)>=1 -- the measurement is h modular evaluations, not an hxh determinant. At t=2 the junction-0 block is U_0={1} with columns zeta^i, i in Z/(n/2), so a junction-0 C2'' skew solution IS a C1 ternary relation at 2N=n; the two censuses agree byte-for-byte where they overlap. NOT claimed: any converse (q^o | Norm does not imply a U-solution), any statement outside the basis range, any upper bound on Norm, or the C1 census identification at j>0. Provenance notes/pilots_20260802/dli_norm_gate/ (LN0-LN3); formalizes the C2'' pilot's L13.

nodes.title: DLI norm gate, energy ceiling: 1 <= Norm <= E^(phi(n)/2) for arbitrary integer coefficient vectors (the C1 sandwich Claim 2 with w -> E, ternariness never used), and the junction router it powers
nodes.statement: In Z[zeta_n]=Z[x]/(x^h+1), n=2^s>=4, h=phi(n)=n/2, for every NONZERO alpha=sum_{i<h} a_i zeta_n^i with integer a_i and energy E=sum_i a_i^2: (LN4) 1 <= Norm(alpha) <= E^(h/2). Parseval is the only step where the coefficients enter, and it enters as sum_i a_i^2 -- TERNARINESS IS NEVER USED; on ternary vectors E=w and the statement is the banked one. (LN5) Consequently, at a junction with root order h_j, degree N_j=phi(h_j) and block size o=L_j, combining with q^{L_j} | Norm != 0 (dli_norm_gate_forward_and_ofold) every nonzero junction-j skew solution satisfies q^{L_j} <= Norm <= E^{N_j/2}, i.e. E >= min{E : E^{N_j/2} >= q^{L_j}}; contrapositively, if E^{N_j/2} < q^{L_j} the junction admits no nonzero skew of energy <= E, so a state whose whole admissible skew domain has sum_i c_i^2 <= E is killed. At a uniform ratio N_j = 256 L_j the criterion collapses to q <= E^128 independently of j. NOT claimed: any lower bound on Norm beyond 1, the exact maxnorm ladder (banked, and its stable-range doubling law is REFUTED in general), sufficiency of the energy condition, or the WCL fence. Provenance notes/pilots_20260802/dli_norm_gate/ (LN4, LN5).

nodes.title: DLI norm-gate splitting law: phi(n) times the solution count equals sum |H_U| exactly, the ratio is mbar/phi(n) >= 1/phi(n) with equality iff multiplicity <= 1, and q^(o+1) > maxnorm forces exactness
nodes.statement: Setting: n=2^s>=4, q odd prime with n | q-1, zeta in F_q of exact order n, W_w the ternary weight-w vectors supported in the basis range [0,phi(n)), Z(alpha)={j odd : alpha(zeta^j)=0}, H_U(alpha)={a in (Z/n)^* : a.U inside Z(alpha)} for a block U of o odd residues, Sol_U={alpha in W_w : 1 in H_U(alpha)}, D_U={alpha : H_U(alpha) nonempty}. (S1) phi(n)|Sol_U| = sum_{alpha in W_w} |H_U(alpha)| EXACTLY -- a double count using that sigma_a: zeta^i -> zeta^{ai} is a signed permutation of the basis, hence a bijection of W_w, and that Z(sigma_a alpha) = a^{-1}Z(alpha). Corollary: |Sol_U| is independent of which primitive n-th root of F_q is chosen; the equidistribution is an IDENTITY, not a Chebotarev estimate. (S2) If D_U is nonempty then |Sol_U|/|D_U| = mbar/phi(n) with mbar the mean of |H_U| over D_U, so the ratio is >= 1/phi(n) -- deviation is UPWARD ONLY -- with equality if and only if |H_U(alpha)| <= 1 for every alpha in W_w. (S3) If Stab(U)={1} and q^{o+1} > maxnorm(phi(n),w) then |H_U| <= 1 throughout, so the ratio is EXACTLY 1/phi(n): two distinct a in H_U give two distinct blocks aU inside Z(alpha), forcing m(alpha) >= o+1 and q^{o+1} <= Norm <= maxnorm. A hypothesis-free weakening replaces maxnorm by w^{phi(n)/2}. Stab(U)={1} is proved for U={1} (so the whole o=1 theory, including junction 0 at t=2 and the C1 relation lane, is unconditional) and whenever 1 in U with max(U)^2 < n (the proof uses b = b.1 in U; official blocks all contain 1). This DISCHARGES the C2'' pilot's L13 splitting observation from a conjecture to a theorem plus a checkable finite condition. NOT claimed: that S3's condition holds at every official junction; that Stab(U_j)={1} for official j <= 25 (a verified pattern, not a theorem -- the family U={1,3,...,2L-1} has nontrivial stabilizer exactly at L=n/4 and L=n/2); or any distributional model (the within-support variance is under-dispersed ~2x and the q-independent norm multiset does not determine rho). Provenance notes/pilots_20260802/dli_norm_gate/ (LN7 = S1-S3; 1,960-row record, 0 violations of S1/S2/S3/LN6; of the 63 rows deviating from 1/phi(n), all 54 that have a banked maxnorm fail S3's condition and the remaining 9 are n=128 rows where no maxnorm is banked, so S3 is untested there).

nodes.title: F2 antipodal descent lemma: in the 2-power Frobenius tower over p with v_2(p-1) = e >= 2 every rung's descent pairs are ANTIPODAL {y,-y}; hence every deployed window is parity-homogeneous (all Delta even), the mode k = p is slice-dead (|R_p| = 1, flat = 0 EXACTLY), and window SELECTION is impossible in principle
nodes.statement: p odd prime, e := v_2(p-1) >= 2, n_j = 2^{e+j}, q_j = p^{2^j}. THEOREM: (i) v_2(q_j - 1) = e+j for every j >= 0 (2-adic LTE: p^{2^j}-1 = (p-1)(p+1)prod_{i=1}^{j-1}(p^{2^i}+1), with v_2(p+1) = 1 since e >= 2 forces p == 1 mod 4, and v_2(p^{2^i}+1) = 1 since an odd square is 1 mod 8); (ii) mu_{n_j} <= F_{q_j}^*, and mu_{n_j} ^ F_{q_{j-1}} = mu_{n_{j-1}} for j >= 1 (gcd(n_j, q_{j-1}-1) = 2^{e+j-1}); (iii) every y of order exactly n_j satisfies y^{q_{j-1}} = -y (q_{j-1}-1 = 2^{e+j-1} u with u odd, and y^{2^{e+j-1}} = -1). COROLLARY A: the rung-j Frobenius conjugate pairs are exactly the ANTIPODAL pairs {y,-y}. COROLLARY B (in the banked first-descent window model -- F_{p^2} = F_p(w), pair reps with w-component in [1,(p-1)/2], s^pm = Tr(c y^{pm}), sigma = s + p[2s>p] in Z/2p, Delta = sigma^+ - sigma^-): s^- = -s^+, and sigma is exactly the CENTRED representative of s mod p hence an ODD function, so sigma^- = -sigma^+ and Delta_i = 2 sigma_i^+ is EVEN for every i, every frequency c, every rung -- every deployed window is parity-homogeneous. COROLLARY C: omega^p = -1 and p is odd, so R_p = (1/m) sum_i (-1)^{Delta_i} = 1, hence max_{k odd}|R_k| = 1 and flat = 0 EXACTLY (not approximately). COROLLARY D: all-Delta-even is COORDINATEWISE, so every non-empty sub-window inherits it -- window SELECTION cannot repair the degeneracy; the escape, if any, is in FREQUENCY space. NOT claimed: the degeneracy law (n_ord/gcd(n_ord,p-1) == 2 <=> all Delta even) is CENSUSED (194 rows, 0 violations), measured not proved -- only the => direction for rung subgroups is proved here; the corollary -log2 rho_b <= log2 p + o(1) (the 1/p ceiling ladder is exact at toy scale with measured saturation, the o(1) is not proved); generic-frequency flatness (T3, OPEN -- needs an incomplete-character-sum bound, not attempted); the K1 mass obligations (O1) E_{c in K1}[exp S_c] <= 2^{n/2+o(n)}, (O2) the same at fixed b, (O3) PP5.0 carrying the pullback ramification 2^d -- these are OPEN constructive obligations (the fixed-sector ABSORPTION route was REFUTED, Theorem B), untouched here; and the law FAILS if n has an odd part or if e = 1. Verified: LTE at the official KoalaBear prime p = 2^31-2^24+1 (e = 24) for all 16 rungs by two independent routes, the antipodal identity at rung 1 (64 genuine elements), all-Delta-even EXHAUSTIVELY over all 2,976 frequencies of F_{p^2}^* at four primes, R_p = 1 exactly, sub-window inheritance, and NON-VACUITY (the full-group window at the same primes has odd Delta and |R_p| < 1). nodes.statement: Banked first-descent window model (p odd, n_ord | p^2-1 even and not dividing p-1, frequency c = (a_c,b_c) in F_{p^2}^*, m = (n_ord - gcd(n_ord,p-1))/2 genuine Frobenius pairs, Delta_i in Z/2p, omega = zeta_{2p}, R_k = (1/m) sum_i omega^{k Delta_i}, flat = 1 - max_{k odd}|R_k|). THEOREM 1 (certificate): with c_d := #{i : Delta_i == d (p), Delta_i EVEN} - #{i : ... ODD}, x_d := the EVEN element of {d,d+p}, D := sum_d |c_d|, then for EVERY odd k, (ID) R_k = (1/m) sum_d c_d omega^{k x_d} -- because omega^{k(x+p)} = -omega^{kx} for odd k collapses each residue class -- hence (DEF) max_{k odd}|R_k| <= D/m and (FLAT) flat >= 1 - D/m. D is an exact integer; one integer bounds all p odd modes at once; a class split evenly between the parities has c_d = 0 (perfect local cancellation). THEOREM 2 (full group, n_ord = p^2-1): m = p(p-1)/2 and, for every frequency with a_c != 0 AND b_c != 0, D = ((p-1)/2)^2 EXACTLY, so flat >= (p+1)/(2p) > 1/2. Proof chain (reconstructed -- the record has the VALUE and a 12-instance check, no derivation and no scope condition): with M = (p-1)/2 and kappa(x) = (-1)^{centred rep of x mod p}, a_c != 0 makes a_y sweep F_p bijectively so c_d = A(d) with A(t) = sum_a kappa(a)kappa(a+t); A(t) = (-1)^t (p-2t) for 0 <= t <= M and A is even (parametrise by the centred rep: exactly t of the p values overflow); b_c != 0 makes the support {4 N_0 b_c b : b = 1..M} a HALF-SYSTEM of F_p^*, so |A| takes each of p-2t, t = 1..M, exactly once; D = sum_{t=1}^M (p-2t) = M^2. THEOREM 3 (the exact scope): the hypothesis is NECESSARY and the failure is total on both excluded lines -- b_c = 0 (c in F_p^*) gives s^+ = s^- and Delta == 0; a_c = 0 (c in w F_p^*) gives s^- = -s^+ and all Delta EVEN (the f2_antipodal_descent_lemma mechanism, reached from the frequency side); both give D = m and a vacuous (FLAT). These are exactly the two parity-pure lines. COROLLARY 4 (degenerate branch): any parity-homogeneous window has every c_d >= 0, so D = m and (FLAT) says only flat >= 0; at deployed rung windows the true value is flat = 0, so the certificate is TIGHT BUT EMPTY there. The certificate is informative exactly to the extent the window is parity-INhomogeneous. Also proved: D is invariant under the GLOBAL orientation reversal but NOT under partial flips (verifier exhibits both), so D must always be quoted with its labelling. NOT claimed: this is NOT an (H-flat) certificate for any DEPLOYED window (the full group is a window the tower does not deploy -- its value is as the TEMPLATE for whatever windows the frequency-space case split sends to the slice theorem); (DEF) is an upper bound, not an identity, and no sharpness is claimed outside the degenerate branch; nothing about EVEN modes k (the collapse needs k odd); generic-frequency flatness (T3, OPEN); the multiplicity law (sorted non-zero Delta-counts = [1..p-1]) is MEASURED (exhaustive over all a_c b_c != 0 frequencies at p = 11..23, plus the pilot's p = 41) and is NOT used in any proof; nothing about the K1 mass obligations (O1)-(O3). Verified: (ID) exactly in Z[zeta_p] at every odd k over 24 (p, window, frequency) cases; A(t) at 8 primes; the half-system property exhaustively; THEOREM 2 EXHAUSTIVELY over every frequency of F_{p^2}^* at p = 11,13,19,23,31,41 (3,552 frequencies) including the pilot's own A8 row; THEOREM 3's exception count (exactly p-1 on each line, none elsewhere). BLOCK FAMILY: a fixed core G and a pool of b pairwise-disjoint blocks of common size m disjoint from G; S_J = G u (union_{j in J} B_j) over a-subsets J, |S_J| = |G| + am = A. CLAIM 1 (spread threshold): |S_J ^ S_J'| = |G| + m|J ^ J'|, so the maximum pairwise core is A - m and, for b >= a+1, the family is SPREAD iff m >= h+1. CLAIM 2 ((SF-SELFCOLLISION), DERIVED not assumed): if m <= h then every member has a partner at core A - m >= K, so the whole planted family sits in Gamma_hi. CLAIM 3 (coset blocks and THE DICHOTOMY): for B_j = g_j mu_m, prod_{x in B_j}(X-x) = X^m - g_j^m, so R_{B_j}(Y) = 1 - g_j^m Y^m in F_q[Y]/(Y^{h+1}) (equivalently p_t(B_j) = m g_j^t if m|t else 0); if m > h then R_{B_j} = 1, every E(S_J) is the SAME point, beta may be taken 0 -- no live slope direction (one slope, a strip) -- while the family IS spread; if m <= h < 2m then R_{S_J} = R_G - (sum_{j in J} g_j^m) (R_G Y^m mod Y^{h+1}), so the moment vectors move affinely in the single scalar sum g_j^m along a direction supported from coordinate e_m -- a live direction exists -- but by Claim 1 the family is NOT spread. Hence for EVERY coset-block geometry spreadness and a live slope direction are INCOMPATIBLE, and (SF-SELFCOLLISION)'s operative window m <= h < 2m is derived. CLAIM 4 (collinearity is NECESSARY -- reconstructed): if every S_J is a witness of one pencil then the block moment vectors E(B_j) lie on one affine line of AG(h,q); for a = 1 unconditionally, for a >= 2 provided b >= a+2. Engine: R_{S u T} = R_S R_T for disjoint S,T in F_q[Y]/(Y^{h+1}), every R_S is a unit, and multiplication by a fixed unit is a linear bijection hence maps lines to lines; fix a-1 blocks and vary the last, then connect the resulting lines through their >= 2 common points. COORDINATE FLAG (load-bearing): the source states Claim 4 in POWER-SUM coordinates (expE.py:7-8) while its own code computes ELEMENTARY-SYMMETRIC ones (core.moment_vector); Newton's identities are NOT affine, so the two conditions differ in general (verifier: the p-collinear triple (0,0,0),(1,0,0),(2,0,0) has e-images of affine rank 2) -- the statement above is in e-coordinates, and for COSET blocks the two readings coincide (both give direction e_m), so Claims 2-3 are unaffected. HYPOTHESIS FLAG: the source writes b >= a+1; at b = a+1 collinearity is vacuous, and b >= a+2 is needed for a >= 2. HONESTY FLAG: the record asserts this result as 'proved + verified' but contains NO written derivation anywhere (only pb_h4_hunt/REPORT.md:15 and expE.py:4-14, which defers to the report); Claims 1-3 are written out from scratch here (the coset power-sum vanishing is the part the coordinator hand-verified, FABLE_AUDIT.md:19-23) and Claim 4 is reconstructed in corrected coordinates. NOT claimed: the NON-COSET RESIDUE (blocks of size m >= h+1 with collinear moment vectors) is OPEN -- measured FEASIBLE at 4 of 5 toy shapes (independently replayed here: 1140 blocks, richest line 28, 4 disjoint, family C(4,2) = 6, matching EXPE.json exactly) and closed at official scale only by a first-moment count the pilot itself says is NOT a theorem; core-varying and non-block families (out of scope); Gamma_lo = 0 for split-fibre as an IDENTITY consequence -- the SELECTOR CATCH: max core A-m >= K is attained only by adjacent label sets whose partners live at other slopes, so Gamma_lo = 0 additionally needs a SUPPORT-KEYED selector (support-lex first-match measured 0 at 18/18 across nu in [0.05,30]; a UNIFORM selector leaves ~q e^{-nu}, at official RowC 1/4 with nu = 3.0 that is ~2^187 >> 8n^3) -- the K1 closure is a JOINT identity-plus-selector statement and re-couples to the ratified PP4.0 compression-order class, and only the identity half is proved here; any P-B bound; any discharge of (H4). nodes.title: XR high-band windowed-projection reduction: exact projective multiplicity identity, high-depth injectivity, and averaged window inequality
nodes.statement: For every tangent-gate Reed-Solomon pencil and every depth ceil(h/2)<=d<=h-2, let N_d^raw count all depth-d joint-explanation pairs, W_d(z) count codewords with agreement in [k+d,A-2] at member z, and beta_d=floor((n-k-d)/(h-d-1)). Then (q+1-beta_d)N_d^raw <= sum_z W_d(z). Hence the selected occupancy N_d obeys the same bound, and 25 sum_z W_d(z) <= 17n^2(q+1-beta_d) implies N_d<=17n^2/25. The proof is the exact P^1 cell identity sum_z(a_P(z)-k-d)=n-k-d, the beta over-agreement packing bound, and injectivity of P->pi_z(P) when 2d>=h. This is a reduction only; it does not assert the high-window list estimate.

nodes.statement: At each of the three prize rows, for every globally generic-branch received pair after the ratified strip order and every ceil(h/2)<=d<=h-2, the support-wise first-match selected occupancy N_d of depth-d joint-explanation pairs carrying at least two selected live slopes satisfies 25N_d<=17n^2. The exact remaining premise is xr_band_maximal_window_divisor_count (SL-2-RES), which counts only maximal exact-depth locators with L_P>=2 and retains small-scale mixed-class survivors. The proved window system and maximality fiber identity give a bijection with N_d. Raw affine divisors and a claimed joint codimension 2d are not valid substitutes. Together with the banked low-depth envelope and cascade cap this fits H_band=s_lo-16n^3. RowC is outside this node.

nodes.title: XR window-system descent: exact locator equations, quotient descent, single-word Toeplitz rank, and large-scale periodic liveness exclusion
nodes.statement: For H=mu_n and r'=n-k-d, a monic locator E_T of degree r' admits a degree-<k word agreeing off T iff the top d coefficients of uE_T mod (X^n-1) vanish. Coset-union locators E_T=G(X^M) descend exactly by residue classes to the quotient window system. Under the tangent gate each single-word Toeplitz matrix has full rank d; no joint rank 2d is claimed. For M=2^j|gcd(n,k,d), individually residue-supported word pairs at odd h can be exact-A live only if M<=floor((n-k-d)/(h-d)); this excludes all M>=2^21 throughout the prize-row high band. Common-class systems descend to strip P3. This proves no occupancy count; small-scale mixed-class and aperiodic systems remain.

nodes.title: XR window-divisor maximality filter: predicate-filtered inversion and Bonferroni support moments
nodes.statement: For every predicate Pi of the uniquely reconstructed maximal pair, RAW_d^Pi=SUM_{e>=d} MAX_e^Pi*C(k+e,k+d), and finite binomial inversion recovers MAX_d^Pi. Its truncations satisfy the exact Bonferroni bounds S_(2a+1)^Pi(d)<=MAX_d^Pi<=S_(2a)^Pi(d). Thus maximality, selected liveness, and strip survival have an exact support-moment interface, but a closing use must control the signed sum as a whole. Raw affine-divisor counts remain inequivalent to SL-2, and full rank d of each single-word system does not imply joint codimension 2d.

nodes.statement: At each prize row and high band-proper depth, let R_d(u,v) contain the degree-(n-k-d) monic split squarefree divisors E_T|X^n-1 satisfying both top-d window systems, whose reconstructed codeword pair has full joint core exactly H\T, has L_P>=2 under support-wise first-match selection, and survives the generic strip order. Then 25|R_d|<=17n^2. The exact remaining alternatives are the full-joint-rank split-divisor target and, at deficient rank, the active-defect-local target whose every selected off-core block lies in the support D of the invariant primitive residual. The complementary deficient family is proved to have size at most n-|D| and the red leaf receives the exact remaining budget. Raw affine divisors without maximality/selection remain outside the assertion.

nodes.title: XR joint-window rank router: full codimension 2d or a nonproportional Pade syndrome syzygy
nodes.statement: Let J_d be the stack of the two full-rank d-row Toeplitz window matrices. Then d<=rank J_d<=2d. Rank below 2d is equivalent to a degree-<d two-sided Pade syzygy across the complete syndrome window. Under the pencil-wide tangent gate neither coefficient polynomial vanishes and they cannot be proportional, since either case gives a forbidden recurrence for one pencil member. Hence the exact residual partitions into full-joint-rank arithmetic and genuinely two-sided nonproportional syzygy strata; no count is claimed.

nodes.title: XR deficient-window payment: outside-forced-set pairs cost at most n-|G|
nodes.statement: For the left syzygy space K_d of a deficient stacked high-window matrix, let G_d be the evaluation points at which both components of every syzygy vanish. Vandermonde inversion makes every syzygy a pointwise rational error-direction law for every maximal depth-d pair. At q>n there is a syzygy whose common H-root set is exactly G_d, all syzygies are divisible by its locator, dim K_d<=2(d-|G_d|), and rank J_d>=2|G_d|. Partition N_d into N_d^out, whose pairs have a selected off-core point outside G_d, and N_d^G, whose complete selected off-core geometry lies in G_d. High-depth first-match ray injectivity gives N_d^out<=n-|G_d| unconditionally, while N_d^G>0 implies |G_d|>=2(h-d). Hence only the G_d-local deficient family remains unpaid.

nodes.title: F2 admissible extension-degree and order classification
nodes.statement: Every official maximal rate-half row belongs to exactly one of 12 signed degree/order types. Plus branch: v2(p-1)>=41, k=1, e in {1,2,3,4,5,6}; v2(p-1)=40, k=2, e in {2,4}; v2(p-1)=39, k=4, e=4. Minus branch: v2(p+1)>=40, k=2, e in {2,4}; v2(p+1)=39, k=4, e=4. All 12 types are nonempty. Exactly seven are non-generating: the five plus k=1 rows with e=2,...,6 and the plus/minus k=2 rows with e=4. In particular, the field cap and elementary compositeness exclude every apparent e=6,k=2 row.

nodes.title: Plus-branch admissible F2 direct-sum reduction to prime-field GRS kernels
nodes.statement: At every official n=2^41 admissible row q=p^e<2^256 in the plus branch p=1 mod 4, ord_n(p)=2^D with D<=2. Every deployed antipodal window splits into at most four F_p-proportionality classes, and its F2 dual kernel is the direct sum of class kernels that are explicit prime-field [S,S-R,R+1]_p GRS/MDS codes. Consequently dim_Fp L=C min(S,R) exactly and the ternary mass factorizes as Z(L)=Z_1^C. The trace collapse uses ord_n(p), not e, and all K1 kernel/mass statements are invariant under the rules-level domain coset. No claim is made for p=3 mod 4 rows.

nodes.title: F2 admissible generating-row branch classification
nodes.statement: Every official maximal rate-half generating row q=p^e, ord_(2^41)(p)=e, belongs to exactly one of five residue-signed types. On p=1 mod 4 they are (v2(p-1),e)=(>=41,1),(40,2),(39,4). On p=3 mod 4 they are (v2(p+1),e)=(>=40,2),(39,4). All five types are nonempty: p=3*2^41+1, 27*2^40+1, 5*2^39+1, 2^61-1, and 25*2^39-1 respectively give certified prime witnesses with q=p^e<2^256. Thus the unsigned three-class census omits two official minus-branch classes.

nodes.title: Plus-branch admissible F2 Newton signed-distance transport
nodes.statement: For every official plus-branch p=1 mod 4 admissible F2 prime-field class whose imposed moments contain 1,3,...,2R-1, every nonzero ternary class-kernel word has weight at least 2R+1; if 2R>=S the ternary kernel is trivial. At the maximal generating witness the floor is S/32+89. This is a distance supplier, not a ternary-mass bound, and makes no minus-branch claim.

nodes.title: Plus-branch admissible F2 weighted odd-prefix L2 identity
nodes.statement: For one plus-branch p=1 mod 4 admissible prime-field class, if N(v) counts subsets of the half-system with a prescribed first-R odd-moment vector, then Z_1=2^{-S} sum_v N(v)^2 exactly. Equivalently Z_1 is the normalized cosine-product Fourier partition function, and each N(v) is a full-agreement list-recovery output size for the explicit [S,S-R] GRS code with coordinate lists of size two. Hence Z_1>=max(1,2^S/p^R), and the desired subexponential mass is exactly a near-diagonal L2 collision bound. This is not a full max-fiber Q theorem, a list-size bound, or a minus-branch identity.

nodes.title: All-admissible F2 bounded-class direct-sum reduction
nodes.statement: The claim that every official admissible F2 antipodal window splits into at most four F_p-proportionality classes is false. For the Mersenne prime p=2^61-1 and q=p^2, q<2^256 and ord_(2^41)(p)=2=e, but gcd(2^41,p-1)=2, so the antipodal half-system has 2^40 singleton classes. The corrected p=1 mod 4 reduction survives.

nodes.title: All-admissible-row F2 O1 mass bound
nodes.statement: The F2 first-moment bound (O1), E_c[T_W(c)]<=2^{m+o(n)}, holds at the full-group deployed window for every official admissible n=2^41 row. This is false whenever ord_n(p)<[F_q:F_p]; in particular p=3*2^41+1 and q=p^6 give an admissible counterexample with an exponential 2^{5n/12} excess under the governing nested reading.

nodes.title: F2 antipodal-selector prefix transport
nodes.statement: For a cyclic odd-prefix syndrome map of binary length m, choosing theta^s or -theta^s according to each bit bijects the cube with antipodal transversal m-subsets of mu_(2m). Their even power sums are fixed and their odd power sums are an affine invertible rescaling of the F2 syndrome. Every F2 fiber therefore injects into one ordinary central depth-2R split-locator prefix fiber. nodes.title: Official exact-slice structured moment/pullback column budget
nodes.statement: At every official exact-list corridor row, let A=K+t_XR and partition each full locator-prefix fiber by one declared support-wise first-match rule. After the quotient and dihedral owners, let M_z be the actual set of list supports assigned to the structured non-quotient moment-null/U2-boundary pullback bucket, including every staircase expansion and after parameter-image coalescing. Prove max_z |M_z|<=N^3=2^123. This is a structured Q/MT column, disjoint from the primitive star-PTE residue owned by u1. A census of t_XR-null generator blocks or families does not by itself prove the claim: it must also prove the expansion, first ownership, maximum-prefix transport, and coalescing needed to count actual list members. The guarded F2 terminal and null-fiber near-tail payments remain evidence for that structured-column proof, not substitutes for its quantifiers.
nodes.falsifier: An official corridor row, locator prefix z, and certified first-match structured moment/U2 pullback bucket containing more than N^3 actual list supports after expansion and coalescing, or an unbounded expansion multiplicity omitted by the proposed ledger.

nodes.title: Coefficient-scale quotient sieve for primitive shift pairs
nodes.statement: For a subset S of a cyclic multiplicative coset D=alpha H, the maximal divisor c|n for which S is a union of order-c subgroup orbits equals gcd(n,e,{j:lambda_j(L_S)!=0}); equivalently L_S(X)=L_bar(X^c). A disjoint depth-t shift pair with maximal common coefficient scale c>1 descends uniquely to degree e/c and depth ceil((t+1)/c)-1, with deg(A-B)=c deg(A_c-B_c), and the maximal quotient pair is coefficient-primitive. Conversely every coefficient-primitive quotient pair pulls back with maximal common scale c. Hence every quotient-borne pair has c|gcd(n,e,deg(A-B)); at dyadic length 2^41 an imprimitive nonconstant pair has even e and even difference degree.

nodes.title: Official exact-slice depths miss the generated-field F2 guard by 129 bits
nodes.statement: Let N=2^41, rho in {1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16}, K=rho N, 128<=L=log2(q)<256, and t_XR=min{t:tL>=log2 binom(N,N-K-t)+128}. Then t_XR L<=N-129. Since B0=F_p(mu_N) is a subfield of F_q, t_XR log2|B0|<=N-129 as well. Thus every official exact-list corridor depth fails the generated-field guard |B0|^t>=2^N by at least 129 bits, including generating rows. Consequently the guarded full-subset F2 terminal cannot by itself discharge the exact-slice u2c/x4 consumer.

nodes.title: Exact-list bucket ownership and currency separation
nodes.statement: Fix a depth-t locator-prefix fiber and a support-wise first-match partition. Choosing one residual base support S0 injects every other residual support S into its canonical star-PTE record (S\S0,S0\S), of width h in [t+1,min(A,n-A)] and with equal elementary coefficients through order t. Hence a proved injection of all residual star records into a universal record ledger of size R gives a local primitive fiber bound 1+R. This is the primitive SP bucket. In contrast, t-null blocks and their staircase expansions are structured moment/pullback generators and belong to a separate Q/MT bucket; counting generators alone does not count the expanded list members. Finally, QA.22's per-pair bad-slope reserve is MCA currency and does not by itself bound a per-word list fiber. Therefore x4 needs three separately typed inputs: structured-column population, primitive-star coverage into its record ledger, and one list-side summed budget. None may be substituted for another without a proved adapter.

nodes.title: Exact-list first-match summed numerator budget
nodes.statement: For every official x4 row and every quotient row consumed by TR, print one support-wise priority map and exact integer list-side numerators U_paid, U_QD, U_MT, and U_prim for the paid background, quotient/dihedral, structured moment/U2, and primitive star buckets. Prove coverage, coalescing, and the single comparison U_paid+U_QD+U_MT+U_prim <= B*=floor(|F|/2^128), using U_MT<=n^3 only from u2c and U_prim<=16n^3 only from the direct local primitive-star target. QA.22 may supply arithmetic evidence but its per-pair MCA slope reserve is not this list-side certificate. The table must include every row actually consumed; six-candidate arithmetic cannot silently certify the wider 29-row or quotient-row family.

nodes.title: Full-prefix to p-free syndrome reduction and full-cube route cut
nodes.statement: In characteristic p, every full depth-t elementary locator-prefix fiber on A-subsets is contained in one fixed-weight fiber of the p-free power-sum map Psi_J(S)=(sum_{x in S}x^j)_{1<=j<=t,p not dividing j}; hence it is also contained in a fiber of the same F_p-linear map on the full Boolean cube. At the official N=2^41 exact-list depth, however, t log2|B0|<=N-129. The full-cube map has at most |B0|^t outputs, so pigeonhole forces a fiber of size at least 2^(N-t log2|B0|)>=2^129>N^3=2^123. Therefore replacing the fixed Hamming slice by the unweighted Boolean cube cannot prove the N^3 maximum-prefix target; any F2/list-recovery bridge must retain the weight or an equally strong owner decomposition.

nodes.title: General local shift pairs partition exactly by locator-difference degree
nodes.statement: Let S and S0 be distinct same-depth-t locator-prefix A-subsets in any support-wise residual family. With C=S intersect S0, P=S\C, Q=S0\C, e=|P|=|Q|, and d=deg(L_P-L_Q), one has 0<=d<=e-t-1 and hence e>=t+d+1. Moreover d=0 if and only if e_j(P)=e_j(Q) for every 1<=j<=e-1, exactly the F-4 minimal constant-shift condition. Therefore every local same-prefix degree partitions disjointly into d=0 minimal records and d>=1 genuinely nonminimal records; the top side width e=t+1 is necessarily minimal. Primitive-scale restriction and support-wise first-owner deletion preserve the partition.

nodes.title: General star records do not universally inject into minimal trades
nodes.closure: exact finite-field counterexample and complete census
nodes.statement: On D=F_17^*, the disjoint pair P={1,2,3}, Q={4,5,14} is a general order-1 width-3 star-PTE record but is not minimal and contains no width-2 minimal subrecord. Exhaustively, D has 4576 unordered general order-1 width-3 records, while its entire unordered F-4 minimal ledger has only 963 records over widths 1,...,8 (843 over widths 2,...,8). Hence no scale-free multiplicity-one injection from all general star records into all minimal records exists, and subset peeling also fails. This is not an official-row or strip-aware counterexample: n=16 and |F|=17<n^2, so x4 coverage may still use official-row first-owner strips or a broadened general-record u1 ledger.

nodes.title: Johnson-nonpositive wedge abstract-code route cut
nodes.statement: At the official rate-half scale, take e=N/8 and d=e-t_XR-1. A bipartite pair-choice construction from a binary code of length N/4 and distance t_XR+1 gives more than 16N^3 abstract pairs (P,Q) with |P|=|Q|=e and changed-set intersections at most e+d. The parameters satisfy e=t_XR+d+1 and 4e^2<=N(e+d). These are not asserted to be locator incidences. Therefore the remaining Johnson-nonpositive wedge cannot be closed from the changed-set intersection cap and row arithmetic alone.

nodes.title: Linear-difference translated-divisor projection codegree bound
nodes.statement: For a fixed base support and side width e, every fixed added-locator or removed-locator projection fiber of the d=1 translated complementary-divisor incidence has Johnson codegree at most v(e-1)/(e^2-v), where v is the corresponding side universe and e^2>v. The exact official corridor implies t_XR>=2^31; since d=1 forces e>=t_XR+2 and N=2^41, both projection codegrees are at most 1024. This bounds multiplicity over a projection but does not bound the projection population or the total d=1 stratum.

nodes.title: Linear-difference local records are translated complementary divisors
nodes.statement: For a fixed base support S0 with locator L0 and complementary-domain locator U, depth-t local records of side width e are in exact bijection with pairs (B,H) such that B is a monic degree-e divisor of L0, B+H is a monic degree-e divisor of U, H is nonzero, and deg H<=e-t-1. On a cyclic multiplicative coset every d=1 record is coefficient-primitive. Over F_17^* one fixed five-point base has three distinct same-prefix neighbours whose reduced locator difference is the same 6X+10, so H is not an injective record key.

nodes.title: Exact locator-prefix consumer and null-fiber scope
nodes.statement: Let D be a finite evaluation domain, A=K+t, and Phi_{A,t}(S) the first t sub-leading coefficients of the monic locator of an A-subset S. For every prefix z, the polynomial word U_z=X^A+sum_{i=1}^t z_i X^{A-i} has an exact bijection between Phi_{A,t}^{-1}(z) and its Reed-Solomon codewords of degree <K agreeing on A points. Consequently a universal exact-list upper ledger must control the heaviest relevant prefix fiber after its paid strips, not only the zero or t-null fiber. In characteristic p, t-nullity fixes only the p-free prefix coordinates; p-multiple locator coefficients are free. Moreover raw mode-at-null is false: for D=F_17^*, A=9, t=1, the zero fiber has size 672 and every nonzero fiber has size 673. Therefore any null-fiber route requires a separately proved strip-aware max-to-null or exchange-compression theorem.

nodes.title: Low-difference local SP Johnson high-width bound
nodes.statement: For a fixed base support, side-width-e neighbours whose reduced locator difference has degree at most d have changed 2e-sets with pairwise intersection at most e+d. Hence their number is at most N(e-d)/(4e^2-N(e+d)) whenever the denominator is positive. At N=2^41 and d=1, every width e>=N/4+1 has at most N^2/16 records, and summing all at most N/4 such widths costs at most N^3/64. Thus only t_XR+2<=e<=N/4 remains in the d=1 branch.

nodes.title: Low-difference Johnson-positive wedge aggregate
nodes.statement: At one fixed base support, sum every exact nonconstant side-width/difference-degree stratum with Delta=4e^2-N(e+d)>0. The low-difference Johnson cell bound and the exact step Delta(e,d+1)=Delta(e,d)-N give a complete aggregate at most 5N^3/16: deep cells Delta>=N cost below N^3/16, and there is at most one boundary cell 0<Delta<N per e, costing at most N^3/4 total. Every remaining nonconstant record satisfies 4e^2<=N(e+d) and e>=t_XR+d+1.

nodes.title: Maximum prefix fiber equals one plus maximum local shift-pair degree
nodes.statement: For any support-wise first-match residual family partitioned by the depth-t elementary locator-prefix map, form the graph whose vertices are residual A-subsets and whose edges join distinct supports with equal prefix. Each nonempty prefix fiber is a clique and there are no edges between fibers, so max_z |R_z|=1+max_S deg(S) exactly. Distinct same-prefix supports have Johnson side-distance e>=t+1; after removing their common core, the two disjoint e-locators form a shift pair, and at e=t+1 their difference is a nonzero constant. Therefore the official N^3 maximum-prefix target is equivalent to a uniform local primitive shift-pair degree at most N^3-1 after the same paid strips. A global second-moment identity controls only the average degree and does not replace this local bound.

nodes.title: Prefix twist-orbit constancy and moment amplification
nodes.statement: Let a cyclic group H of order N act multiplicatively on the evaluation domain D, and let F_z be a depth-t elementary locator-prefix fiber of A-subsets. Multiplication by zeta in H sends F_z bijectively to F_(zeta z_1,...,zeta^t z_t). If I(z)={i:z_i!=0}, the stabilizer has size s(z)=N for z=0 and gcd(N,I(z)) otherwise, so the twist orbit has N/s(z) equal-size fibers. For Q=|B|^t, R(z)=Q|F_z|/binom(N,A), and Gamma_r=Q^(r-1) sum_y (|F_y|/binom(N,A))^r, one has Gamma_r >= (N/s(z))R(z)^r/Q. For N=2^ell, s(z)=2^min_i v_2(i) on nonzero z; any prefix with a nonzero odd coordinate has a full N-element orbit. This is the first exact heavy-fiber descent rung, but supplies no moment upper bound and hence no maximum-prefix estimate by itself.

nodes.title: X4 primitive norm-size hard-boundary route cut
nodes.statement: At the official rate-half residual cell N=2^41, e=N/8, T=t_XR, d=e-T-1, every coefficient-primitive active/zero fold pattern passes the complete generic norm-size gate. Uniformly over log2(q)<256, the logarithm of the residue-degree plus structural-zero lower factor is below 3N+5160, while the shared Haar ceiling is at least 10N. Thus no pattern is excluded by these size inequalities alone. This is not a shift-pair construction or an X4 counterexample; exact factors, locator incidence, and first-owner routes remain live.

nodes.title: Primitive shift-pair dyadic norm router
nodes.statement: For a disjoint equal-size shift pair on a dyadic multiplicative coset with equal first t locator coefficients, every allowed dyadic fold beta_j vanishes modulo the row field at the odd frequencies supplied by the prefix. If beta_j is nonzero, one residue-degree factor p^ord_n(p) divides its cyclotomic norm for every distinct Frobenius orbit reached; the orbit-weighted exponent is at least the number M_j of distinct available odd frequencies, while |Norm(beta_j)|<=E_j^(n/4) and E_j<=2^(j+2)e. The root fold beta_0 vanishes exactly on the common antipodal coefficient-scale branch, so every coefficient-primitive pair is canonically norm-gated. This is a necessary arithmetic router, not a population bound.

nodes.title: Primitive shift-pair Haar norm-product gate
nodes.statement: The dyadic folds of every balanced signed shift-pair vector satisfy the exact shared Haar identity sum_j E_j/2^(j+1)=2e. For any nonempty set S of prefix-supplied nonzero folds, if a_j=N/2^(j+2), A_S=sum a_j, R_S=sum ord_nj(p)o_j, and M_S=sum M_j, then p^M_S<=p^R_S<=product_j |Norm(beta_j)|<=product_j E_j^a_j<=(eN/A_S)^A_S. Thus the exact integer inequality p^R_S A_S^A_S<=(eN)^A_S is necessary. Coefficient primitivity makes scale zero active, and an exact difference-degree cell supplies depth T=e-d-1. This is a pattern-exclusion gate, not a population bound.

nodes.title: Primitive shift-pair zero-fold norm divisibility
nodes.statement: For a balanced signed shift-pair polynomial C, beta_a=0 exactly when Phi_(n_a) divides C in Z[X], while X-1 always divides C. If S and Z are the active and zero prefix-supplied dyadic levels, then 2^(|S|+sum_(j in S,a in Z)min(n_j,n_a)/2) p^R_S divides the product of active cyclotomic norms. Together with the shared Haar ceiling this gives the exact necessary pattern inequality 2^(|S|+T_2) p^R_S A_S^A_S<=(eN)^A_S. This can exclude zero-heavy patterns but supplies no ownership or population bound.

nodes.title: Primitive exact-list local general-star budget
nodes.statement: At an official base row let N=2^41, K=rho N, t=t_XR=min{0<=j<=N-K:q^j>=2^128 binom(N,N-K-j)}, and A=K+t. Fix the same support-wise first-match map as the final LIST ledger. For every primitive residual full locator-prefix fiber F_z^prim and base support S0, S maps injectively to (S\S0,S0\S), a general order-t star-PTE record. Prove |F_z^prim|-1<=16N^3-1 uniformly over official fields and domains. The exact difference-degree partition writes this local degree as D_0+sum_{d>=1}D_d, where d=deg(L_P-L_Q), D_0 is precisely the F-4 minimal constant-shift stratum, and d>=1 implies side width e>=t+d+1. The coefficient-scale quotient sieve removes every common scale c>1 and gives c|gcd(N,e,d); the remaining direct residue is coefficient-primitive. At d=1 the exact local object is a translated complementary-divisor incidence B|L_(S0), B+aX+b|L_(D\S0), and fixed aX+b is not an injective record key. The official corridor gives t>=2^31; either fixed-locator projection codegree is at most 1024, and the complete high-width band e>=N/4+1 costs at most N^3/64. Across all d>=1, every cell with 4e^2>N(e+d) costs at most 5N^3/16 in aggregate. The surviving nonconstant wedge satisfies 4e^2<=N(e+d) and e>=t+d+1; an abstract-code route cut proves its changed-set intersection constraints alone admit more than 16N^3 blocks, so locator algebra or exact first-owner structure is essential. Every live coefficient-primitive pair has a canonical nonzero antipodal fold beta_0. At effective depth T=e-d-1 it satisfies p^ceil(T/2)<=p^(fo)<=|Norm(beta_0)|<=(4e)^(N/4), where f=ord_N(p) and o counts represented Frobenius orbits; higher nonzero dyadic folds give analogous necessary gates. All active folds share one exact Haar energy budget. Structural zero folds supply exact dyadic cyclotomic factors, so every active/zero pattern obeys 2^(|S|+T_2(S,Z))p^R_S A_S^A_S<=(eN)^A_S; a pattern violating this integer inequality is empty. At the hard rate-half boundary e=N/8,d=e-t_XR-1, every possible pattern passes this complete generic size gate, so further work there needs exact factors, locator incidence, or first ownership. All surviving patterns remain open, and no population bound for vectors passing the gates is yet proved. D_0 and this wedge remain open. Transported quotient rows use their exact compiler-emitted tuple and own allowance and must appear in the final table.

nodes.title: XR deficient window: active-block nullity pin
nodes.statement: For every D-local deficient target, the two disjoint selected r-blocks force |G_d|>=2r, while the primitive Pade router gives dim K_d<=d-ell-|G_d|. Hence dim K_d<=3d-2h-ell. Thus the extremal residue is bounded-nullity and adjacent to the separate full-rank census, not an arbitrary-rank Pade family.

nodes.title: XR deficient Padé family: active-defect payment and punctured-list router
nodes.statement: In a nonempty deficient primitive Pade family (f_tau,g_tau)=(f_*+Q tau,g_*-P tau), the residual rho=P(u-f_*)+Q(v-g_*) is invariant across tau and has support D contained in the whole-kernel forced set G_d, with e=|D|<=d-ell-1. No joint core meets D. On H\D there is a fixed word w with E_tau=Q(w-tau), E_tau'=-P(w-tau), so the family injects into the exact punctured RS list of degree-<k-ell polynomials agreeing with w on k+d points. Every projective scalar error factors as (alpha Q-beta P)(w-tau). A D-local selected ray has an (h-d)-point block in D and every outside root of its degree-ell factor already in the core; distinct selected blocks are disjoint. All pairs exposing a selected off-core point outside D cost at most n-e, so only the D-local family remains, necessarily e>=2(h-d).

nodes.title: XR deficient window: affine-plane component payment
nodes.statement: For a fixed residual core plane and three pairwise distinct-phi points in one selected defect block, the two block conics contain at most three target parameters without any restriction-genericity premise. On every positive-dimensional common component, a varying ray would produce three Mobius functions with three distinct poles but one affine-linear dependence; hence the ray is constant and the same-ray interaction strip caps the component. The triple incidence bound is therefore unconditional. At the next dimensions it pays every r>2ell tuple with d+ell<=6840580025 at rates 1/4,1/8 and d+ell<=3435973837 at rate 1/16; the rate-1/16 ell=1 slice extends to d+1=3523371941.

nodes.title: XR deficient window: affine-plane triple router
nodes.statement: After s-2 independent active-core cuts, three pairwise distinct-phi points in one selected defect block impose two conics on the residual affine plane. If the residual two-dimensional direction code has nonzero pairwise distinct projective evaluations on the triple, the conics have no common component and at most three affine intersections. Double counting gives (APT1)-(APT2). At the next unpaid dimensions this pays the printed ell=1 lower-x slices unless a restriction-degenerate triple flag occurs. This first-stage router leaves that mass explicit; the downstream affine-plane component payment removes it.

nodes.title: XR deficient window: common-ray eliminant payment
nodes.statement: On an m-dimensional active-defect affine slice, a fixed (m+1)-tuple of pairwise distinct phi values belongs to one selected block for at most m+1 target parameters. Introducing the common error ray turns the block conditions into m+1 affine-linear equations in m parameters with coefficients linear in the ray. Generic consistency would create a varying-ray component, forbidden by the distinct-pole argument; a nonzero rank minor of degree at most m+1 therefore contains every admissible ray, and the same-ray strip leaves one target per root. At the full next dimensions this improves the ell=1 payment through d+1=8500560263 at rates 1/4,1/8 and d+1=4265559234 at rate 1/16.

nodes.title: XR deficient window: full-affine tuple payment
nodes.statement: On an s-dimensional active-defect parameter hull, any fixed (s+1)-tuple of points with pairwise distinct phi=[P:Q] values belongs to a common selected block for at most 2^s target parameters. The s block equations are quadrics; affine Bezout bounds their irreducible components by 2^s, while the distinct-pole argument forces the selected ray to be constant on every positive-dimensional component and the interaction strip leaves at most one target there. For ell=1 this gives |Tau|<=2^(s-1) binom(e,s+1)/binom(r,s+1). At the next official dimensions it pays through d+1=8453534100 at rates 1/4,1/8 and through d+1=4250714177 at rate 1/16.

nodes.title: XR deficient active-defect family: low-affine-span payment
nodes.statement: For the exact punctured parameter list of a D-local deficient Pade family, an affine dimension-s parameter set has size at most floor(C(R+ell-e+s,s)/C(d+ell+s,s)). Over the full official active-defect range this cap is maximized at d=ceil((2h+2)/3), ell=1, e=2(h-d). Exact integer evaluation pays the SL2-D budget through affine dimensions 9,9,8 at rates 1/4,1/8,1/16. Hence every counterexample has affine parameter dimension at least 10,10,9 respectively.

nodes.title: XR deficient active-defect family: mixed core/block payment
nodes.statement: For an affine dimension-s active-defect-local deficient family, double counting (s-1) independent punctured-core hyperplanes with two points in one selected defect block gives |Tau| <= (n-e)_(s-1)e(e-1)/(r(r-ell) product_{j=2}^s(d+ell+j)) whenever ell<r. The line residual has at most two members per witness; a degenerate determinant forces a constant selected slope and is removed by same-ray interaction. Combined with the affine-span compiler, exact official arithmetic pays dimensions 10,10,9 at rates 1/4,1/8,1/16. Any SL2-D counterexample has dimension at least 11,11,10.

nodes.title: XR deficient window: packed four-fiber plane payment
nodes.statement: At the tuple-incidence boundary, a stratum whose two selected blocks both have exact phi profile (ell,ell,1) uses four fixed full fibers and two points from a tail of size t=e-4ell in [2,sigma+2]. There are 6t individual block geometries, every target contributes two, and each fixed block owns at most three targets on an affine plane. Hence |Tau_pack| B_(s-2)<=9t binom(n-e,s-2). At the next dimensions this lies below the local allowance for every official tail. The bound is stratum-local and is not additive across mixed profiles or higher dimensions.

nodes.title: XR deficient window: exact phi-fiber and split-pencil router
nodes.statement: For every selected r-point active-defect block, the number of triples on three distinct phi=[P:Q] fibers is the third elementary symmetric function of the fiber multiplicities and is minimized by the maximally packed ell-capped profile. Conditional on at least three fibers, the exact minimum is r-2 for r<=ell+2, ell(r-ell-1) for ell+2<r<=2ell, and the packed-profile value for r>2ell. A block on at most two fibers has its square-free locator dividing one or two members of the primitive pencil bP-aQ. Thus the triple-incidence method routes every uncounted target into an exact split-pencil endpoint with at least two disjoint selected block locators; it does not by itself pay that endpoint or the high-fiber upper tails.

nodes.title: XR deficient window: two-block kernel-slack router
nodes.statement: Put r=h-d and sigma=d-ell-1-2r. Every nonempty D-local deficient target has 2r<=|D|<=|G_d|<=2r+sigma. If sigma<r, it has exactly two selected live blocks, those blocks cover all but sigma points of both D and G_d, and every kernel multiplier is the G_d locator times a polynomial of degree below sigma+1. At the tuple-incidence obstruction sigma is exactly 5,5,1 on the three official rows, so the deficient residue has cofactor degree below 6,6,2 and is structurally stronger than a generic nullity-at-most-six window.

nodes.title: XR deficient window: uniform higher-ell envelope payment
nodes.statement: For every order p, the exact minimum number of distinct-phi p-tuples in an r-point block with fiber cap ell is binom(q,p)ell^p+binom(q,p-1)ell^(p-1)u, where r=qell+u. Hence the next-dimensional target is paid whenever d+11ell-10<=8500560263 at rates 1/4,1/8 or d+10ell-9<=4265559234 at rate 1/16. At the admissible packed boundary r=2ell+1, however, the exact pair and triple caps both exceed budget while every higher tuple count vanishes; tuple-order optimization using only the current fiber/core currencies therefore cannot close the target.
